505: +// TestContainerStateUsesDockerVocabulary checks the state and status of every node state c9s
506: +// reports, in events and inspect.
507: +func TestContainerStateUsesDockerVocabulary(t *testing.T) {
508: +	t.Parallel()
509: +
510: +	c9sLab, err := clabcore.NewContainerLab(clabcore.WithLabNameOnly("parity"))
511: +	if err != nil {
512: +		t.Fatal(err)
513: +	}
514: +
515: +	state := &clablabruntime.LabState{Name: "parity", Namespace: "c9s-parity"}
516: +	tests := []struct {
517: +		node          clablabruntime.NodeState
518: +		state, status string
519: +	}{
520: +		{
521: +			clablabruntime.NodeState{Name: "a", ContainerState: "created", State: "notready"},
522: +			"created", "Created",
523: +		},
524: +		{clablabruntime.NodeState{
525: +			Name: "b", ContainerState: "running", Health: "starting",
526: +			State: "notready",
527: +		}, "running", "health: starting"},
528: +		{clablabruntime.NodeState{
529: +			Name: "c", ContainerState: "running", Health: "healthy",
530: +			State: "ready", Ready: true,
531: +		}, "running", "healthy"},
532: +		{
533: +			clablabruntime.NodeState{Name: "d", ContainerState: "exited", State: "stopped"},
534: +			"exited", "Exited",
535: +		},
536: +	}
537: +	for _, tt := range tests {
538: +		container := c9sLab.LabRuntimeContainer(state, tt.node)
539: +		if container.State != tt.state || container.Status != tt.status {
540: +			t.Fatalf("%s: %s / %s, want %s / %s", tt.node.Name, container.State, container.Status,
541: +				tt.state, tt.status)
542: +		}
543: +	}
544: +}

546: +// dockerInterfaceEvent is a netlink interface event of a Docker container.
547: +func dockerInterfaceEvent(
548: +	container clabruntime.GenericContainer,
549: +	action string,
550: +	snapshot ifaceSnapshot,
551: +	stats *ifaceStatsMetrics,
552: +) aggregatedEvent {
553: +	attributes := interfaceAttributes(&container, snapshot)
554: +	if stats != nil {
555: +		interfaceStatsAttributes(attributes, *stats)
556: +	}
557: +
558: +	return aggregatedEvent{
559: +		Type: "interface", Action: action, ActorID: container.ShortID,
560: +		ActorName: container.Names[0], ActorFullID: container.ID, Attributes: attributes,
561: +	}
562: +}
563: +
564: +func c9sInterfaceEvent(
565: +	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
566: +	node clablabruntime.NodeState,
567: +	action string,
568: +	iface clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData,
569: +) aggregatedEvent {
570: +	key := state.Namespace + "/" + state.Name + "/" + node.Name
571: +
572: +	return aggregatedEventFromLabRuntimeEvent(nil, clablabruntime.Event{
573: +		Type: clablabruntime.EventTypeInterface, Action: action,
574: +		ActorID: key, ActorName: state.Name + "-" + node.Name, ActorFullID: key,
575: +		Attributes: map[string]string{
576: +			"namespace": state.Namespace, "lab": state.Name, "node": node.Name, "pod": node.Pod,
577: +			"origin": "clabernetes",
578: +		},
579: +		Lab: state, Node: &node, Interface: &iface,
580: +	})
581: +}
582: +
583: +// TestInterfaceEventParity compares the interface events of the lab link (linux eth1, SR Linux
584: +// e1-1 with its alias ethernet-1/1), the management interface and loopback.
585: +func TestInterfaceEventParity(t *testing.T) {
586: +	path, dockerLab := parityLab(t)
587: +
588: +	tests := []struct {
589: +		node string
590: +		data clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData
591: +	}{
592: +		{
593: +			"client",
594: +			clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
595: +				Name:      "eth1",
596: +				Index:     7,
597: +				MTU:       9500,
598: +				MAC:       "aa:c1:ab:56:aa:46",
599: +				OperState: "up",
600: +				Type:      "veth",
601: +			},
602: +		},
603: +		{"srl1", clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
604: +			Name: "e1-1", Alias: "ethernet-1/1", Index: 7, MTU: 9500, MAC: "aa:c1:ab:56:aa:47",
605: +			OperState: "lower-layer-down", Type: "veth",
606: +		}},
607: +		{
608: +			"client",
609: +			clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
610: +				Name:      "eth0",
611: +				Index:     4,
612: +				MTU:       1500,
613: +				MAC:       "02:42:ac:14:14:02",
614: +				OperState: "up",
615: +				Type:      "veth",
616: +			},
617: +		},
618: +		{"client", clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
619: +			Name: "lo", Index: 1, MTU: 65536, OperState: "unknown", Type: "device",
620: +		}},
621: +	}
622: +	for _, tt := range tests {
623: +		container := dockerContainer(t, dockerLab, tt.node)
624: +		state, nodeState := c9sNode(dockerLab, path, tt.node)
625: +		snapshot := ifaceSnapshot{
626: +			Index: tt.data.Index, Name: tt.data.Name, Alias: tt.data.Alias, MTU: tt.data.MTU,
627: +			MAC: tt.data.MAC, OperState: tt.data.OperState, Type: tt.data.Type,
628: +		}
629: +		metrics := ifaceStatsMetrics{
630: +			RxBytes: 2000, TxBytes: 3000, RxPackets: 20, TxPackets: 30,
631: +			RxBps: 8000, TxBps: 12000, RxPps: 10, TxPps: 15, Interval: 2 * time.Second,
632: +		}
633: +
634: +		for _, action := range []string{"snapshot", "create", "update", "delete", "stats"} {
635: +			var stats *ifaceStatsMetrics
636: +			data := tt.data
637: +			if action == "stats" {
638: +				stats = &metrics
639: +				data.Stats = &clablabruntime.InterfaceStats{
640: +					RxBytes: 2000, TxBytes: 3000, RxPackets: 20, TxPackets: 30,
641: +					RxBps: 8000, TxBps: 12000, RxPps: 10, TxPps: 15, Interval: 2 * time.Second,
642: +				}
643: +			}
644: +			docker := dockerInterfaceEvent(container, action, snapshot, stats)
645: +			c9s := c9sInterfaceEvent(state, nodeState, action, data)
646: +			assertAttributeParity(t, docker, c9s, nil)
647: +
648: +			dockerAttributes := mergedEventAttributes(docker)
649: +			got := mergedEventAttributes(c9s)
650: +			for key, value := range dockerAttributes {
651: +				switch key {
652: +				case "id", "name", "lab", "origin":
653: +					// the node's own ID, name and lab; the source of the event
654: +					continue
655: +				}
656: +				if got[key] != value {
657: +					t.Fatalf("%s %s %s: %s = %q, docker %q", tt.node, tt.data.Name, action, key,
658: +						got[key], value)
659: +				}
660: +			}
661: +			if got["name"] != "parity-"+tt.node || got["lab"] != "parity" ||
662: +				got["id"] != "c9s-parity/parity/"+tt.node {
663: +				t.Fatalf("%s %s %s: node attributes %v", tt.node, tt.data.Name, action, got)
664: +			}
665: +		}
666: +	}
667: +}

669: +// TestInterfaceEventOmitsUnknownValues checks that values the runtime could not read are left
670: +// out: an index of 0 would make clients take two interfaces for one.
671: +func TestInterfaceEventOmitsUnknownValues(t *testing.T) {
672: +	t.Parallel()
673: +
674: +	state := &clablabruntime.LabState{Name: "parity", Namespace: "c9s-parity"}
675: +	ev := c9sInterfaceEvent(state, clablabruntime.NodeState{Name: "client"}, "stats",
676: +		clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
677: +			Name: "eth1", Type: "veth",
678: +			Stats: &clablabruntime.InterfaceStats{RxBytes: 1, Interval: time.Second},
679: +		})
680: +	got := mergedEventAttributes(ev)
681: +	for _, key := range []string{"index", "mtu", "state", "mac", "alias"} {
682: +		if _, ok := got[key]; ok {
683: +			t.Fatalf("%s reported without a value: %v", key, got)
684: +		}
685: +	}
686: +	if got["ifname"] != "eth1" || got["rx_bytes"] != "1" || got["interval_seconds"] != "1" {
687: +		t.Fatalf("stats = %v", got)
688: +	}
689: +}

691: +func TestLabRuntimeTopologyEventsKeepTheirAttributes(t *testing.T) {
692: +	t.Parallel()
693: +
694: +	ev := aggregatedEventFromLabRuntimeEvent(nil, clablabruntime.Event{
695: +		Type: "topology", Action: "modified", ActorID: "c9s-parity/parity", ActorName: "parity",
696: +		Attributes: map[string]string{"lab": "parity", "state": "running"},
697: +	})
698: +	if !strings.EqualFold(ev.Attributes["lab"], "parity") || len(ev.Attributes) != 2 {
699: +		t.Fatalf("topology event = %+v", ev)

701: +}

964: +// labRuntimeContainerState is a lab runtime node's state and status in the vocabulary of the
965: +// container runtimes: state created, running or exited; status healthy or "health: starting"
966: +// for a running node, as inspect shortens a Docker status line with a healthcheck, Created or
967: +// Exited otherwise. A runtime that reports no container state keeps its own state.
968: +func labRuntimeContainerState(
969: +	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
970: +	node clablabruntime.NodeState,
971: +) (string, string) {
972: +	switch node.ContainerState {
973: +	case clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning:
974: +		if node.Health == clablabruntime.ContainerHealthHealthy {
975: +			return node.ContainerState, "healthy"
976: +		}
977: +
978: +		return node.ContainerState, "health: starting"
979: +	case clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated:
980: +		return node.ContainerState, "Created"
981: +	case clablabruntime.ContainerStateExited:
982: +		return node.ContainerState, "Exited"
983: +	}
984: +
985: +	if node.Ready {
986: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning, "healthy"
987: +	}
988: +	if node.State == "" {
989: +		return state.State, ""
990: +	}
991: +
992: +	return node.State, node.State
993: +}
994: +
995: +// labRuntimePorts reports the ports a lab runtime exposes for a node as the ports a container
996: +// exposes without publishing them on the host: the node is reached through the runtime (a
997: +// Service, a port-forward), never on a port of this machine.
998: +func labRuntimePorts(ports []clablabruntime.ExposedPort) []*clabtypes.GenericPortBinding {
999: +	if len(ports) == 0 {
1000: +		return nil
1001: +	}
1002: +
1003: +	bindings := make([]*clabtypes.GenericPortBinding, 0, len(ports))
1004: +	for _, port := range ports {
1005: +		bindings = append(bindings, &clabtypes.GenericPortBinding{
1006: +			ContainerPort: port.Port,
1007: +			Protocol:      port.Protocol,
1008: +		})
1009: +	}
1010: +
1011: +	return bindings
1012: +}
1013: +

1016:  	return fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/%s", namespace, lab, node)
1017:  }

1074: diff --git a/docs/cmd/events.md b/docs/cmd/events.md
1075: index 92d51ed..23d9eef 100644
1076: --- a/docs/cmd/events.md
1077: +++ b/docs/cmd/events.md
1078: @@ -75,19 +75,25 @@ Currently supported runtimes:
1079:  
1080:  - `docker`
1081:  - `c9s`
1082:  
1083:  With `--runtime c9s`, events are backed by kubernetes watches for Clabernetes
1084: -`Topology` and `Node` resources and labeled Pods. Interface state (`interface up`
1085: -and `interface down` events) and statistics are sampled inside the device
1086: -containers, not through local host netlink. The stream covers every namespace by
1087: -default; `--namespace` (or `CLAB_KUBE_NAMESPACE`) limits it to one namespace,
1088: -and `-t`/`--name` to one lab. With Docker and Podman the lab selection is ignored
1089: -and every lab is streamed.
1090: +`Topology` and `Node` resources and labeled Pods. They use the actions and
1091: +attributes of the Docker runtime: a node is a container (`create`, `start`,
1092: +`kill`, `stop`, `die`, `destroy`, `health_status: …`) described by the same
1093: +labels, and the interface events (`snapshot`, `create`, `update`, `delete`,
1094: +`stats`) report the node's lab link interfaces, `eth0` and `lo` under the names
1095: +a Docker container of the node has. Interface state and statistics are sampled
1096: +inside the device containers, not through local host netlink. The stream covers
1097: +every namespace by default; `--namespace` (or `CLAB_KUBE_NAMESPACE`) limits it
1098: +to one namespace, and `-t`/`--name` to one lab. With Docker and Podman the lab
1099: +selection is ignored and every lab is streamed. The
1100: +[c9s runtime manual](../manual/clabernetes/runtime.md#events) lists the
1101: +attributes and the few Docker attributes c9s has no equivalent for.
1102:  
1103:  Runtimes that do not implement the `events` API, or are not yet supported by Containerlab, will exit with an explanatory error.
1104:  
1105:  ## See also
1106:  
1107:  - [`inspect interfaces`](inspect/interfaces.md) – produces a point-in-time view of the same interface details that `events` reports continuously.
1108: -- [Clabernetes containerlab runtime](../manual/clabernetes/runtime.md) - explains how c9s events differ from Docker events.
1109: +- [Clabernetes containerlab runtime](../manual/clabernetes/runtime.md#events) - describes c9s events and how they map onto Docker events.
1110:  - `docker events` – the raw runtime feed that Containerlab builds upon.
1111: diff --git a/docs/cmd/inspect/interfaces.md b/docs/cmd/inspect/interfaces.md
1112: index 2354dc1..43fbb9a 100644
1113: --- a/docs/cmd/inspect/interfaces.md
1114: +++ b/docs/cmd/inspect/interfaces.md
1115: @@ -3,11 +3,11 @@
1116:  ### Description
1117:  
1118:  The `inspect interfaces` subcommand provides information about the network interfaces of deployed nodes of a deployed lab.
1119:  The subcommand gathers information directly from deployed containers, and displays information about their operational state, network interface type, and if applicable, the applied network interface alias.
1120:  
1121: -With the [c9s runtime](../../manual/clabernetes/runtime.md#packet-capture), the listing covers the lab link interfaces of each running node, the ones [`capture`](../capture.md) accepts, with the alias the topology used, and the MAC address, index, MTU and operational state read in the node's device container. The node names follow `inspect` (`<lab>-<node>`), and the JSON fields are the same as with Docker.
1122: +With the [c9s runtime](../../manual/clabernetes/runtime.md#interface-events), the listing covers the interfaces a Docker container of the node has: the lab link interfaces of each running node (the ones [`capture`](../capture.md) accepts) with the alias the topology used, the management interface `eth0` and the loopback `lo`, with the MAC address, index, MTU and operational state read in the node's device container. The pod's own interfaces are not listed. The node names follow `inspect` (`<lab>-<node>`), and the JSON fields and values (`veth`/`device`, netlink state names) are the same as with Docker. `eth0` and `lo` cannot be captured on c9s.
1123:  
1124:  ### Usage
1125:  
1126:  `containerlab [global-flags] inspect interfaces [local-flags]`
1127:

1129: index 8174c98..751ccf1 100644
1130: --- a/docs/manual/clabernetes/runtime.md
1131: +++ b/docs/manual/clabernetes/runtime.md
1132: @@ -543,10 +543,45 @@ port-forward without working out the pod themselves:
1133:  
1134:  These fields are only present for lab runtimes; Docker and Podman output is
1135:  unchanged. Fields without a value, such as `pod` for a stopped node, are left
1136:  out. `--details` keeps printing the raw records.
1137:  
1138: +The other fields mean what they mean for Docker and Podman, so clients can treat
1139: +c9s nodes like containers:
1140: +
1141: +| Field | c9s value |
1142: +|---|---|
1143: +| `state` | `created` while the node's pod is scheduled and prepared, `running` once its device containers run, `exited` once the node is stopped (or its pod ends or is replaced) |
1144: +| `status` | `healthy` once the node is ready or its device containers are, `health: starting` while a running device boots, `Created`, `Exited` |
1145: +| `labPath`, `absLabPath` | the topology file the lab was deployed from (see below) |
1146: +| `name` | `<lab>-<node>`, the name events use as `actor_name` |
1147: +
1148: +### Topology file
1149: +
1150: +A deploy records the absolute path of the topology file, on the machine that
1151: +deployed it, in the annotation `containerlab.dev/topo-file`:
1152: +
1153: +- with a `Topology` resource, on the `Topology`; every deploy records the file
1154: +  it read
1155: +- with `--no-topology-cr`, on every `Node`. clabernetes copies a Node's
1156: +  annotations into its pod, so a Node keeps the file it was created from: a
1157: +  later deploy from another file does not change it and does not restart the
1158: +  node. Destroy and deploy again to record a new file.
1159: +
1160: +`inspect` reports the recorded file as `labPath` and `absLabPath` (shortened
1161: +for the table, as for Docker), and events as `clab-topo-file`, so a client
1162: +matches a running lab to its file the same way for every runtime. The file is a
1163: +path on the deploying machine; a client on another machine cannot assume it
1164: +exists there.
1165: +
1166: +A lab that containerlab did not deploy from a file, for example one applied from
1167: +`deploy --emit-crs` output with `kubectl` (the emitted manifests do not carry
1168: +the annotation), has no recorded file. It reports where its definition lives in
1169: +the cluster: `k8s://<namespace>/topologies/<lab>`, or
1170: +`k8s://<namespace>/labs/<lab>` without a `Topology` resource. With `-t`,
1171: +`inspect` reports the given file.
1172: +
1173:  Useful kubernetes checks for the same state are:
1174:  
1175:  ```bash
1176:  kubectl -n <namespace> get node.c9s.run,link.c9s.run,nodeprofile.c9s.run,deploy,pod,svc,cm,pvc \
1177:    -l c9s.run/topologyOwner=<lab>
1178: @@ -697,12 +732,18 @@ stopped node is started by the same patch.
1179:  What a stopped node keeps and loses:
1180:  
1181:  - The `Node`, its Services, PersistentVolumeClaims and Links stay. Saved
1182:    configuration survives a stop and start.
1183:  - Its links go carrier-down on every peer, like an unplugged cable;
1184: -  `events` reports them as interface `down` events.
1185: -- `inspect` shows the node as `stopped` (`stopping` while its Pod terminates).
1186: +  `events` reports an interface `update` with state `lower-layer-down` on the
1187: +  peers, and deletes the stopped node's interfaces.
1188: +- `inspect` shows the node as `exited` with status `Exited`.
1189: +- `events` reports the container actions Docker reports for `containerlab stop`
1190: +  and `start`: `kill`, `stop` and `die` when the node's pod goes, `start` when

1240: +Each node is reported as a container. Its state follows its pod: `created`

1249: +| `stop` | `kill`, `stop`, `die` |

1251: +| `restart`, or the pod is replaced | `kill`, `stop`, `die`, `start` |
1252: +| the node is removed (destroy, apply) | `kill`, `die` (when it ran), `destroy` |

1255: +is its state (`running`, `exited`, `created`) and `origin` `snapshot`, like the
1256: +snapshot of a Docker container.

Fields without a value, such as `pod` for a stopped node, are left\n1136:  out. `--details` keeps printing the raw records.\n1137:  \n1138: +The other fields mean what they mean for Docker and Podman, so clients can treat\n1139: +c9s nodes like containers:\n1140: +\n1141: +| Field | c9s value |\n1142: +|---|---|\n1143: +| `state` | `created` while the node's pod is scheduled and prepared, `running` once its device containers run, `exited` once the node is stopped (or its pod ends or is replaced) |\n1144: +| `status` | `healthy` once the node is ready or its device containers are, `health: starting` while a running device boots, `Created`, `Exited` |\n1145: +| `labPath`, `absLabPath` | the topology file the lab was deployed from (see below) |\n1146: +| `name` | `<lab>-<node>`, the name events use as `actor_name` |\n1147: +\n1148: +### Topology file\n1149: +\n1150: +A deploy records the absolute path of the topology file, on the machine that\n1151: +deployed it, in the annotation `containerlab.dev/topo-file`:\n1152: +\n1153: +- with a `Topology` resource, on the `Topology`; every deploy records the file\n1154: +  it read\n1155: +- with `--no-topology-cr`, on every `Node`. clabernetes copies a Node's\n1156: +  annotations into its pod, so a Node keeps the file it was created from: a\n1157: +  later deploy from another file does not change it and does not restart the\n1158: +  node. Destroy and deploy again to record a new file.\n1159: +\n1160: +`inspect` reports the recorded file as `labPath` and `absLabPath` (shortened\n1161: +for the table, as for Docker), and events as `clab-topo-file`, so a client\n1162: +matches a running lab to its file the same way for every runtime. The file is a\n1163: +path on the deploying machine; a client on another machine cannot assume it\n1164: +exists there.\n1165: +\n1166: +A lab that containerlab did not deploy from a file, for example one applied from\n1167: +`deploy --emit-crs` output with `kubectl` (the emitted manifests do not carry\n1168: +the annotation), has no recorded file. It reports where its definition lives in\n1169: +the cluster: `k8s://<namespace>/topologies/<lab>`, or\n1170: +`k8s://<namespace>/labs/<lab>` without a `Topology` resource. With `-t`,\n1171: +`inspect` reports the given file.\n1172: +\n1173:  Useful kubernetes checks for the same state are:\n1174:  \n1175:  ```bash\n1176:  kubectl -n <namespace> get node.c9s.run,link.c9s.run,nodeprofile.c9s.run,deploy,pod,svc,cm,pvc \\\n1177:    -l c9s.run/topologyOwner=<lab>\n1178: @@ -697,12 +732,18 @@ stopped node is started by the same patch.\n1179:  What a stopped node keeps and loses:\n1180:  \n1181:  - The `Node`, its Services, PersistentVolumeClaims and Links stay. 1757: +// trackedContainer is the last reported container state of a node.
1758: +type trackedContainer struct {

1768: +// containerTracker turns the node states of the labs in an event scope into the container
1769: +// events the Docker runtime emits for the same lifecycle: create and start when a node's pod
1770: +// starts, kill, stop and die when it stops (on request, or between the pods of a restart),
1771: +// destroy when the node is removed, and health_status as its device becomes ready.
1772: +type containerTracker struct {

1778: +// trackContainers reports the container events of a scope. It reads the labs once, reporting
1779: +// them as a snapshot when the stream includes the initial state, and then reads a lab again
1780: +// whenever its Topology, Nodes or pods change. Changes that arrive together are read once.
1781: +func (r *Runtime) trackContainers(
1782: +	ctx context.Context,
1783: +	scope eventScope,
1784: +	includeInitialState bool,
1785: +	changed <-chan labRef,
1786: +	eventSink chan<- clablabruntime.Event,
1787: +	errSink chan<- error,
1788: +) {
1789: +	tracker := &containerTracker{r: r, sink: eventSink, nodes: map[string]*trackedContainer{}}
1790: +
1791: +	states, err := r.labStates(ctx, scope)
1792: +	if err != nil {
1793: +		sendEventError(ctx, errSink, err)
1794: +		return
1795: +	}
1796: +	for _, state := range states {
1797: +		tracker.observeLab(ctx, labRef{namespace: state.Namespace, lab: state.Name}, state,
1798: +			&observeSeed{snapshot: includeInitialState})
1799: +	}
1800: +
1801: +	pending := map[labRef]bool{}
1802: +	timer := time.NewTimer(time.Hour)
1803: +	timer.Stop()
1804: +	defer timer.Stop()
1805: +	armed := false
1806: +	arm := func(delay time.Duration) {
1807: +		if !armed {
1808: +			timer.Reset(delay)
1809: +			armed = true
1810: +		}
1811: +	}
1812: +
1813: +	for {
1814: +		select {
1815: +		case <-ctx.Done():
1816: +			return
1817: +		case ref := <-changed:
1818: +			pending[ref] = true
1819: +			arm(containerRefreshDelay)
1820: +		case <-timer.C:
1821: +			armed = false
1822: +			refs := pending
1823: +			pending = map[labRef]bool{}
1824: +			for ref := range refs {
1825: +				if !tracker.refresh(ctx, ref) {
1826: +					pending[ref] = true
1827: +				}
1828: +			}
1829: +			if len(pending) != 0 {
1830: +				arm(containerRefreshRetryDelay)
1831: +			}
1832: +		}
1833: +	}
1834: +}

1836: +// observeSeed marks the first observation of a stream: it records the node states without
1837: +// reporting changes, and reports them as a snapshot when asked to.
1838: +type observeSeed struct {
1839: +	snapshot bool
1840: +}
1841: +
1842: +// refresh reads a lab again and reports what changed for its nodes. A lab that is gone reports
1843: +// its nodes as destroyed. It returns false when the lab could not be read.
1844: +func (t *containerTracker) refresh(ctx context.Context, ref labRef) bool {
1845: +	state, err := t.r.Inspect(ctx, clablabruntime.InspectRequest{
1846: +		Name:      ref.lab,
1847: +		Namespace: ref.namespace,
1848: +	})
1849: +	if err != nil {
1850: +		var notFound *labNotFoundError
1851: +		if !errors.As(err, &notFound) {
1852: +			if ctx.Err() == nil {
1853: +				log.Debug("Failed to read a C9s lab for container events",
1854: +					"namespace", ref.namespace, "lab", ref.lab, "error", err)
1855: +			}
1856: +
1857: +			return ctx.Err() != nil
1858: +		}
1859: +		state = nil
1860: +	}
1861: +
1862: +	t.observeLab(ctx, ref, state, nil)
1863: +
1864: +	return true
1865: +}
1866: +
1867: +// observeLab compares the nodes of a lab with what was reported before and reports the
1868: +// difference. A nil state removes every node of the lab.
1869: +func (t *containerTracker) observeLab(
1870: +	ctx context.Context,
1871: +	ref labRef,
1872: +	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
1873: +	seed *observeSeed,
1874: +) {
1875: +	seen := map[string]bool{}
1876: +	if state != nil {
1877: +		for idx := range state.Nodes {
1878: +			key := c9sNodeKey(state.Namespace, state.Name, state.Nodes[idx].Name)
1879: +			seen[key] = true
1880: +			t.observeNode(ctx, ref, state, state.Nodes[idx], seed)
1881: +		}
1882: +	}
1883: +
1884: +	for key, tracked := range t.nodes {
1885: +		if tracked.ref != ref || seen[key] {
1886: +			continue
1887: +		}
1888: +
1889: +		for _, action := range containerRemovalActions(tracked) {
1890: +			t.emit(ctx, tracked.lab, tracked.node, action, nil)
1891: +		}
1892: +		delete(t.nodes, key)
1893: +	}
1894: +}

1896: +func (t *containerTracker) observeNode(
1897: +	ctx context.Context,
1898: +	ref labRef,
1899: +	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
1900: +	node clablabruntime.NodeState,
1901: +	seed *observeSeed,
1902: +) {
1903: +	key := c9sNodeKey(state.Namespace, state.Name, node.Name)
1904: +	previous := t.nodes[key]
1905: +	if node.ContainerState == "" {
1906: +		node.ContainerState = clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated
1907: +	}
1908: +	next := &trackedContainer{
1909: +		ref:   ref,
1910: +		state: node.ContainerState,
1911: +		pod:   node.Pod,
1912: +		lab:   state,
1913: +		node:  node,
1914: +	}
1915: +	next.health = containerHealth(previous, next, node.Health)
1916: +	t.nodes[key] = next
1917: +
1918: +	if seed != nil {
1919: +		if seed.snapshot {
1920: +			t.emit(ctx, state, node, next.state, map[string]string{
1921: +				"origin": clablabruntime.EventOriginSnapshot,
1922: +			})
1923: +		}
1924: +
1925: +		return
1926: +	}
1927: +
1928: +	for _, action := range containerTransitionActions(previous, next) {
1929: +		t.emit(ctx, state, node, action, nil)
1930: +	}
1931: +}

1933: +// containerHealth is the health a running node reports: a node that was healthy and is not
1934: +// ready anymore in the same pod is unhealthy, as a container whose healthcheck starts failing.
1935: +func containerHealth(previous, next *trackedContainer, health string) string {
1936: +	if next.state != clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning {
1937: +		return ""
1938: +	}
1939: +	if health == "" {
1940: +		health = clablabruntime.ContainerHealthStarting
1941: +	}
1942: +	if health == clablabruntime.ContainerHealthStarting && previous != nil &&
1943: +		previous.state == clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning && previous.pod == next.pod &&
1944: +		(previous.health == clablabruntime.ContainerHealthHealthy ||
1945: +			previous.health == clablabruntime.ContainerHealthUnhealthy) {
1946: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerHealthUnhealthy
1947: +	}
1948: +
1949: +	return health
1950: +}
1951: +
1952: +// containerTransitionActions are the container event actions Docker reports when a container
1953: +// goes from the previous to the next state:
1954: +//
1955: +//	new node            create (+ start when it runs, + stop when it is already stopped)
1956: +//	created -> running  start
1957: +//	exited  -> running  start
1958: +//	running -> exited   kill, stop, die (stop, or the old pod of a restart ending)
1959: +//	running -> created  kill, stop, die (the replacement pod of a restart not running yet)
1960: +//	running, new pod    kill, stop, die, start (restart)
1961: +//	created -> exited   stop
1962: +//
1963: +// A started node also reports its health (health_status: starting or healthy), and a running
1964: +// node reports health changes, like a container with a healthcheck.
1965: +func containerTransitionActions(previous, next *trackedContainer) []string {
1966: +	const (
1967: +		created = clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated
1968: +		running = clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning
1969: +		exited  = clablabruntime.ContainerStateExited
1970: +	)
1971: +
1972: +	var actions []string
1973: +	previousState := ""
1974: +	if previous != nil {
1975: +		previousState = previous.state
1976: +	}
1977: +
1978: +	switch {
1979: +	case previous == nil:
1980: +		actions = append(actions, containerActionCreate)
1981: +		switch next.state {
1982: +		case running:
1983: +			actions = append(actions, containerActionStart)
1984: +		case exited:
1985: +			actions = append(actions, containerActionStop)
1986: +		}
1987: +	case previousState == running && next.state == running && previous.pod != next.pod:
1988: +		actions = append(actions, containerActionKill, containerActionStop, containerActionDie,
1989: +			containerActionStart)
1990: +	case previousState == running && next.state != running:
1991: +		actions = append(actions, containerActionKill, containerActionStop, containerActionDie)
1992: +	case previousState != running && next.state == running:
1993: +		actions = append(actions, containerActionStart)
1994: +	case previousState == created && next.state == exited:
1995: +		actions = append(actions, containerActionStop)
1996: +	}
1997: +
1998: +	if next.state != running {
1999: +		return actions
2000: +	}
2001: +
2002: +	started := len(actions) != 0 && actions[len(actions)-1] == containerActionStart
2003: +	if !started && previous != nil && previous.health == next.health {
2004: +		return actions
2005: +	}
2006: +	if next.health == clablabruntime.ContainerHealthStarting && !started {
2007: +		return actions
2008: +	}
2009: +
2010: +	return append(actions, containerActionHealthPrefix+next.health)
2011: +}
2012: +
2013: +// containerRemovalActions are the actions Docker reports when a container is removed: a running
2014: +// one is killed and dies first.
2015: +func containerRemovalActions(previous *trackedContainer) []string {
2016: +	if previous.state == clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning {
2017: +		return []string{containerActionKill, containerActionDie, containerActionDestroy}
2018: +	}
2019: +
2020: +	return []string{containerActionDestroy}
2021: +}
2022: +
2023: +// containerActionState is the container state after an action, which every container event
2024: +// reports in its state attribute.
2025: +func containerActionState(action, snapshotState string) string {
2026: +	switch action {
2027: +	case containerActionCreate:
2028: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated
2029: +	case containerActionStop, containerActionDie, containerActionDestroy:
2030: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateExited
2031: +	case containerActionStart, containerActionKill:
2032: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning
2033: +	}
2034: +	if strings.HasPrefix(action, containerActionHealthPrefix) {
2035: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning
2036: +	}
2037: +
2038: +	return snapshotState
2039: +}
2040: +
2041: +func (t *containerTracker) emit(
2042: +	ctx context.Context,
2043: +	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
2044: +	node clablabruntime.NodeState,
2045: +	action string,
2046: +	extra map[string]string,
2047: +) {
2048: +	t.r.sendEvent(ctx, t.sink, c9sContainerEvent(state, node, action, extra))
2049: +}
2050: +
2051: +// c9sContainerEvent is a container event of a node. The actor is the node, as for its interface
2052: +// events; its ID is the container_id inspect reports. Lab and Node let the events command
2053: +// describe the node with the attributes inspect and the Docker runtime report.
2054: +func c9sContainerEvent(
2055: +	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
2056: +	node clablabruntime.NodeState,
2057: +	action string,
2058: +	extra map[string]string,
2059: +) clablabruntime.Event {
2060: +	key := c9sNodeKey(state.Namespace, state.Name, node.Name)
2061: +	attributes := map[string]string{
2062: +		"namespace":                  state.Namespace,
2063: +		"lab":                        state.Name,
2064: +		"node":                       node.Name,
2065: +		containerEventAttributeState: containerActionState(action, node.ContainerState),
2066: +	}
2067: +	if node.Pod != "" {
2068: +		attributes["pod"] = node.Pod
2069: +	}
2070: +	if action == containerActionKill {
2071: +		// Kubernetes stops a pod's containers with SIGTERM.
2072: +		attributes["signal"] = containerEventSignalSIGTERM
2073: +	}
2074: +	for k, v := range extra {
2075: +		attributes[k] = v
2076: +	}
2077: +
2078: +	nodeCopy := node
2079: +
2080: +	return clablabruntime.Event{
2081: +		Timestamp:   time.Now(),
2082: +		Type:        clablabruntime.EventTypeContainer,
2083: +		Action:      action,
2084: +		ActorID:     key,
2085: +		ActorName:   fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", state.Name, node.Name),
2086: +		ActorFullID: key,
2087: +		Attributes:  attributes,
2088: +		Lab:         state,
2089: +		Node:        &nodeCopy,
2090: +	}
2091: +}

2247: +// TestInterfacePollerReportsTheTopologyInterfaces runs a linux and an SR Linux node through the
2248: +// poller: only the lab link interfaces (named and aliased as clabwire lists them), eth0 and lo
2249: +// are reported, with the actions of the netlink events.
2250: +func TestInterfacePollerReportsTheTopologyInterfaces(t *testing.T) {
2251: +	t.Parallel()
2252: +
2253: +	tests := []struct {
2254: +		name  string
2255: +		link  string
2256: +		alias string
2257: +	}{
2258: +		{name: "linux", link: "eth1"},
2259: +		{name: "srl", link: "e1-1", alias: "ethernet-1/1"},
2260: +	}
2261: +	for _, tt := range tests {
2262: +		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
2263: +			t.Parallel()
2264: +
2265: +			links := []clabwireInterface{{
2266: +				Node: "r1", Interface: tt.link, Alias: tt.alias,
2267: +				PeerNode: "r2", PeerInterface: tt.link,
2268: +			}}
2269: +			sink := make(chan clablabruntime.Event, 64)
2270: +			p := newInterfacePoller(&Runtime{}, eventScope{},
2271: +				interfacePollOptions{includeInitialState: true}, sink)
2272: +			ctx := context.Background()
2273: +			start := time.Now()
2274: +
2275: +			p.processSample(
2276: +				ctx,
2277: +				interfaceTestSample("r1", start, links, podInterfaces(tt.link, "up")),
2278: +			)
2279: +			got := interfacesByName(drain(sink))
2280: +			if len(got) != 3 {
2281: +				t.Fatalf("first round reported %v, want %s, eth0 and lo", got, tt.link)
2282: +			}
2283: +			link := got[tt.link]
2284: +			if link.Action != interfaceActionSnapshot ||
2285: +				link.Type != clablabruntime.EventTypeInterface ||
2286: +				link.ActorID != "c9s-lab1/lab1/r1" ||
2287: +				link.ActorFullID != "c9s-lab1/lab1/r1" ||
2288: +				link.ActorName != "lab1-r1" || link.Interface.Alias != tt.alias ||
2289: +				link.Interface.OperState != "up" || link.Interface.Type != "veth" ||
2290: +				link.Lab == nil || link.Node == nil || link.Node.Name != "r1" ||
2291: +				link.Attributes["origin"] != "clabernetes" ||
2292: +				link.Attributes["pod"] != "lab1-r1-abc" ||
2293: +				link.Attributes["namespace"] != "c9s-lab1" {
2294: +				t.Fatalf("%s event = %+v", tt.link, link)
2295: +			}
2296: +			if got["lo"].Interface.Type != "device" || got["eth0"].Interface.Alias != "" {
2297: +				t.Fatalf("eth0/lo = %+v %+v", got["eth0"].Interface, got["lo"].Interface)
2298: +			}
2299: +
2300: +			// unchanged: nothing
2301: +			p.firstRound = false
2302: +			p.processSample(ctx, interfaceTestSample("r1", start.Add(time.Second), links,
2303: +				podInterfaces(tt.link, "up")))
2304: +			if events := drain(sink); len(events) != 0 {
2305: +				t.Fatalf("unchanged interfaces reported %+v", events)
2306: +			}
2307: +
2308: +			// the peer goes away: the link loses its carrier
2309: +			p.processSample(ctx, interfaceTestSample("r1", start.Add(2*time.Second), links,
2310: +				podInterfaces(tt.link, "lowerlayerdown")))
2311: +			events := drain(sink)
2312: +			if len(events) != 1 || events[0].Action != interfaceActionUpdate ||
2313: +				events[0].Interface.Name != tt.link ||
2314: +				events[0].Interface.OperState != "lower-layer-down" {
2315: +				t.Fatalf("carrier loss reported %+v", events)
2316: +			}
2317: +
2318: +			// the link interface disappears, then comes back
2319: +			withoutLink := podInterfaces(tt.link, "up")
2320: +			withoutLink = withoutLink[:len(withoutLink)-1]
2321: +			p.processSample(
2322: +				ctx,
2323: +				interfaceTestSample("r1", start.Add(3*time.Second), links, withoutLink),
2324: +			)
2325: +			events = drain(sink)
2326: +			if len(events) != 1 || events[0].Action != interfaceActionDelete ||
2327: +				events[0].Interface.Name != tt.link {
2328: +				t.Fatalf("removed link reported %+v", events)
2329: +			}
2330: +			p.processSample(ctx, interfaceTestSample("r1", start.Add(4*time.Second), links,
2331: +				podInterfaces(tt.link, "up")))
2332: +			events = drain(sink)
2333: +			if len(events) != 1 || events[0].Action != interfaceActionCreate ||
2334: +				events[0].Interface.Alias != tt.alias {
2335: +				t.Fatalf("new link reported %+v", events)
2336: +			}
2337: +
2338: +			// the node stops: its interfaces are deleted
2339: +			p.retireStoppedNodes(ctx, map[string]bool{})
2340: +			got = interfacesByName(drain(sink))
2341: +			if len(got) != 3 || got[tt.link].Action != interfaceActionDelete ||
2342: +				got["eth0"].Action != interfaceActionDelete || len(p.nodes) != 0 {
2343: +				t.Fatalf("stopped node reported %+v", got)
2344: +			}
2345: +		})
2346: +	}
2347: +}

2396: +// listingExec answers clabwire --list-interfaces with the listing of the pod and counts the
2397: +// listings.
2398: +type listingExec struct {
2399: +	mu       sync.Mutex
2400: +	listings map[string][]clabwireInterface
2401: +	calls    int
2402: +}
2403: +
2404: +func (l *listingExec) exec(
2405: +	_ context.Context,
2406: +	_, pod, container string,
2407: +	command []string,
2408: +	_ io.Reader,
2409: +	stdout, _ io.Writer,
2410: +) error {
2411: +	l.mu.Lock()
2412: +	defer l.mu.Unlock()
2413: +
2414: +	if container != clabwireContainer || !slices.Contains(command, "--list-interfaces") {
2415: +		return nil
2416: +	}
2417: +	l.calls++
2418: +
2419: +	return json.NewEncoder(stdout).Encode(l.listings[pod])
2420: +}

2466: +func TestContainerTransitionActions(t *testing.T) {

2468: +
2469: +	const (

2471: +		running = clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning

2473: +		healthy = clablabruntime.ContainerHealthHealthy
2474: +		start   = clablabruntime.ContainerHealthStarting

2477: +	tracked := func(state, health, pod string) *trackedContainer {
2478: +		return &trackedContainer{state: state, health: health, pod: pod}
2479: +	}
2480: +
2481: +	tests := []struct {
2482: +		name     string
2483: +		previous *trackedContainer
2484: +		next     *trackedContainer
2485: +		want     string
2486: +	}{
2487: +		{"new pending node", nil, tracked(created, "", ""), "create"},
2488: +		{
2489: +			"new running node", nil, tracked(running, start, "p1"),
2490: +			"create,start,health_status: starting",
2491: +		},
2492: +		{
2493: +			"new ready node", nil, tracked(running, healthy, "p1"),
2494: +			"create,start,health_status: healthy",
2495: +		},
2496: +		{"new stopped node", nil, tracked(exited, "", ""), "create,stop"},
2497: +		{
2498: +			"pod starts", tracked(created, "", "p1"), tracked(running, start, "p1"),
2499: +			"start,health_status: starting",
2500: +		},
2501: +		{
2502: +			"device ready", tracked(running, start, "p1"), tracked(running, healthy, "p1"),
2503: +			"health_status: healthy",
2504: +		},
2505: +		{"still booting", tracked(running, start, "p1"), tracked(running, start, "p1"), ""},
2506: +		{"no change", tracked(running, healthy, "p1"), tracked(running, healthy, "p1"), ""},
2507: +		{
2508: +			"device not ready again", tracked(running, healthy, "p1"), tracked(running, sick, "p1"),
2509: +			"health_status: unhealthy",
2510: +		},
2511: +		{"stop", tracked(running, healthy, "p1"), tracked(exited, "", ""), "kill,stop,die"},
2512: +		{
2513: +			"start", tracked(exited, "", ""), tracked(running, healthy, "p2"),
2514: +			"start,health_status: healthy",
2515: +		},
2516: +		{
2517: +			"restart, new pod pending", tracked(running, healthy, "p1"), tracked(created, "", "p2"),
2518: +			"kill,stop,die",
2519: +		},
2520: +		{
2521: +			"restart, new pod running", tracked(running, healthy, "p1"),
2522: +			tracked(running, start, "p2"), "kill,stop,die,start,health_status: starting",
2523: +		},
2524: +		{"stopped before it ran", tracked(created, "", "p1"), tracked(exited, "", ""), "stop"},
2525: +		{"stopped node rescheduled", tracked(exited, "", ""), tracked(created, "", "p2"), ""},
2526: +	}
2527: +	for _, tt := range tests {
2528: +		got := strings.Join(containerTransitionActions(tt.previous, tt.next), ",")
2529: +		if got != tt.want {
2530: +			t.Fatalf("%s: actions = %q, want %q", tt.name, got, tt.want)
2531: +		}
2532: +	}
2533: +
2534: +	if got := strings.Join(containerRemovalActions(tracked(running, healthy, "p1")), ","); got !=
2535: +		"kill,die,destroy" {
2536: +		t.Fatalf("removal of a running node = %q", got)
2537: +	}
2538: +	if got := strings.Join(
2539: +		containerRemovalActions(tracked(exited, "", "")),
2540: +		",",
2541: +	); got != "destroy" {
2542: +		t.Fatalf("removal of a stopped node = %q", got)
2543: +	}
2544: +
2545: +	// health: a running node that was healthy and is not ready anymore in the same pod is
2546: +	// unhealthy; in a new pod it starts again
2547: +	previous := tracked(running, healthy, "p1")
2548: +	if got := containerHealth(previous, tracked(running, "", "p1"), start); got != sick {
2549: +		t.Fatalf("health in the same pod = %q", got)
2550: +	}
2551: +	if got := containerHealth(previous, tracked(running, "", "p2"), start); got != start {
2552: +		t.Fatalf("health in a new pod = %q", got)
2553: +	}
2554: +}

2556: +// trackerTestNode is a Node of lab1 in lab-ns.
2557: +func trackerTestNode(
2558: +	name string,
2559: +	runState string,
2560: +	conditions ...map[string]any,
2561: +) *unstructured.Unstructured {
2562: +	status := map[string]any{
2563: +		"readiness":        "notready",
2564: +		"directContainers": []any{map[string]any{"name": "node-" + name, "id": name}},
2565: +	}
2566: +	rawConditions := []any{}
2567: +	for _, condition := range conditions {
2568: +		rawConditions = append(rawConditions, condition)
2569: +		if condition["type"] == "Ready" && condition["status"] == "True" {
2570: +			status["readiness"] = "ready"
2571: +		}
2572: +	}
2573: +	status["conditions"] = rawConditions
2574: +
2575: +	return &unstructured.Unstructured{Object: map[string]any{
2576: +		"apiVersion": c9sAPIVersion,
2577: +		"kind":       "Node",
2578: +		"metadata": map[string]any{
2579: +			"name": name, "namespace": "lab-ns", "uid": "uid-" + name,
2580: +			"labels": map[string]any{
2581: +				labelTopologyOwner: "lab1", labelOriginalNodeName: strings.ToUpper(name),
2582: +			},
2583: +		},
2584: +		"spec":   map[string]any{"kind": "linux", "image": "alpine", "runState": runState},
2585: +		"status": status,
2586: +	}}
2587: +}
2588: +
2589: +func condition(conditionType, status string) map[string]any {
2590: +	return map[string]any{"type": conditionType, "status": status}
2591: +}
2592: +
2593: +func trackerTestPod(name string, phase corev1.PodPhase) *corev1.Pod {
2594: +	pod := captureTestPod(name, "r1")
2595: +	pod.Status.Phase = phase
2596: +
2597: +	return pod
2598: +}

2600: +type trackerHarness struct {
2601: +	t       *testing.T
2602: +	r       *Runtime
2603: +	tracker *containerTracker
2604: +	sink    chan clablabruntime.Event
2605: +}

2607: +func newTrackerHarness(
2608: +	t *testing.T,
2609: +	node *unstructured.Unstructured,
2610: +	pods ...*corev1.Pod,
2611: +) *trackerHarness {
2612: +	t.Helper()
2613: +
2614: +	kubeObjects := make([]k8sruntime.Object, 0, len(pods))
2615: +	for _, pod := range pods {
2616: +		kubeObjects = append(kubeObjects, pod)
2617: +	}
2618: +	r := newTestRuntimeWithKubeObjects([]*unstructured.Unstructured{node}, kubeObjects)
2619: +	r.labNamespaceOverride = "lab-ns"
2620: +	sink := make(chan clablabruntime.Event, 64)
2621: +
2622: +	return &trackerHarness{
2623: +		t: t, r: r, sink: sink,
2624: +		tracker: &containerTracker{r: r, sink: sink, nodes: map[string]*trackedContainer{}},
2625: +	}
2626: +}

2628: +func (h *trackerHarness) seed(snapshot bool) {
2629: +	h.t.Helper()
2630: +
2631: +	state, err := h.r.Inspect(context.Background(), clablabruntime.InspectRequest{Name: "lab1"})
2632: +	if err != nil {
2633: +		h.t.Fatal(err)
2634: +	}
2635: +	h.tracker.observeLab(context.Background(), labRef{namespace: "lab-ns", lab: "lab1"}, state,
2636: +		&observeSeed{snapshot: snapshot})
2637: +}

2666: +// refresh reads lab1 again and returns the reported actions with their state attribute.
2667: +func (h *trackerHarness) refresh() string {
2668: +	h.t.Helper()
2669: +
2670: +	if !h.tracker.refresh(context.Background(), labRef{namespace: "lab-ns", lab: "lab1"}) {
2671: +		h.t.Fatal("refresh failed")
2672: +	}
2673: +
2674: +	var actions []string
2675: +	for _, ev := range drain(h.sink) {
2676: +		if ev.Type != clablabruntime.EventTypeContainer || ev.ActorID != "lab-ns/lab1/r1" ||
2677: +			ev.ActorFullID != "lab-ns/lab1/r1" || ev.ActorName != "lab1-r1" ||
2678: +			ev.Lab == nil || ev.Node == nil || ev.Node.TopologyName != "R1" ||
2679: +			ev.Attributes["lab"] != "lab1" || ev.Attributes["node"] != "r1" ||
2680: +			ev.Attributes["namespace"] != "lab-ns" {
2681: +			h.t.Fatalf("container event = %+v", ev)
2682: +		}
2683: +		action := ev.Action + "=" + ev.Attributes["state"]
2684: +		if signal := ev.Attributes["signal"]; signal != "" {
2685: +			action += "/" + signal
2686: +		}
2687: +		actions = append(actions, action)
2688: +	}
2689: +
2690: +	return strings.Join(actions, ",")
2691: +}

2693: +// TestContainerTrackerReportsTheNodeLifecycle drives one node through boot, readiness, stop,
2694: +// start, restart and removal on the fake cluster and checks the Docker container events.
2695: +func TestContainerTrackerReportsTheNodeLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
2696: +	t.Parallel()
2697: +
2698: +	node := trackerTestNode("r1", nodeRunStateRunning)
2699: +	h := newTrackerHarness(t, node, trackerTestPod("lab1-r1-a", corev1.PodPending))
2700: +	h.seed(true)
2701: +	snapshot := drain(h.sink)
2702: +	if len(snapshot) != 1 || snapshot[0].Action != "created" ||
2703: +		snapshot[0].Attributes["origin"] != clablabruntime.EventOriginSnapshot ||
2704: +		snapshot[0].Attributes["state"] != "created" {
2705: +		t.Fatalf("snapshot = %+v", snapshot)
2706: +	}
2707: +
2708: +	// the pod runs, the device boots
2709: +	h.deletePod("lab1-r1-a")
2710: +	h.addPod(trackerTestPod("lab1-r1-a", corev1.PodRunning))
2711: +	if got := h.refresh(); got != "start=running,health_status: starting=running" {
2712: +		t.Fatalf("pod running: %s", got)
2713: +	}
2714: +
2715: +	// the device is ready
2716: +	h.setNode(trackerTestNode("r1", nodeRunStateRunning,
2717: +		condition("Ready", "True"), condition(nodeConditionContainersReady, "True")))
2718: +	if got := h.refresh(); got != "health_status: healthy=running" {
2719: +		t.Fatalf("ready: %s", got)
2720: +	}
2721: +	if got := h.refresh(); got != "" {
2722: +		t.Fatalf("unchanged: %s", got)
2723: +	}
2724: +
2725: +	// stop: the Node is stopped and its pod goes
2726: +	h.setNode(trackerTestNode("r1", nodeRunStateStopped,
2727: +		condition(nodeConditionStopped, "True")))
2728: +	h.deletePod("lab1-r1-a")
2729: +	if got := h.refresh(); got != "kill=running/15,stop=exited,die=exited" {
2730: +		t.Fatalf("stop: %s", got)
2731: +	}
2732: +
2733: +	// start: a new pod
2734: +	h.setNode(trackerTestNode("r1", nodeRunStateRunning))
2735: +	h.addPod(trackerTestPod("lab1-r1-b", corev1.PodPending))
2736: +	if got := h.refresh(); got != "" {
2737: +		t.Fatalf("start requested: %s", got)
2738: +	}
2739: +	h.deletePod("lab1-r1-b")
2740: +	h.addPod(trackerTestPod("lab1-r1-b", corev1.PodRunning))
2741: +	h.setNode(
2742: +		trackerTestNode("r1", nodeRunStateRunning, condition(nodeConditionContainersReady, "True")),
2743: +	)
2744: +	if got := h.refresh(); got != "start=running,health_status: healthy=running" {
2745: +		t.Fatalf("started: %s", got)
2746: +	}
2747: +
2748: +	// restart: the pod is replaced
2749: +	h.deletePod("lab1-r1-b")
2750: +	h.addPod(trackerTestPod("lab1-r1-c", corev1.PodRunning))
2751: +	if got := h.refresh(); got !=
2752: +		"kill=running/15,stop=exited,die=exited,start=running,health_status: healthy=running" {
2753: +		t.Fatalf("restart: %s", got)
2754: +	}
2755: +
2756: +	// destroy
2757: +	if err := h.r.client.Resource(nodeGVR).Namespace("lab-ns").
2758: +		Delete(context.Background(), "r1", metav1.DeleteOptions{}); err != nil {
2759: +		t.Fatal(err)
2760: +	}
2761: +	if got := h.refresh(); got != "kill=running/15,die=exited,destroy=exited" {
2762: +		t.Fatalf("destroy: %s", got)
2763: +	}
2764: +	if len(h.tracker.nodes) != 0 {
2765: +		t.Fatalf("destroyed node still tracked: %+v", h.tracker.nodes)
2766: +	}
2767: +}

2769: +func TestContainerTrackerSeedsWithoutSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
2770: +	t.Parallel()
2771: +
2772: +	h := newTrackerHarness(t, trackerTestNode("r1", nodeRunStateRunning,
2773: +		condition("Ready", "True")), trackerTestPod("lab1-r1-a", corev1.PodRunning))
2774: +	h.seed(false)

2780: +	}
2781: +}

2783: +func TestNodeContainerState(t *testing.T) {
2784: +	t.Parallel()
2785: +
2786: +	deleting := metav1.NewTime(time.Now())
2787: +	pod := func(phase corev1.PodPhase, deleted bool) *corev1.Pod {
2788: +		p := &corev1.Pod{Status: corev1.PodStatus{Phase: phase}}
2789: +		if deleted {
2790: +			p.DeletionTimestamp = &deleting
2791: +		}
2792: +
2793: +		return p
2794: +	}
2795: +
2796: +	tests := []struct {
2797: +		name          string
2798: +		stopRequested bool
2799: +		pod           *corev1.Pod
2800: +		want          string
2801: +	}{
2802: +		{"no pod yet", false, nil, "created"},
2803: +		{"pod scheduled, init containers", false, pod(corev1.PodPending, false), "created"},
2804: +		{"device containers run", false, pod(corev1.PodRunning, false), "running"},
2805: +		{"pod being deleted (restart)", false, pod(corev1.PodRunning, true), "exited"},
2806: +		{"pod ended", false, pod(corev1.PodFailed, false), "exited"},
2807: +		{"stop requested, pod terminating", true, pod(corev1.PodRunning, true), "exited"},
2808: +		{"stopped", true, nil, "exited"},
2809: +	}
2810: +	for _, tt := range tests {
2811: +		if got := nodeContainerState(tt.stopRequested, tt.pod); got != tt.want {
2812: +			t.Fatalf("%s: %q, want %q", tt.name, got, tt.want)
2813: +		}
2814: +	}
2815: +}
2816: +
2817: +func TestNewestPodPrefersAPodThatIsNotDeleted(t *testing.T) {
2818: +	t.Parallel()
2819: +
2820: +	now := time.Now()
2821: +	deleting := metav1.NewTime(now)
2822: +	old := &corev1.Pod{
2823: +		ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{
2824: +			Name: "old", CreationTimestamp: metav1.NewTime(now.Add(-time.Hour)),
2825: +			DeletionTimestamp: &deleting,
2826: +		},
2827: +		Status: corev1.PodStatus{Phase: corev1.PodRunning},
2828: +	}
2829: +	replacement := &corev1.Pod{
2830: +		ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "new", CreationTimestamp: metav1.NewTime(now)},
2831: +		Status:     corev1.PodStatus{Phase: corev1.PodPending},
2832: +	}
2833: +	if got := newestPod(old, replacement); got != replacement {
2834: +		t.Fatalf("newestPod = %s, want the replacement", got.Name)
2835: +	}
2836: +	if got := newestPod(replacement, old); got != replacement {
2837: +		t.Fatalf("newestPod = %s, want the replacement", got.Name)
2838: +	}
2839: +}

2841: +func TestEnrichStateReportsContainerStateAndHealth(t *testing.T) {
2842: +	t.Parallel()
2843: +
2844: +	r := newTestRuntimeWithKubeObjects(
2845: +		[]*unstructured.Unstructured{
2846: +			trackerTestNode("r1", nodeRunStateRunning, condition("Ready", "True")),
2847: +			// its peer is stopped: not ready, but the device is
2848: +			trackerTestNode("r2", nodeRunStateRunning,
2849: +				condition(nodeConditionContainersReady, "True")),
2850: +			trackerTestNode("r3", nodeRunStateRunning),
2851: +			trackerTestNode("r4", nodeRunStateStopped, condition(nodeConditionStopped, "True")),
2852: +		},
2853: +		[]k8sruntime.Object{
2854: +			captureTestPod("lab1-r1-a", "r1"),
2855: +			captureTestPod("lab1-r2-a", "r2"),
2856: +			withNodeUID(captureTestPod("lab1-r3-a", "r3"), "uid-r3"),
2857: +			// the newer pod of an earlier Node r3 that still terminates is not r3's pod
2858: +			withNodeUID(withCreation(captureTestPod("lab1-r3-stale", "r3"), time.Hour), "uid-old"),
2859: +		},
2860: +	)
2861: +
2862: +	state := &clablabruntime.LabState{Name: "lab1", Namespace: "lab-ns"}
2863: +	if err := r.enrichState(context.Background(), state); err != nil {
2864: +		t.Fatal(err)
2865: +	}
2866: +
2867: +	want := map[string]string{
2868: +		"r1": "running/healthy", "r2": "running/healthy", "r3": "running/starting", "r4": "exited/",
2869: +	}
2870: +	for _, node := range state.Nodes {
2871: +		if node.Name == "r3" && node.Pod != "lab1-r3-a" {
2872: +			t.Fatalf("r3 pod = %q, want its own Node's pod", node.Pod)
2873: +		}
2874: +		if got := node.ContainerState + "/" + node.Health; got != want[node.Name] {
2875: +			t.Fatalf("%s = %s, want %s", node.Name, got, want[node.Name])
2876: +		}
2877: +		if node.TopologyName != strings.ToUpper(node.Name) {
2878: +			t.Fatalf("%s topology name = %q", node.Name, node.TopologyName)
2879: +		}
2880: +	}
2881: +}

2889: +    node2:

2896: +func sourceDeployRequest(path string, noTopologyCR bool) clablabruntime.DeployRequest {
2897: +	return clablabruntime.DeployRequest{
2898: +		Name:               "lab1",
2899: +		Namespace:          "lab-ns",
2900: +		TopologyFile:       path,

2906: +// TestDeployRecordsTheTopologyFile checks where a deploy records the topology file and that
2907: +// inspect reports it, with and without a Topology resource.
2908: +func TestDeployRecordsTheTopologyFile(t *testing.T) {
2909: +	t.Parallel()
2910: +
2911: +	// with a Topology resource: on the Topology, updated by every deploy
2912: +	r := newTestRuntime()
2913: +	if _, err := r.Deploy(context.Background(),
2914: +		sourceDeployRequest("/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml", false)); err != nil {
2915: +		t.Fatal(err)
2916: +	}
2917: +	topology := getTestTopology(t, r, "lab-ns", "lab1")
2918: +	if got := topology.GetAnnotations()[annotationTopologyFile]; got != "/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml" {
2919: +		t.Fatalf("Topology annotation = %q", got)
2920: +	}
2921: +	state, err := r.Inspect(context.Background(),
2922: +		clablabruntime.InspectRequest{Name: "lab1", Namespace: "lab-ns"})
2923: +	if err != nil {
2924: +		t.Fatal(err)
2925: +	}
2926: +	if state.TopologyPath != "/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml" {
2927: +		t.Fatalf("TopologyPath = %q", state.TopologyPath)
2928: +	}
2929: +
2930: +	if _, err := r.Deploy(context.Background(),
2931: +		sourceDeployRequest("/srv/labs/lab1.clab.yml", false)); err != nil {
2932: +		t.Fatal(err)
2933: +	}
2934: +	topology = getTestTopology(t, r, "lab-ns", "lab1")
2935: +	if got := topology.GetAnnotations()[annotationTopologyFile]; got != "/srv/labs/lab1.clab.yml" {
2936: +		t.Fatalf("Topology annotation after a deploy from another file = %q", got)
2937: +	}
2938: +
2939: +	// without a Topology resource: on the Nodes only, kept from their creation
2940: +	r = newTestRuntime()
2941: +	if _, err := r.Deploy(context.Background(),
2942: +		sourceDeployRequest("/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml", true)); err != nil {
2943: +		t.Fatal(err)
2944: +	}
2945: +	assertPrimitiveTopologyFile(t, r, "/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml")
2946: +	state, err = r.Inspect(context.Background(),
2947: +		clablabruntime.InspectRequest{Name: "lab1", Namespace: "lab-ns"})
2948: +	if err != nil {
2949: +		t.Fatal(err)
2950: +	}
2951: +	if state.TopologyPath != "/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml" {
2952: +		t.Fatalf("TopologyPath without a Topology = %q", state.TopologyPath)
2953: +	}
2954: +
2955: +	plan, err := r.Plan(context.Background(),
2956: +		sourceDeployRequest("/srv/labs/lab1.clab.yml", true))
2957: +	if err != nil {
2958: +		t.Fatal(err)
2959: +	}
2960: +	for _, change := range plan.Changes {
2961: +		if change.Kind == "Node" {
2962: +			t.Fatalf("a deploy from another file would change %+v and replace its pod", change)
2963: +		}
2964: +	}
2965: +	if _, err := r.Deploy(context.Background(),
2966: +		sourceDeployRequest("/srv/labs/lab1.clab.yml", true)); err != nil {
2967: +		t.Fatal(err)
2968: +	}
2969: +	assertPrimitiveTopologyFile(t, r, "/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml")
2970: +}

2972: +func assertPrimitiveTopologyFile(t *testing.T, r *Runtime, want string) {
2973: +	t.Helper()
2974: +
2975: +	for _, gvr := range []struct {
2976: +		name string
2977: +		want string

3675: +// sampledInterfaceNames lists the interface names a sample saw, sorted and comma-joined.
3676: +func sampledInterfaceNames(sample interfaceSample) string {
3677: +	names := make([]string, 0, len(sample.stats)+len(sample.ifaces))
3678: +	seen := map[string]bool{}
3679: +	for _, iface := range sample.ifaces {
3680: +		if !seen[iface.Name] {
3681: +			seen[iface.Name] = true
3682: +			names = append(names, iface.Name)
3683: +		}
3684: +	}
3685: +	for _, stat := range sample.stats {
3686: +		if !seen[stat.Name] {
3687: +			seen[stat.Name] = true
3688: +			names = append(names, stat.Name)
3689: +		}
3690: +	}
3691: +	sort.Strings(names)
3692: +
3693: +	return strings.Join(names, ",")
3694: +}

3696: +// nodeLinks returns the lab link interfaces of a node from its pod's clabwire listing. A pod is
3697: +// listed once, and again when its interfaces change (a pod gets its link interfaces as clabwire
3698: +// wires them).
3699: +func (p *interfacePoller) nodeLinks(
3700: +	ctx context.Context,
3701: +	target interfaceSampleTarget,
3702: +	names string,
3703: +) ([]clabwireInterface, error) {
3704: +	key := target.pod.Namespace + "/" + target.pod.Name
3705: +
3706: +	p.listingsMu.Lock()
3707: +	listing := p.listings[key]
3708: +	p.listingsMu.Unlock()
3709: +
3710: +	if listing == nil || listing.names != names {
3711: +		entries, err := p.r.listPodInterfaces(ctx, target.pod.Namespace, target.pod.Name)
3712: +		if err != nil {
3713: +			return nil, err
3714: +		}
3715: +
3716: +		listing = &podInterfaceListing{
3717: +			names:  names,
3718: +			byNode: map[string][]clabwireInterface{},
3719: +		}
3720: +		for _, entry := range entries {
3721: +			listing.byNode[entry.Node] = append(listing.byNode[entry.Node], entry)
3722: +		}
3723: +
3724: +		p.listingsMu.Lock()
3725: +		p.listings[key] = listing
3726: +		p.listingsMu.Unlock()
3727: +	}
3728: +
3729: +	return listing.byNode[target.node.Name], nil
3730: +}

3732:  // commandNotExecutable reports an exec that failed because the command does not exist in the
3733:  // container.
3734:  func commandNotExecutable(rc int, err error) bool {
3735:  	if rc == exitCommandNotExecutable || rc == exitCommandNotFound {
3736:  		return true
3737:  	}
3738:  
3739:  	return err != nil && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "executable file not found")
3740:  }

3742: +// reportedInterfaces are the interfaces reported for a node, by name, with the alias the
3743: +// topology gave them: its lab link interfaces, the management interface and loopback.
3744: +func reportedInterfaces(links []clabwireInterface) map[string]string {
3745: +	reported := map[string]string{
3746: +		loopbackInterface:   "",
3747: +		managementInterface: "",
3748: +	}
3749: +	for _, link := range links {
3750: +		reported[link.Interface] = link.Alias
3751: +	}
3752: +
3753: +	return reported
3754: +}
3755: +
3756: +// interfaceEventData describes an interface the way the local runtimes' netlink events do: the
3757: +// alias is the topology's name for the interface (an alias clabernetes set for its own use is
3758: +// not reported), the operational state uses netlink's names, lab link and management
3759: +// interfaces are veth pairs, loopback a device, and loopback has no hardware address.
3760: +func interfaceEventData(iface c9sIfaceState, alias string) clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData {
3761: +	if alias == "" && !strings.HasPrefix(iface.Alias, clabernetesAliasPrefix) {
3762: +		alias = iface.Alias
3763: +	}
3764: +
3765: +	mac := iface.MAC
3766: +	if mac == zeroMAC {
3767: +		mac = ""
3768: +	}
3769: +
3770: +	linkType := interfaceTypeVeth
3771: +	if iface.Name == loopbackInterface {
3772: +		linkType = interfaceTypeDevice
3773: +	}
3774: +
3775: +	return clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
3776: +		Name:      iface.Name,
3777: +		Alias:     alias,
3778: +		Index:     iface.Index,
3779: +		MTU:       iface.MTU,
3780: +		MAC:       mac,
3781: +		OperState: netlinkOperState(iface.OperState),
3782: +		Type:      linkType,
3783: +	}
3784: +}
3785: +
3786: +// netlinkOperState names an operational state from sysfs (RFC 2863, as in
3787: +// /sys/class/net/<if>/operstate) the way netlink, and so the local runtimes' events, name it.
3788: +func netlinkOperState(operState string) string {
3789: +	switch operState {
3790: +	case "notpresent":
3791: +		return "not-present"
3792: +	case "lowerlayerdown":
3793: +		return "lower-layer-down"
3794: +	case "":
3795: +		return "unknown"
3796: +	default:
3797: +		return operState
3798: +	}
3799: +}

154: // labRuntimeEventStreamRequest scopes a lab runtime event stream. A selected lab (--topo or
155: // --name) limits the stream to that lab in its namespace. Without one the stream covers every
156: // namespace, unless a namespace override (--namespace, CLAB_KUBE_NAMESPACE) limits it to that
157: // namespace; the runtime applies the override.
158: func labRuntimeEventStreamRequest(
159: 	labName string,
160: 	identity clablabruntime.Identity,
161: 	opts Options,
162: ) clablabruntime.EventStreamRequest {
163: 	return clablabruntime.EventStreamRequest{
164: 		Name:                  labName,
165: 		Identity:              identity,
166: 		AllNamespaces:         labName == "",
167: 		IncludeInitialState:   opts.IncludeInitialState,
168: 		IncludeInterfaceStats: opts.IncludeInterfaceStats,
169: 		StatsInterval:         opts.StatsInterval,
170: 	}
171: }

173: // aggregatedEventFromLabRuntimeEvent reports a lab runtime event with the attributes the
174: // container runtimes' events have. A container event describes its node with the container
175: // record inspect reports for it, the way a Docker event carries the container's labels: as a
176: // snapshot like the snapshots of local containers, otherwise with the labels, image,
177: // management addresses and ports a Docker event and its enrichment carry. An interface event
178: // carries the attributes of the netlink interface events. The runtime's own attributes come on
179: // top.
180: func aggregatedEventFromLabRuntimeEvent(
181: 	clab *clabcore.CLab,
182: 	ev clablabruntime.Event,
183: ) aggregatedEvent {
184: 	ts := ev.Timestamp
185: 	if ts.IsZero() {
186: 		ts = time.Now()
187: 	}
188: 
189: 	var attributes map[string]string
190: 	switch {
191: 	case ev.Type == clablabruntime.EventTypeContainer && ev.Lab != nil && ev.Node != nil &&
192: 		clab != nil:
193: 		container := clab.LabRuntimeContainer(ev.Lab, *ev.Node)
194: 		if ev.Attributes["origin"] == clablabruntime.EventOriginSnapshot {
195: 			attributes = aggregatedEventFromContainerSnapshot(&container).Attributes
196: 		} else {
197: 			attributes = containerAttributes(&container)
198: 		}
199: 	case ev.Type == clablabruntime.EventTypeInterface && ev.Interface != nil:
200: 		lab := ev.Attributes["lab"]
201: 		if ev.Lab != nil {
202: 			lab = ev.Lab.Name
203: 		}
204: 		attributes = labRuntimeInterfaceAttributes(lab, ev.ActorName, ev.Interface)
205: 	}
206: 
207: 	for key, value := range ev.Attributes {
208: 		if attributes == nil {
209: 			attributes = make(map[string]string, len(ev.Attributes))
210: 		}
211: 		attributes[key] = value
212: 	}
213: 
214: 	return aggregatedEvent{
215: 		Timestamp:   ts,
216: 		Type:        ev.Type,
217: 		Action:      ev.Action,
218: 		ActorID:     ev.ActorID,
219: 		ActorName:   ev.ActorName,
220: 		ActorFullID: ev.ActorFullID,
221: 		Attributes:  attributes,
222: 	}
223: }

253: func forwardRuntimeEvents(
254: 	ctx context.Context,
255: 	runtime clabruntime.ContainerRuntime,
256: 	registry *netlinkRegistry,
257: 	runtimeEvents <-chan clabruntime.ContainerEvent,
258: 	runtimeErrs <-chan error,
259: 	eventSink chan<- aggregatedEvent,
260: 	errSink chan<- error,
261: ) {
262: 	defer close(errSink)
263: 
264: 	sendErr := func(err error) {
265: 		select {
266: 		case errSink <- err:
267: 		case <-ctx.Done():
268: 		}
269: 	}
270: 
271: 	for {
272: 		select {
273: 		case <-ctx.Done():
274: 			return
275: 		case err, ok := <-runtimeErrs:
276: 			if !ok {
277: 				return
278: 			}
279: 
280: 			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
281: 				sendErr(err)
282: 
283: 				return
284: 			}
285: 		case ev, ok := <-runtimeEvents:
286: 			if !ok {
287: 				return
288: 			}
289: 
290: 			registry.HandleContainerEvent(runtime, ev)
291: 
292: 			aggregated := aggregatedEventFromContainerEvent(ctx, runtime, ev)
293: 			select {
294: 			case eventSink <- aggregated:
295: 			case <-ctx.Done():
296: 				return
297: 			}
298: 		}
299: 	}
300: }

566: func exposedPortsAttributeValue(ports []*clabtypes.GenericPortBinding) string {
567: 	if len(ports) == 0 {
568: 		return ""
569: 	}
570: 
571: 	sortedPorts := make([]*clabtypes.GenericPortBinding, 0, len(ports))
572: 	for idx := range ports {
573: 		if ports[idx] != nil {
574: 			sortedPorts = append(sortedPorts, ports[idx])
575: 		}
576: 	}
577: 
578: 	if len(sortedPorts) == 0 {
579: 		return ""
580: 	}
581: 
582: 	sort.Slice(sortedPorts, func(i, j int) bool {
583: 		left := sortedPorts[i]
584: 		right := sortedPorts[j]
585: 
586: 		switch {
587: 		case left.ContainerPort != right.ContainerPort:
588: 			return left.ContainerPort < right.ContainerPort
589: 		case left.Protocol != right.Protocol:
590: 			return left.Protocol < right.Protocol
591: 		case left.HostPort != right.HostPort:
592: 			return left.HostPort < right.HostPort
593: 		default:
594: 			return left.HostIP < right.HostIP
595: 		}
596: 	})
597: 
598: 	result := make([]string, 0, len(sortedPorts))
599: 	for idx := range sortedPorts {
600: 		formatted := formatExposedPort(sortedPorts[idx])
601: 		if formatted != "" {
602: 			result = append(result, formatted)
603: 		}
604: 	}
605: 
606: 	if len(result) == 0 {
607: 		return ""
608: 	}
609: 
610: 	return strings.Join(result, ";")
611: }

613: func formatExposedPort(port *clabtypes.GenericPortBinding) string {
614: 	if port == nil {
615: 		return ""
616: 	}
617: 
618: 	proto := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(port.Protocol))
619: 	protoSuffix := ""
620: 	if proto != "" {
621: 		protoSuffix = "/" + proto
622: 	}
623: 
624: 	if port.HostPort > 0 {
625: 		hostIP := port.HostIP
626: 		if hostIP == "" {
627: 			hostIP = "0.0.0.0"
628: 		}
629: 
630: 		if strings.Contains(hostIP, ":") {
631: 			hostIP = fmt.Sprintf("[%s]", hostIP)
632: 		}
633: 
634: 		if port.ContainerPort > 0 {
635: 			return fmt.Sprintf(
636: 				"%s:%d%s->%d",
637: 				hostIP,
638: 				port.HostPort,
639: 				protoSuffix,
640: 				port.ContainerPort,
641: 			)
642: 		}
643: 
644: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d%s", hostIP, port.HostPort, protoSuffix)
645: 	}
646: 
647: 	if port.ContainerPort <= 0 {
648: 		return ""
649: 	}
650: 
651: 	return fmt.Sprintf("%d%s", port.ContainerPort, protoSuffix)
652: }

22: 	// interfaceSampleScript reads the interface counters and, per interface, the sysfs

24: 	// name, ifindex, mtu, address, operstate, flags and ifalias, tab separated.
25: 	interfaceSampleScript = `cat /proc/net/dev; echo ` + interfaceSysfsMarker + `; ` +
26: 		`for d in /sys/class/net/*; do [ -e "$d/operstate" ] || continue; ` +
27: 		`printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "${d##*/}" "$(cat "$d/ifindex")" ` +
28: 		`"$(cat "$d/mtu")" "$(cat "$d/address")" "$(cat "$d/operstate")" ` +
