108: 	ifaces    []c9sIfaceState
109: 	hasStates bool
110: 	// links are the node's lab link interfaces as clabwire lists them.
111: 	links     []clabwireInterface
112: 	timestamp time.Time
113: 	err       error
114: }
115: 
116: // podInterfaceListing is the clabwire interface listing of a pod, per node. It is listed again
117: // when the pod's interfaces change.
118: type podInterfaceListing struct {
119: 	names  string
120: 	byNode map[string][]clabwireInterface
121: }
122: 
123: // interfacePoller samples the interfaces of every running node in an event scope and turns the
124: // samples into interface events. It reports the interfaces a container of the local runtimes
125: // has for the same node: the node's lab link interfaces, with the names and aliases clabwire
126: // lists for them, the management interface and loopback. The pod's own interfaces (the pod
127: // network, clabernetes' interposition and link transport interfaces) are not reported.
128: type interfacePoller struct {
129: 	r     *Runtime
130: 	scope eventScope
131: 	opts  interfacePollOptions
132: 	sink  chan<- clablabruntime.Event
133: 
134: 	statsSamples map[string]c9sIfaceStatsSample
135: 	nodes        map[string]*trackedNode
136: 
137: 	noShellMu sync.Mutex
138: 	// noShell holds the pods whose device container has no shell; they are sampled with a
139: 	// plain cat of /proc/net/dev and report statistics without interface state.
140: 	noShell map[string]bool
141: 
142: 	listingsMu sync.Mutex
143: 	// listings holds the clabwire interface listing per pod (namespace/pod).
144: 	listings map[string]*podInterfaceListing
145: 
146: 	firstRound bool
147: }
148: 
149: func (r *Runtime) pollInterfaces(
150: 	ctx context.Context,
151: 	scope eventScope,
152: 	opts interfacePollOptions,
153: 	eventSink chan<- clablabruntime.Event,
154: ) {
155: 	if opts.interval <= 0 {
156: 		opts.interval = time.Second
157: 	}
158: 
159: 	poller := newInterfacePoller(r, scope, opts, eventSink)
160: 	poller.round(ctx)
161: 
162: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(opts.interval)
163: 	defer ticker.Stop()
164: 
165: 	for {
166: 		select {
167: 		case <-ctx.Done():
168: 			return
169: 		case <-ticker.C:
170: 			poller.round(ctx)
171: 		}
172: 	}
173: }
174: 
175: func newInterfacePoller(
176: 	r *Runtime,
177: 	scope eventScope,
178: 	opts interfacePollOptions,
179: 	eventSink chan<- clablabruntime.Event,
180: ) *interfacePoller {
181: 	return &interfacePoller{
182: 		r:            r,
183: 		scope:        scope,
184: 		opts:         opts,
185: 		sink:         eventSink,
186: 		statsSamples: map[string]c9sIfaceStatsSample{},
187: 		nodes:        map[string]*trackedNode{},
188: 		noShell:      map[string]bool{},
189: 		listings:     map[string]*podInterfaceListing{},
190: 		firstRound:   true,
191: 	}
192: }
193: 
194: func (p *interfacePoller) round(ctx context.Context) {
195: 	defer func() { p.firstRound = false }()
196: 
197: 	states, err := p.r.labStates(ctx, p.scope)
198: 	if err != nil {
199: 		log.Debug("failed to list C9s labs for interface events", "error", err)
200: 		return
201: 	}
202: 
203: 	running := map[string]bool{}
204: 	pods := map[string]bool{}
205: 	var targets []interfaceSampleTarget
206: 	for _, state := range states {
207: 		for _, node := range state.Nodes {
208: 			if node.ContainerState != clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning || node.Pod == "" ||
209: 				node.Container == "" {
210: 				continue
211: 			}
212: 
213: 			running[c9sNodeKey(state.Namespace, state.Name, node.Name)] = true
214: 			pods[state.Namespace+"/"+node.Pod] = true
215: 			targets = append(targets, interfaceSampleTarget{
216: 				state: state,
217: 				node:  node,
218: 				pod: &corev1.Pod{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{
219: 					Name:      node.Pod,
220: 					Namespace: state.Namespace,
221: 				}},
222: 			})
223: 		}
224: 	}
225: 
226: 	for _, sample := range p.sampleAll(ctx, targets) {
227: 		if ctx.Err() != nil {
228: 			return
229: 		}
230: 		if sample.err != nil {
231: 			log.Debug("failed to sample C9s interfaces",
232: 				"namespace", sample.target.state.Namespace,
233: 				"lab", sample.target.state.Name,
234: 				"node", sample.target.node.Name,
235: 				"error", sample.err,
236: 			)
237: 
238: 			continue
239: 		}
240: 
241: 		p.processSample(ctx, sample)
242: 	}
243: 
244: 	p.retireStoppedNodes(ctx, running)
245: 	p.forgetListings(pods)
246: }
247: 
248: // retireStoppedNodes reports the interfaces of nodes that stopped running, or were removed, as
249: // deleted: they are gone with the node's pod.
250: func (p *interfacePoller) retireStoppedNodes(ctx context.Context, running map[string]bool) {
251: 	for key, tracked := range p.nodes {
252: 		if running[key] {
253: 			continue
254: 		}
255: 
256: 		for _, name := range sortedInterfaceNames(tracked.ifaces) {
257: 			p.emit(ctx, tracked, interfaceActionDelete, tracked.ifaces[name], time.Now())
258: 			p.forgetStats(tracked, name)
259: 		}
260: 		delete(p.nodes, key)
261: 	}
262: }
263: 
264: // forgetListings drops the interface listings of pods that are gone.
265: func (p *interfacePoller) forgetListings(pods map[string]bool) {
266: 	p.listingsMu.Lock()
267: 	defer p.listingsMu.Unlock()
268: 
269: 	for key := range p.listings {
270: 		if !pods[key] {
271: 			delete(p.listings, key)
272: 		}
273: 	}
274: }
275: 
276: func (p *interfacePoller) sampleAll(
277: 	ctx context.Context,
278: 	targets []interfaceSampleTarget,
279: ) []interfaceSample {
280: 	samples := make([]interfaceSample, len(targets))
281: 
282: 	var wg sync.WaitGroup
283: 	sem := make(chan struct{}, interfaceSampleWorkers)
284: 	for idx := range targets {
285: 		wg.Add(1)
286: 		sem <- struct{}{}
287: 		go func(idx int) {
288: 			defer wg.Done()
289: 			defer func() { <-sem }()
290: 
291: 			samples[idx] = p.sample(ctx, targets[idx])
292: 		}(idx)
293: 	}
294: 	wg.Wait()
295: 
296: 	return samples
297: }
298: 
299: func (p *interfacePoller) sample(
300: 	ctx context.Context,
301: 	target interfaceSampleTarget,
302: ) interfaceSample {
303: 	sample := interfaceSample{target: target}
304: 	podName := target.pod.Name
305: 
306: 	p.noShellMu.Lock()
307: 	noShell := p.noShell[podName]
308: 	p.noShellMu.Unlock()
309: 
310: 	command := []string{"sh", "-c", interfaceSampleScript}
311: 	if noShell {
312: 		command = []string{"cat", "/proc/net/dev"}
313: 	}
314: 
315: 	stdout, stderr, rc, err := p.r.execInPod(ctx, target.pod, target.node.Container, command)
316: 	if !noShell && commandNotExecutable(rc, err) {
317: 		p.noShellMu.Lock()
318: 		p.noShell[podName] = true
319: 		p.noShellMu.Unlock()
320: 
321: 		log.Debug("C9s device container has no shell; reporting interface statistics only",
322: 			"namespace", target.state.Namespace,
323: 			"lab", target.state.Name,
324: 			"node", target.node.Name,
325: 		)
326: 
327: 		stdout, stderr, rc, err = p.r.execInPod(ctx, target.pod, target.node.Container,
328: 			[]string{"cat", "/proc/net/dev"})
329: 	}
330: 
331: 	sample.timestamp = time.Now()
332: 	switch {
333: 	case err != nil:
334: 		sample.err = err
335: 	case rc != 0:
336: 		sample.err = fmt.Errorf("exit code %d: %s", rc, strings.TrimSpace(string(stderr)))
337: 	default:
338: 		sample.stats, sample.ifaces, sample.hasStates, sample.err = parseInterfaceSample(stdout)
339: 	}
340: 	if sample.err != nil {
341: 		return sample
342: 	}
343: 
344: 	sample.links, sample.err = p.nodeLinks(ctx, target, sampledInterfaceNames(sample))
345: 
346: 	return sample
347: }
348: 
349: // sampledInterfaceNames lists the interface names a sample saw, sorted and comma-joined.
350: func sampledInterfaceNames(sample interfaceSample) string {
351: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(sample.stats)+len(sample.ifaces))
352: 	seen := map[string]bool{}
353: 	for _, iface := range sample.ifaces {
354: 		if !seen[iface.Name] {
355: 			seen[iface.Name] = true
356: 			names = append(names, iface.Name)
357: 		}
358: 	}
359: 	for _, stat := range sample.stats {
360: 		if !seen[stat.Name] {
361: 			seen[stat.Name] = true
362: 			names = append(names, stat.Name)
363: 		}
364: 	}
365: 	sort.Strings(names)
366: 
367: 	return strings.Join(names, ",")
368: }
369: 
370: // nodeLinks returns the lab link interfaces of a node from its pod's clabwire listing. A pod is
371: // listed once, and again when its interfaces change (a pod gets its link interfaces as clabwire
372: // wires them).
373: func (p *interfacePoller) nodeLinks(
374: 	ctx context.Context,
375: 	target interfaceSampleTarget,
376: 	names string,
377: ) ([]clabwireInterface, error) {
378: 	key := target.pod.Namespace + "/" + target.pod.Name
379: 
380: 	p.listingsMu.Lock()
381: 	listing := p.listings[key]
382: 	p.listingsMu.Unlock()
383: 
384: 	if listing == nil || listing.names != names {
385: 		entries, err := p.r.listPodInterfaces(ctx, target.pod.Namespace, target.pod.Name)
386: 		if err != nil {
387: 			return nil, err
388: 		}
389: 
390: 		listing = &podInterfaceListing{
391: 			names:  names,
392: 			byNode: map[string][]clabwireInterface{},
393: 		}
394: 		for _, entry := range entries {
395: 			listing.byNode[entry.Node] = append(listing.byNode[entry.Node], entry)
396: 		}
397: 
398: 		p.listingsMu.Lock()
399: 		p.listings[key] = listing
400: 		p.listingsMu.Unlock()
401: 	}
402: 
403: 	return listing.byNode[target.node.Name], nil
404: }
405: 
406: // commandNotExecutable reports an exec that failed because the command does not exist in the
407: // container.
408: func commandNotExecutable(rc int, err error) bool {
409: 	if rc == exitCommandNotExecutable || rc == exitCommandNotFound {
410: 		return true
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	return err != nil && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "executable file not found")
414: }
415: 
416: // reportedInterfaces are the interfaces reported for a node, by name, with the alias the
417: // topology gave them: its lab link interfaces, the management interface and loopback.
418: func reportedInterfaces(links []clabwireInterface) map[string]string {
419: 	reported := map[string]string{
420: 		loopbackInterface:   "",
421: 		managementInterface: "",
422: 	}
423: 	for _, link := range links {
424: 		reported[link.Interface] = link.Alias
425: 	}
426: 
427: 	return reported
428: }
429: 
430: // interfaceEventData describes an interface the way the local runtimes' netlink events do: the
431: // alias is the topology's name for the interface (an alias clabernetes set for its own use is
432: // not reported), the operational state uses netlink's names, lab link and management
433: // interfaces are veth pairs, loopback a device, and loopback has no hardware address.
434: func interfaceEventData(iface c9sIfaceState, alias string) clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData {
435: 	if alias == "" && !strings.HasPrefix(iface.Alias, clabernetesAliasPrefix) {
436: 		alias = iface.Alias
437: 	}
438: 
439: 	mac := iface.MAC
440: 	if mac == zeroMAC {
441: 		mac = ""
442: 	}
443: 
444: 	linkType := interfaceTypeVeth
445: 	if iface.Name == loopbackInterface {
446: 		linkType = interfaceTypeDevice
447: 	}
448: 
449: 	return clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
450: 		Name:      iface.Name,
451: 		Alias:     alias,
452: 		Index:     iface.Index,
453: 		MTU:       iface.MTU,
454: 		MAC:       mac,
455: 		OperState: netlinkOperState(iface.OperState),
456: 		Type:      linkType,
457: 	}
458: }
459: 
460: // netlinkOperState names an operational state from sysfs (RFC 2863, as in
461: // /sys/class/net/<if>/operstate) the way netlink, and so the local runtimes' events, name it.
462: func netlinkOperState(operState string) string {
463: 	switch operState {
464: 	case "notpresent":
465: 		return "not-present"
466: 	case "lowerlayerdown":
467: 		return "lower-layer-down"
468: 	case "":
469: 		return "unknown"
470: 	default:
471: 		return operState
472: 	}
473: }
474: 
475: func (p *interfacePoller) processSample(ctx context.Context, sample interfaceSample) {
476: 	state := sample.target.state
477: 	node := sample.target.node
478: 	key := c9sNodeKey(state.Namespace, state.Name, node.Name)
479: 
480: 	tracked, known := p.nodes[key]
481: 	if !known {
482: 		tracked = &trackedNode{ifaces: map[string]clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{}}
483: 		p.nodes[key] = tracked
484: 	}
485: 	tracked.lab = state
486: 	tracked.node = node
487: 
488: 	reported := reportedInterfaces(sample.links)
489: 
490: 	if sample.hasStates {
491: 		p.processStates(ctx, tracked, reported, sample)
492: 	}
493: 
494: 	if !p.opts.includeStats {
495: 		return
496: 	}
497: 	for _, stat := range sample.stats {
498: 		alias, ok := reported[stat.Name]
499: 		if !ok {
500: 			continue
501: 		}
502: 
503: 		statsKey := c9sIfaceStatsKey(state.Namespace, state.Name, node.Name, stat.Name)
504: 		current := c9sIfaceStatsSample{Stats: stat, Timestamp: sample.timestamp}
505: 		if previous, ok := p.statsSamples[statsKey]; ok {
506: 			data, ok := tracked.ifaces[stat.Name]
507: 			if !ok {
508: 				data = interfaceEventData(c9sIfaceState{Name: stat.Name}, alias)
509: 				data.OperState = ""
510: 			}
511: 			data.Stats = c9sIfaceStatsData(previous, current)
512: 			p.emit(ctx, tracked, interfaceActionStats, data, current.Timestamp)
513: 		}
514: 
515: 		p.statsSamples[statsKey] = current
516: 	}
517: }
518: 
519: // processStates reports the interfaces that appeared (snapshot in the first round with
520: // --initial-state, create later), changed (update) or disappeared (delete) since the last
521: // sample, like the netlink events of the local runtimes.
522: func (p *interfacePoller) processStates(
523: 	ctx context.Context,
524: 	tracked *trackedNode,
525: 	reported map[string]string,
526: 	sample interfaceSample,
527: ) {
528: 	present := map[string]bool{}
529: 	for _, iface := range sample.ifaces {
530: 		alias, ok := reported[iface.Name]
531: 		if !ok {
532: 			continue
533: 		}
534: 
535: 		data := interfaceEventData(iface, alias)
536: 		present[iface.Name] = true
537: 		previous, seen := tracked.ifaces[iface.Name]
538: 		tracked.ifaces[iface.Name] = data
539: 
540: 		switch {
541: 		case seen && previous == data:
542: 		case !seen && p.firstRound:
543: 			// Interfaces that exist when the stream starts are only reported with
544: 			// --initial-state; later changes are always reported.
545: 			if p.opts.includeInitialState {
546: 				p.emit(ctx, tracked, interfaceActionSnapshot, data, sample.timestamp)
547: 			}
548: 		case !seen:
549: 			p.emit(ctx, tracked, interfaceActionCreate, data, sample.timestamp)
550: 		default:
551: 			p.emit(ctx, tracked, interfaceActionUpdate, data, sample.timestamp)
552: 		}
553: 	}
554: 
555: 	for _, name := range sortedInterfaceNames(tracked.ifaces) {
556: 		if present[name] {
557: 			continue
558: 		}
559: 
560: 		p.emit(ctx, tracked, interfaceActionDelete, tracked.ifaces[name], sample.timestamp)
561: 		p.forgetStats(tracked, name)
562: 		delete(tracked.ifaces, name)
563: 	}
564: }
565: 
566: func sortedInterfaceNames(ifaces map[string]clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData) []string {
567: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(ifaces))
568: 	for name := range ifaces {
569: 		names = append(names, name)
570: 	}
571: 	sort.Strings(names)
572: 
573: 	return names
574: }
575: 
576: func (p *interfacePoller) forgetStats(tracked *trackedNode, ifName string) {
577: 	delete(p.statsSamples,
578: 		c9sIfaceStatsKey(tracked.lab.Namespace, tracked.lab.Name, tracked.node.Name, ifName))
579: }
580: 
581: func (p *interfacePoller) emit(
582: 	ctx context.Context,
583: 	tracked *trackedNode,
584: 	action string,
585: 	data clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData,
586: 	timestamp time.Time,
587: ) {
588: 	p.r.sendEvent(ctx, p.sink, c9sInterfaceEvent(tracked, action, data, timestamp))
589: }
590: 
591: // c9sInterfaceEvent is an interface event of a node. The actor is the node, as for its container
592: // events. The interface itself is in Interface; the events command reports it with the
593: // attributes of the local runtimes' interface events.
594: func c9sInterfaceEvent(
595: 	tracked *trackedNode,
596: 	action string,
597: 	data clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData,
598: 	timestamp time.Time,
599: ) clablabruntime.Event {
600: 	key := c9sNodeKey(tracked.lab.Namespace, tracked.lab.Name, tracked.node.Name)
601: 
602: 	attributes := map[string]string{
603: 		"namespace": tracked.lab.Namespace,
604: 		"lab":       tracked.lab.Name,
605: 		"node":      tracked.node.Name,
606: 		"origin":    clabernetesAppValue,
607: 	}
608: 	if tracked.node.Pod != "" {
609: 		attributes["pod"] = tracked.node.Pod
610: 	}
611: 
612: 	node := tracked.node
613: 
614: 	return clablabruntime.Event{
615: 		Timestamp:   timestamp,
616: 		Type:        clablabruntime.EventTypeInterface,
617: 		Action:      action,
618: 		ActorID:     key,
619: 		ActorName:   fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", tracked.lab.Name, tracked.node.Name),
620: 		ActorFullID: key,
621: 		Attributes:  attributes,
622: 		Lab:         tracked.lab,
623: 		Node:        &node,
624: 		Interface:   &data,
625: 	}
626: }
627: 
628: // c9sIfaceStatsData computes the counters and rates of a stats event from two samples.
629: func c9sIfaceStatsData(previous, current c9sIfaceStatsSample) *clablabruntime.InterfaceStats {
630: 	interval := current.Timestamp.Sub(previous.Timestamp)
631: 	if interval <= 0 {
632: 		interval = time.Second
633: 	}
634: 
635: 	seconds := interval.Seconds()
636: 	stat := current.Stats
637: 
638: 	return &clablabruntime.InterfaceStats{
639: 		RxBytes:   stat.RxBytes,
640: 		TxBytes:   stat.TxBytes,
641: 		RxPackets: stat.RxPackets,
642: 		TxPackets: stat.TxPackets,
643: 		RxBps:     float64(counterDelta(stat.RxBytes, previous.Stats.RxBytes)*8) / seconds,
644: 		TxBps:     float64(counterDelta(stat.TxBytes, previous.Stats.TxBytes)*8) / seconds,
645: 		RxPps:     float64(counterDelta(stat.RxPackets, previous.Stats.RxPackets)) / seconds,
646: 		TxPps:     float64(counterDelta(stat.TxPackets, previous.Stats.TxPackets)) / seconds,
647: 		Interval:  interval,
648: 	}
649: }
650: 
651: // parseInterfaceSample splits the output of interfaceSampleScript into the /proc/net/dev
652: // counters and the sysfs interface states. hasStates is false for output without the sysfs
653: // section, such as a plain cat of /proc/net/dev.
654: func parseInterfaceSample(data []byte) ([]c9sIfaceStats, []c9sIfaceState, bool, error) {
655: 	text := string(data)
656: 
657: 	procPart, sysfsPart, hasStates := strings.Cut(text, interfaceSysfsMarker+"\n")
658: 	if !hasStates {
659: 		procPart, _, hasStates = strings.Cut(text, interfaceSysfsMarker)
660: 	}
661: 
662: 	stats, err := parseProcNetDev([]byte(procPart))
663: 	if err != nil {
664: 		return nil, nil, false, err
665: 	}
666: 	if !hasStates {
667: 		return stats, nil, false, nil
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	return stats, parseSysfsInterfaces(sysfsPart), true, nil
671: }
672: 
673: func parseSysfsInterfaces(data string) []c9sIfaceState {
674: 	lines := strings.Split(data, "\n")
675: 	states := make([]c9sIfaceState, 0, len(lines))
676: 
677: 	for _, line := range lines {
678: 		fields := strings.SplitN(line, "\t", 7) //nolint:mnd
679: 		if len(fields) < 5 || strings.TrimSpace(fields[0]) == "" {
680: 			continue
681: 		}
682: 
683: 		state := c9sIfaceState{
684: 			Name:      strings.TrimSpace(fields[0]),
685: 			MAC:       strings.TrimSpace(fields[3]),
686: 			OperState: strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(fields[4])),
687: 		}
688: 		state.Index, _ = strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(fields[1]))
689: 		state.MTU, _ = strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(fields[2]))
690: 		if len(fields) > 5 {
691: 			state.Flags, _ = strconv.ParseUint(
692: 				strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(fields[5]), "0x"), 16, 64)
693: 		}
694: 		if len(fields) > 6 {
695: 			state.Alias = strings.TrimSpace(fields[6])
696: 		}
697: 		if state.OperState == "" {
698: 			state.OperState = "unknown"
699: 		}
700: 
701: 		states = append(states, state)
702: 	}
703: 
704: 	return states
705: }
706: 
707: func parseProcNetDev(data []byte) ([]c9sIfaceStats, error) {
708: 	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
709: 	stats := make([]c9sIfaceStats, 0, len(lines))
710: 
711: 	for _, line := range lines {
712: 		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
713: 		if line == "" || !strings.Contains(line, ":") {
714: 			continue
715: 		}
716: 
717: 		parts := strings.SplitN(line, ":", 2)
718: 		if len(parts) != 2 {
719: 			continue
720: 		}
721: 
722: 		ifName := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
723: 		fields := strings.Fields(parts[1])
724: 		if len(fields) < 16 {
725: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected /proc/net/dev line for %q: %q", ifName, line)
726: 		}
727: 
728: 		rxBytes, err := strconv.ParseUint(fields[0], 10, 64)
729: 		if err != nil {
730: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse rx bytes for %q: %w", ifName, err)

736: 		txBytes, err := strconv.ParseUint(fields[8], 10, 64)

741: 		if err != nil {
742: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse tx packets for %q: %w", ifName, err)
743: 		}
744:

757: // c9sNodeKey is the actor ID of a node: <namespace>/<lab>/<node>, the same value inspect
758: // reports as container_id.
759: func c9sNodeKey(namespace, lab, node string) string {
760: 	return namespace + "/" + lab + "/" + node
761: }
762: 
763: func c9sIfaceStatsKey(namespace, lab, node, ifName string) string {
764: 	return c9sNodeKey(namespace, lab, node) + "/" + ifName
765: }
766: 
767: func counterDelta(current, previous uint64) uint64 {
768: 	if current < previous {
769: 		return 0
770: 	}
771: 
772: 	return current - previous
773: }

Key observations so far:

1. In `labRuntimeInterfaceAttributes` (core/events/netlink.go head), `interfaceSnapshotAttributes` sets `"state": snapshot.OperState` unconditionally — an empty `OperState` yields a `"state": ""` attribute. The new test `TestInterfaceEventOmitsUnknownValues` expects `state` (and `mac`, `alias`) to be absent. Need to check `mergedEventAttributes` — maybe it filters empty values. Let me check where mergedEventAttributes is defined (probably in events.go or netlink.go).

2. `sample()` calls `p.nodeLinks` AFTER the exec; `nodeLinks` may perform another exec (`listPodInterfaces`) concurrently with up to 16 workers... but `sampleAll` bounds only the sample execs; nodeLinks execs happen within sample(), so bounded by same semaphore. OK.

3. `processSample` on `sample.err != nil` — round skips those samples (continue). So tracked node state retained; good. But note: `retireStoppedNodes` uses `running` map from labStates, independent of sampling.

4. `p.statsSamples` accessed only from poller goroutine (round → processSample) — single goroutine, fine. `nodes` map also single goroutine. `listings` guarded by mutex. `noShell` guarded. Good.

5. Issue candidate: in `processStates`, when a link interface is reported by clabwire but not present in sysfs sample yet (pod just wired), the interface will not be in `present`, so `tracked.ifaces` deletes it... wait, tracked.ifaces only contains previously-seen reported interfaces. Fine.

6. Potential issue: `processStates` — when `!seen && p.firstRound && !includeInitialState` → nothing, but `tracked.ifaces[name] = data` already recorded. Good.

7. In `processSample` stats path: `data, ok := tracked.ifaces[stat.Name]` — for no-shell nodes, tracked.ifaces empty → constructs data with `data.OperState = ""` → then `labRuntimeInterfaceAttributes` sets `"state": ""`. Test expects state absent. Need to check mergedEventAttributes handling of empty values. Let me look at core/events/events.go or wherever mergedEventAttributes lives.

8. `c9sInterfaceEvent` attributes: `"origin": clabernetesAppValue` = "clabernetes". Parity test c9sInterfaceEvent uses "origin": "clabernetes" — consistent.

9. `aggregate` for interface events: `labRuntimeInterfaceAttributes(lab, ev.ActorName, ev.Interface)` — "name" attribute set to ActorName ("lab1-r1"). Docker interface events set "name" from firstContainerName — which is the container name (longname). Same.

10. Now check `netlink.go` head for `interfaceAttributes`, `mergedEventAttributes`, `aggregatedEventFromContainerEvent` etc.

680: 	attributes["interval_seconds"] = strconv.FormatFloat(metrics.Interval.Seconds(), 'f', -1, 64)

683: // labRuntimeInterfaceAttributes are the attributes of a lab runtime's interface event: those
684: // of the netlink interface events, for the node the runtime runs. Values the runtime could not
685: // read (no index or MTU without a shell in the node) are left out rather than reported as 0.
686: func labRuntimeInterfaceAttributes(
687: 	lab, name string,
688: 	iface *clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData,
689: ) map[string]string {
690: 	attributes := interfaceSnapshotAttributes(ifaceSnapshot{
691: 		Index:     iface.Index,
692: 		Name:      iface.Name,
693: 		Alias:     iface.Alias,
694: 		MTU:       iface.MTU,
695: 		MAC:       iface.MAC,
696: 		OperState: iface.OperState,
697: 		Type:      iface.Type,
698: 	})
699: 	if iface.Index <= 0 {
700: 		delete(attributes, "index")
701: 	}
702: 	if iface.MTU <= 0 {
703: 		delete(attributes, "mtu")
704: 	}
705: 
706: 	if lab != "" {
707: 		attributes["lab"] = lab
708: 	}
709: 	if name != "" {
710: 		attributes["name"] = name
711: 	}
712: 
713: 	if stats := iface.Stats; stats != nil {
714: 		interfaceStatsAttributes(attributes, ifaceStatsMetrics{
715: 			RxBytes:   stats.RxBytes,
716: 			TxBytes:   stats.TxBytes,
717: 			RxPackets: stats.RxPackets,
718: 			TxPackets: stats.TxPackets,
719: 			RxBps:     stats.RxBps,
720: 			TxBps:     stats.TxBps,
721: 			RxPps:     stats.RxPps,
722: 			TxPps:     stats.TxPps,
723: 			Interval:  stats.Interval,
724: 		})
725: 	}
726: 
727: 	return attributes
728: }

730: func interfaceAttributes(

767: 			) + "%"

769: 	}

776: func overlayToolsInterface(

812: func (r *netlinkRegistry) emitInterfaceEvent(
813: 	container *clabruntime.GenericContainer,
814: 	action string,
815: 	snapshot ifaceSnapshot,
816: ) {
817: 	if container == nil {
818: 		return
819: 	}
820: 
821: 	attributes := interfaceAttributes(container, snapshot)
822: 
823: 	event := aggregatedEvent{
824: 		Timestamp:   time.Now(),
825: 		Type:        "interface",
826: 		Action:      action,
827: 		ActorID:     container.ShortID,
828: 		ActorName:   firstContainerName(container),
829: 		ActorFullID: container.ID,
830: 		Attributes:  attributes,
831: 	}
832: 
833: 	select {
834: 	case r.events <- event:
835: 	case <-r.ctx.Done():
836: 	}
837: }

839: func waitForNamespacePath(
840: 	ctx context.Context,
841: 	runtime clabruntime.ContainerRuntime,
842: 	containerID string,
843: ) (string, error) {
844: 	const (
845: 		attempts   = 5
846: 		retryDelay = 200 * time.Millisecond
847: 	)
848: 
849: 	var lastErr error
850: 
851: 	for i := 0; i < attempts; i++ {
852: 		nsPath, err := runtime.GetNSPath(ctx, containerID)
853: 		if err == nil && nsPath != "" {
854: 			return nsPath, nil
855: 		}
856: 
857: 		if err != nil {
858: 			lastErr = err
859: 		}
860: 
861: 		select {
862: 		case <-time.After(retryDelay):
863: 		case <-ctx.Done():
864: 			return "", ctx.Err()
865: 		}
866: 	}
867: 
868: 	if lastErr != nil {
869: 		return "", lastErr
870: 	}
871: 
872: 	return "", fmt.Errorf("namespace path not ready for container %s", containerID)
873: }

903: func snapshotInterfaces(netHandle *netlink.Handle) (map[int]ifaceSnapshot, error) {
904: 	if netHandle == nil {
905: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("netlink handle is nil")
906: 	}
907: 
908: 	links, err := netHandle.LinkList()
909: 	if err != nil {
910: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unable to list links: %w", err)
911: 	}
912: 
913: 	states := make(map[int]ifaceSnapshot, len(links))
914: 	for _, link := range links {
915: 		snapshot := snapshotFromLink(link)
916: 		states[snapshot.Index] = snapshot
917: 	}
918: 
919: 	return states, nil
920: }

928: 		snapshot.PacketLoss = info.PacketLoss

930: 		snapshot.Corruption = info.Corruption

946: 		snapshot.Alias = attrs.Alias

956: 			snapshot.RxPackets = stats.RxPackets

1037: func (w *netlinkWatcher) collectAndEmitStats(
1038: 	netHandle *netlink.Handle,
1039: 	states map[int]ifaceSnapshot,
1040: 	statsSamples map[int]ifaceStatsSample,
1041: 	registry *netlinkRegistry,
1042: ) {
1043: 	if netHandle == nil || statsSamples == nil {
1044: 		return
1045: 	}
1046: 
1047: 	now := time.Now()
1048: 	// Fetch all interfaces with one netlink call per tick instead of one call
1049: 	// per interface to reduce syscall overhead in large labs.
1050: 	currentStates, err := snapshotInterfaces(netHandle)
1051: 	if err != nil {
1052: 		log.Debugf(
1053: 			"failed to collect interface stats snapshot for container %s: %v",
1054: 			firstContainerName(w.container),
1055: 			err,
1056: 		)
1057: 
1058: 		return
1059: 	}
1060: 
1061: 	for idx, state := range states {
1062: 		current, ok := currentStates[idx]
1063: 		if !ok {
1064: 			continue
1065: 		}
1066: 
1067: 		state.Name = current.Name
1068: 		state.Alias = current.Alias
1069: 		state.MTU = current.MTU
1070: 		state.MAC = current.MAC
1071: 		state.OperState = current.OperState
1072: 		state.Type = current.Type
1073: 		state.HasStats = current.HasStats
1074: 		state.RxBytes = current.RxBytes
1075: 		state.TxBytes = current.TxBytes
1076: 		state.RxPackets = current.RxPackets
1077: 		state.TxPackets = current.TxPackets
1078: 		states[idx] = state
1079: 
1080: 		if !state.HasStats {
1081: 			delete(statsSamples, idx)
1082: 
1083: 			continue
1084: 		}
1085: 
1086: 		prev, ok := statsSamples[idx]
1087: 		if !ok || now.Sub(prev.Timestamp) <= 0 {
1088: 			statsSamples[idx] = ifaceStatsSample{
1089: 				RxBytes:   state.RxBytes,
1090: 				TxBytes:   state.TxBytes,
1091: 				RxPackets: state.RxPackets,
1092: 				TxPackets: state.TxPackets,
1093: 				Timestamp: now,
1094: 			}
1095: 
1096: 			continue
1097: 		}
1098: 
1099: 		interval := now.Sub(prev.Timestamp)
1100: 		if interval <= 0 {
1101: 			statsSamples[idx] = ifaceStatsSample{
1102: 				RxBytes:   state.RxBytes,
1103: 				TxBytes:   state.TxBytes,
1104: 				RxPackets: state.RxPackets,
1105: 				TxPackets: state.TxPackets,
1106: 				Timestamp: now,
1107: 			}
1108: 
1109: 			continue
1110: 		}
1111: 
1112: 		rxBytesDelta := deltaCounter(prev.RxBytes, state.RxBytes)
1113: 		txBytesDelta := deltaCounter(prev.TxBytes, state.TxBytes)
1114: 		rxPacketsDelta := deltaCounter(prev.RxPackets, state.RxPackets)
1115: 		txPacketsDelta := deltaCounter(prev.TxPackets, state.TxPackets)
1116: 
1117: 		seconds := interval.Seconds()
1118: 		if seconds <= 0 {
1119: 			statsSamples[idx] = ifaceStatsSample{
1120: 				RxBytes:   state.RxBytes,
1121: 				TxBytes:   state.TxBytes,
1122: 				RxPackets: state.RxPackets,
1123: 				TxPackets: state.TxPackets,
1124: 				Timestamp: now,
1125: 			}
1126: 
1127: 			continue
1128: 		}
1129: 
1130: 		metrics := ifaceStatsMetrics{
1131: 			RxBytes:   state.RxBytes,
1132: 			TxBytes:   state.TxBytes,
1133: 			RxPackets: state.RxPackets,
1134: 			TxPackets: state.TxPackets,
1135: 			RxBps:     float64(rxBytesDelta) * 8 / seconds,
1136: 			TxBps:     float64(txBytesDelta) * 8 / seconds,
1137: 			RxPps:     float64(rxPacketsDelta) / seconds,
1138: 			TxPps:     float64(txPacketsDelta) / seconds,
1139: 			Interval:  interval,
1140: 			Timestamp: now,
1141: 		}
1142: 
1143: 		registry.emitInterfaceStatsEvent(w.container, state, metrics)
1144: 
1145: 		statsSamples[idx] = ifaceStatsSample{
1146: 			RxBytes:   state.RxBytes,
1147: 			TxBytes:   state.TxBytes,
1148: 			RxPackets: state.RxPackets,
1149: 			TxPackets: state.TxPackets,
1150: 			Timestamp: now,
1151: 		}
1152: 	}
1153: }
1154: 
1155: func deltaCounter(previous, current uint64) uint64 {
1156: 	if current >= previous {
1157: 		return current - previous
1158: 	}
1159: 
1160: 	return current
1161: }
1162: 
1163: const (
1164: 	msPerSec = 1000
1165: )

1170: }
1171:

1186: 
1187: // Query queries the TC qdiscs in the namespace and returns a map of
1188: // interface index to netem data.
1189: func (q *netemQuerier) Query() map[int]netemInfo {
1190: 	result := make(map[int]netemInfo)
1191: 
1192: 	qdiscs, err := q.qdiscs()
1193: 	if err != nil {
1194: 		log.Debugf("failed to query tc qdiscs: %v", err)
1195: 		return result
1196: 	}
1197: 
1198: 	for idx := range qdiscs {
1199: 		qdisc := &qdiscs[idx]
1200: 		if qdisc.Attribute.Kind != "netem" || qdisc.Netem == nil {
1201: 			continue
1202: 		}
1203: 
1204: 		info := netemInfoFromQdisc(qdisc)
1205: 		if info.hasValues() {
1206: 			result[int(qdisc.Ifindex)] = info
1207: 		}
1208: 	}
1209: 
1210: 	return result
1211: }
1212: 
1213: func (q *netemQuerier) qdiscs() ([]gotc.Object, error) {
1214: 	if q == nil {
1215: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("netem querier is nil")
1216: 	}
1217: 
1218: 	if err := q.ensureHandle(); err != nil {
1219: 		return nil, err
1220: 	}
1221: 
1222: 	qdiscs, err := clabnetem.Impairments(q.tcHandle)
1223: 	if err == nil {
1224: 		return qdiscs, nil
1225: 	}
1226: 
1227: 	// Retry once by reopening the tc socket in case it became stale.
1228: 	q.Close()
1229: 	if errOpen := q.ensureHandle(); errOpen != nil {
1230: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
1231: 			"failed to query tc qdiscs (%v), and failed to reopen tc socket (%v)",
1232: 			err,
1233: 			errOpen,
1234: 		)
1235: 	}
1236: 
1237: 	return clabnetem.Impairments(q.tcHandle)
1238: }
1239: 
1240: func (q *netemQuerier) ensureHandle() error {
1241: 	if q == nil {
1242: 		return fmt.Errorf("netem querier is nil")
1243: 	}
1244: 
1245: 	if q.tcHandle != nil {
1246: 		return nil
1247: 	}
1248: 
1249: 	tcnl, err := clabnetem.NewTC(int(q.nsHandle))
1250: 	if err != nil {
1251: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open tc socket for netem query: %w", err)
1252: 	}
1253: 
1254: 	q.tcHandle = tcnl
1255: 
1256: 	return nil
1257: }

1259: type netemInfo struct {
1260: 	Delay      string
1261: 	Jitter     string
1262: 	PacketLoss float64
1263: 	Rate       int
1264: 	Corruption float64
1265: }
1266: 
1267: func (n netemInfo) hasValues() bool {
1268: 	return n.Delay != "" || n.Jitter != "" || n.PacketLoss != 0 || n.Rate != 0 || n.Corruption != 0
1269: }
1270: 
1271: func netemInfoFromQdisc(qdisc *gotc.Object) netemInfo {
1272: 	var info netemInfo
1273: 
1274: 	if qdisc.Netem == nil {
1275: 		return info
1276: 	}
1277: 
1278: 	if qdisc.Netem.Latency64 != nil && *qdisc.Netem.Latency64 != 0 {
1279: 		info.Delay = (time.Duration(*qdisc.Netem.Latency64) * time.Nanosecond).String()
1280: 	}
1281: 
1282: 	if qdisc.Netem.Jitter64 != nil && *qdisc.Netem.Jitter64 != 0 {
1283: 		info.Jitter = (time.Duration(*qdisc.Netem.Jitter64) * time.Nanosecond).String()
1284: 	}
1285: 
1286: 	if qdisc.Netem.Rate != nil && qdisc.Netem.Rate.Rate != 0 {
1287: 		info.Rate = int(qdisc.Netem.Rate.Rate * 8 / msPerSec)
1288: 	}
1289: 
1290: 	if qdisc.Netem.Corrupt != nil && qdisc.Netem.Corrupt.Probability != 0 {
1291: 		info.Corruption = math.Round((float64(qdisc.Netem.Corrupt.Probability)/
1292: 			float64(math.MaxUint32)*100)*100) / 100
1293: 	}
1294: 
1295: 	if qdisc.Netem.Qopt.Loss != 0 {
1296: 		info.PacketLoss = math.Round(
1297: 			(float64(qdisc.Netem.Qopt.Loss)/float64(math.MaxUint32)*100)*100) / 100
1298: 	}
1299: 
1300: 	return info
1301: }

462: func (c *CLab) containerFromLabNode(
463: 	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
464: 	node clablabruntime.NodeState,
465: ) clabruntime.GenericContainer {
466: 	nodeName := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", state.Name, node.Name)
467: 	containerState, containerStatus := labRuntimeContainerState(state, node)
468: 
469: 	topologyNode := node.Name
470: 	if node.TopologyName != "" {
471: 		topologyNode = node.TopologyName
472: 	}
473: 	if c.Config.Topology != nil {
474: 		topologyNode = c.topologyNodeName(topologyNode)
475: 	}
476: 
477: 	labels := map[string]string{
478: 		clabconstants.Containerlab: state.Name,
479: 		clabconstants.NodeName:     topologyNode,
480: 		clabconstants.LongName:     nodeName,
481: 		clabconstants.TopoFile:     labRuntimeTopologyPath(c, state),
482: 	}
483: 
484: 	var image string
485: 	if c.Config.Topology != nil {
486: 		labels[clabconstants.NodeKind] = c.Config.Topology.GetNodeKind(topologyNode)
487: 		image = c.Config.Topology.GetNodeImage(topologyNode)
488: 	}
489: 	if node.Kind != "" {
490: 		labels[clabconstants.NodeKind] = node.Kind
491: 	}
492: 	if node.Image != "" {
493: 		image = node.Image
494: 	}
495: 
496: 	// The node's type and group: from the loaded topology's node, with the kind's defaults the
497: 	// local runtimes report too, otherwise as the topology set them on the runtime's node.
498: 	nodeType, group := node.Type, node.Group
499: 	if topologyNodeConfig, ok := c.Nodes[topologyNode]; ok {
500: 		nodeType, group = topologyNodeConfig.Config().NodeType, topologyNodeConfig.Config().Group
501: 	} else if c.Config.Topology != nil && group == "" {
502: 		group = c.Config.Topology.GetNodeGroup(topologyNode)
503: 	}
504: 	if nodeType != "" {
505: 		labels[clabconstants.NodeType] = nodeType
506: 	}
507: 	if group != "" {
508: 		labels[clabconstants.NodeGroup] = group
509: 	}
510: 
511: 	if state.Owner != "" {
512: 		labels[clabconstants.Owner] = state.Owner
513: 	} else if c.customOwner != "" {
514: 		labels[clabconstants.Owner] = c.customOwner
515: 	}
516: 
517: 	// The ID names the node uniquely across namespaces and labs. It is also the short ID, so
518: 	// inspect reports it as container_id and it matches the events actor ID.
519: 	id := labRuntimeContainerID(state.Namespace, state.Name, node.Name)
520: 
521: 	return clabruntime.GenericContainer{
522: 		Names:           []string{nodeName},
523: 		ID:              id,
524: 		ShortID:         id,
525: 		Image:           image,
526: 		State:           containerState,
527: 		Status:          containerStatus,
528: 		Labels:          labels,
529: 		NetworkName:     state.Namespace,
530: 		NetworkSettings: managementAddress(node),
531: 		Ports:           labRuntimePorts(node.ExposedPorts),
532: 		Workload: &clabtypes.LabRuntimeWorkload{
533: 			Namespace:           state.Namespace,
534: 			Pod:                 node.Pod,
535: 			Container:           node.Container,
536: 			NodeUID:             node.NodeUID,
537: 			ExposedPorts:        node.ExposedPorts,
538: 			LoadBalancerAddress: node.LoadBalancerAddress,
539: 		},
540: 	}
541: }

543: // labRuntimeContainerState is a lab runtime node's state and status in the vocabulary of the
544: // container runtimes: state created, running or exited; status healthy or "health: starting"
545: // for a running node, as inspect shortens a Docker status line with a healthcheck, Created or
546: // Exited otherwise. A runtime that reports no container state keeps its own state.
547: func labRuntimeContainerState(
548: 	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
549: 	node clablabruntime.NodeState,
550: ) (string, string) {
551: 	switch node.ContainerState {
552: 	case clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning:
553: 		if node.Health == clablabruntime.ContainerHealthHealthy {
554: 			return node.ContainerState, "healthy"
555: 		}
556: 
557: 		return node.ContainerState, "health: starting"
558: 	case clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated:
559: 		return node.ContainerState, "Created"
560: 	case clablabruntime.ContainerStateExited:
561: 		return node.ContainerState, "Exited"
562: 	}
563: 
564: 	if node.Ready {
565: 		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning, "healthy"
566: 	}
567: 	if node.State == "" {
568: 		return state.State, ""
569: 	}
570: 
571: 	return node.State, node.State
572: }

574: // labRuntimePorts reports the ports a lab runtime exposes for a node as the ports a container
575: // exposes without publishing them on the host: the node is reached through the runtime (a
576: // Service, a port-forward), never on a port of this machine.
577: func labRuntimePorts(ports []clablabruntime.ExposedPort) []*clabtypes.GenericPortBinding {
578: 	if len(ports) == 0 {
579: 		return nil
580: 	}
581: 
582: 	bindings := make([]*clabtypes.GenericPortBinding, 0, len(ports))
583: 	for _, port := range ports {
584: 		bindings = append(bindings, &clabtypes.GenericPortBinding{
585: 			ContainerPort: port.Port,
586: 			Protocol:      port.Protocol,
587: 		})
588: 	}
589: 
590: 	return bindings
591: }

598: // topologyNodeName maps a node name a lab runtime reports back onto the topology node it belongs
599: // to. The runtime renames the nodes Kubernetes cannot carry, so the state it reports does not
600: // always use the name the topology file wrote.
601: func (c *CLab) topologyNodeName(name string) string {
602: 	if c.Config.Topology == nil {
603: 		return name
604: 	}
605: 	if _, ok := c.Config.Topology.Nodes[name]; ok {
606: 		return name
607: 	}
608: 
609: 	for nodeName := range c.Config.Topology.Nodes {
610: 		if clabnames.SanitizeName(nodeName) == name {
611: 			return nodeName
612: 		}
613: 	}
614: 
615: 	return name
616: }

618: // managementAddress reports the address a user reaches the node at: the LoadBalancer address
619: // when the node is exposed, otherwise the allocated management address.
620: func managementAddress(node clablabruntime.NodeState) clabruntime.GenericMgmtIPs {
621: 	settings := clabruntime.GenericMgmtIPs{}
622: 
623: 	if ip := net.ParseIP(node.LoadBalancerAddress); ip != nil {
624: 		if ip.To4() != nil {
625: 			settings.IPv4addr = node.LoadBalancerAddress
626: 			settings.IPv4pLen = 32
627: 		} else {
628: 			settings.IPv6addr = node.LoadBalancerAddress
629: 			settings.IPv6pLen = 128
630: 		}
631: 	}
632: 
633: 	if settings.IPv4addr == "" {
634: 		settings.IPv4addr, settings.IPv4pLen = splitManagementCIDR(node.MgmtIPv4Address)
635: 	}
636: 	if settings.IPv6addr == "" {
637: 		settings.IPv6addr, settings.IPv6pLen = splitManagementCIDR(node.MgmtIPv6Address)
638: 	}
639: 
640: 	return settings
641: }

643: func splitManagementCIDR(cidr string) (string, int) {
644: 	if cidr == "" {
645: 		return "", 0
646: 	}
647: 
648: 	ip, network, err := net.ParseCIDR(cidr)
649: 	if err != nil {
650: 		if net.ParseIP(cidr) != nil {
651: 			return cidr, 0
652: 		}
653: 
654: 		return "", 0
655: 	}
656: 
657: 	prefixLen, _ := network.Mask.Size()
658: 
659: 	return ip.String(), prefixLen
660: }

683: func filterLabRuntimeContainers(
684: 	containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer,
685: 	filters []*clabtypes.GenericFilter,
686: ) []clabruntime.GenericContainer {
687: 	if len(filters) == 0 {
688: 		return containers
689: 	}
690: 
691: 	filtered := make([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, 0, len(containers))
692: 	for _, container := range containers {
693: 		if labRuntimeContainerMatches(container, filters) {
694: 			filtered = append(filtered, container)
695: 		}
696: 	}

701: func labRuntimeContainerMatches(
702: 	container clabruntime.GenericContainer,
703: 	filters []*clabtypes.GenericFilter,
704: ) bool {
705: 	for _, filter := range filters {
706: 		switch filter.FilterType {
707: 		case "name":
708: 			if !labRuntimeNameMatches(container.Names, filter.Match) {
709: 				return false
710: 			}
711: 		case "id":
712: 			if container.ID != filter.Match && !strings.HasPrefix(container.ID, filter.Match) {
713: 				return false
714: 			}
715: 		case "label":
716: 			if !labRuntimeLabelMatches(container.Labels, filter) {
717: 				return false
718: 			}
719: 		}
720: 	}
721: 
722: 	return true
723: }

735: func labRuntimeLabelMatches(labels map[string]string, filter *clabtypes.GenericFilter) bool {
736: 	value, ok := labels[filter.Field]
737: 
738: 	switch filter.Operator {
739: 	case "exists":
740: 		return ok
741: 	case "!=":
742: 		return !ok || value != filter.Match
743: 	default:
744: 		return ok && value == filter.Match
745: 	}

748: func (c *CLab) copyLabRuntimeSavedFiles(
749: 	result *clablabruntime.SaveResult,
750: 	dstRoot string,
751: ) error {
752: 	for _, file := range result.Files {
753: 		if file.NodeName == "" || file.Name == "" {
754: 			continue
755: 		}
756: 
757: 		relPath, ok := cleanLabRuntimeSavedPath(file.Name)
758: 		if !ok {
759: 			return fmt.Errorf("refusing to copy unsafe saved config path %q", file.Name)
760: 		}
761: 
762: 		nodeDstDir := filepath.Join(dstRoot, file.NodeName)
763: 		dstPath := filepath.Join(nodeDstDir, relPath)
764: 		if err := os.MkdirAll(
765: 			filepath.Dir(dstPath),
766: 			clabconstants.PermissionsDirDefault,
767: 		); err != nil {
768: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create save dst directory %q: %w",
769: 				filepath.Dir(dstPath), err)
770: 		}
771: 
772: 		if file.LinkTarget != "" {
773: 			linkTarget, ok := cleanLabRuntimeSavedLinkTarget(file.LinkTarget)
774: 			if !ok {
775: 				return fmt.Errorf("refusing to create unsafe saved config symlink %q -> %q",
776: 					file.Name, file.LinkTarget)
777: 			}
778: 
779: 			_ = os.Remove(dstPath)
780: 			if err := os.Symlink(linkTarget, dstPath); err != nil {
781: 				return fmt.Errorf("failed to create symlink %q -> %q: %w",
782: 					dstPath, linkTarget, err)
783: 			}
784: 
785: 			continue
786: 		}
787: 
788: 		mode := os.FileMode(file.Mode)
789: 		if mode == 0 {
790: 			mode = clabconstants.PermissionsFileDefault
791: 		}
792: 
793: 		if err := os.WriteFile(dstPath, file.Data, mode); err != nil {
794: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to write saved config %q: %w", dstPath, err)
795: 		}
796: 
797: 		log.Info(
798: 			"copied saved config",
799: 			"node", file.NodeName,
800: 			"dst", dstPath,
801: 		)
802: 	}
803: 
804: 	return nil
805: }

807: func cleanLabRuntimeSavedPath(name string) (string, bool) {
808: 	cleaned := filepath.Clean(name)
809: 	if cleaned == "." || filepath.IsAbs(cleaned) ||
810: 		strings.HasPrefix(cleaned, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) ||
811: 		cleaned == ".." {
812: 		return "", false
813: 	}
814: 
815: 	return cleaned, true
816: }
817:

A runtime that reports no container state keeps its own state.\nfunc labRuntimeContainerState(\n\tstate *clablabruntime.LabState,\n\tnode clablabruntime.NodeState,\n) (string, string) {\n\tswitch node.ContainerState {\n\tcase clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning:\n\t\tif node.Health == clablabruntime.ContainerHealthHealthy {\n\t\t\treturn node.ContainerState, \"healthy\"\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn node.ContainerState, \"health: starting\"\n\tcase clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated:\n\t\treturn node.ContainerState, \"Created\"\n\tcase clablabruntime.ContainerStateExited:\n\t\treturn node.ContainerState, \"Exited\"\n\t}\n\n\tif node.Ready {\n\t\treturn clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning, \"healthy\"\n\t}\n\tif node.State == \"\" {\n\t\treturn state.State, \"\"\n\t}\n\n\treturn node.State, node.State\n}\n\n// labRuntimePorts reports the ports a lab runtime exposes for a node as the ports a container\n// exposes without publishing them on the host: the node is reached through the runtime (a\n// Service, a port-forward), never on a port of this machine.\nfunc labRuntimePorts(ports []clablabruntime.ExposedPort) []*clabtypes.GenericPortBinding {\n\tif len(ports) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tbindings := make([]*clabtypes.GenericPortBinding, 0, len(ports))\n\tfor _, port := range ports {\n\t\tbindings = append(bindings, &clabtypes.GenericPortBinding{\n\t\t\tContainerPort: port.Port,\n\t\t\tProtocol:      port.Protocol,\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\treturn bindings\n}\n\n// labRuntimeContainerID is the ID of a lab runtime node: <namespace>/<lab>/<node>.\nfunc labRuntimeContainerID(namespace, lab, node string) string {\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s/%s/%s\", namespace, lab, node)\n}\n\n// topologyNodeName maps a node name a lab runtime reports back onto the topology node it belongs\n// to. 22: 	// interfaceSampleScript reads the interface counters and, per interface, the sysfs
23: 	// attributes the interface state events carry, in one exec:
24: 	// name, ifindex, mtu, address, operstate, flags and ifalias, tab separated.
25: 	interfaceSampleScript = `cat /proc/net/dev; echo ` + interfaceSysfsMarker + `; ` +
26: 		`for d in /sys/class/net/*; do [ -e "$d/operstate" ] || continue; ` +

121: }

123: // interfacePoller samples the interfaces of every running node in an event scope and turns the
124: // samples into interface events. It reports the interfaces a container of the local runtimes
125: // has for the same node: the node's lab link interfaces, with the names and aliases clabwire
126: // lists for them, the management interface and loopback. The pod's own interfaces (the pod
127: // network, clabernetes' interposition and link transport interfaces) are not reported.
128: type interfacePoller struct {
129: 	r     *Runtime

132: 	sink  chan<- clablabruntime.Event
133:

136:

141:

144: 	listings map[string]*podInterfaceListing
145:

147: }

149: func (r *Runtime) pollInterfaces(
150: 	ctx context.Context,
151: 	scope eventScope,
152: 	opts interfacePollOptions,
153: 	eventSink chan<- clablabruntime.Event,
154: ) {
155: 	if opts.interval <= 0 {
156: 		opts.interval = time.Second
157: 	}
158: 
159: 	poller := newInterfacePoller(r, scope, opts, eventSink)
160: 	poller.round(ctx)
161: 
162: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(opts.interval)
163: 	defer ticker.Stop()
164: 
165: 	for {
166: 		select {
167: 		case <-ctx.Done():
168: 			return
169: 		case <-ticker.C:
170: 			poller.round(ctx)
171: 		}
172: 	}
173: }
174: 
175: func newInterfacePoller(
176: 	r *Runtime,
177: 	scope eventScope,
178: 	opts interfacePollOptions,
179: 	eventSink chan<- clablabruntime.Event,
180: ) *interfacePoller {
181: 	return &interfacePoller{
182: 		r:            r,
183: 		scope:        scope,
184: 		opts:         opts,
185: 		sink:         eventSink,
186: 		statsSamples: map[string]c9sIfaceStatsSample{},
187: 		nodes:        map[string]*trackedNode{},
188: 		noShell:      map[string]bool{},
189: 		listings:     map[string]*podInterfaceListing{},
190: 		firstRound:   true,
191: 	}
192: }
193: 
194: func (p *interfacePoller) round(ctx context.Context) {
195: 	defer func() { p.firstRound = false }()
196: 
197: 	states, err := p.r.labStates(ctx, p.scope)
198: 	if err != nil {
199: 		log.Debug("failed to list C9s labs for interface events", "error", err)
200: 		return
201: 	}
202: 
203: 	running := map[string]bool{}
204: 	pods := map[string]bool{}
205: 	var targets []interfaceSampleTarget
206: 	for _, state := range states {
207: 		for _, node := range state.Nodes {
208: 			if node.ContainerState != clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning || node.Pod == "" ||
209: 				node.Container == "" {
210: 				continue
211: 			}
212: 
213: 			running[c9sNodeKey(state.Namespace, state.Name, node.Name)] = true
214: 			pods[state.Namespace+"/"+node.Pod] = true
215: 			targets = append(targets, interfaceSampleTarget{
216: 				state: state,
217: 				node:  node,
218: 				pod: &corev1.Pod{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{
219: 					Name:      node.Pod,
220: 					Namespace: state.Namespace,
221: 				}},
222: 			})
223: 		}
224: 	}
225: 
226: 	for _, sample := range p.sampleAll(ctx, targets) {
227: 		if ctx.Err() != nil {
228: 			return
229: 		}
230: 		if sample.err != nil {
231: 			log.Debug("failed to sample C9s interfaces",
232: 				"namespace", sample.target.state.Namespace,
233: 				"lab", sample.target.state.Name,
234: 				"node", sample.target.node.Name,
235: 				"error", sample.err,
236: 			)
237: 
238: 			continue
239: 		}
240: 
241: 		p.processSample(ctx, sample)
242: 	}
243: 
244: 	p.retireStoppedNodes(ctx, running)
245: 	p.forgetListings(pods)
246: }
247: 
248: // retireStoppedNodes reports the interfaces of nodes that stopped running, or were removed, as
249: // deleted: they are gone with the node's pod.
250: func (p *interfacePoller) retireStoppedNodes(ctx context.Context, running map[string]bool) {
251: 	for key, tracked := range p.nodes {
252: 		if running[key] {
253: 			continue
254: 		}
255: 
256: 		for _, name := range sortedInterfaceNames(tracked.ifaces) {
257: 			p.emit(ctx, tracked, interfaceActionDelete, tracked.ifaces[name], time.Now())
258: 			p.forgetStats(tracked, name)
259: 		}
260: 		delete(p.nodes, key)

271: 			delete(p.listings, key)

349: // sampledInterfaceNames lists the interface names a sample saw, sorted and comma-joined.
350: func sampledInterfaceNames(sample interfaceSample) string {
351: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(sample.stats)+len(sample.ifaces))
352: 	seen := map[string]bool{}
353: 	for _, iface := range sample.ifaces {
354: 		if !seen[iface.Name] {
355: 			seen[iface.Name] = true
356: 			names = append(names, iface.Name)
357: 		}
358: 	}
359: 	for _, stat := range sample.stats {
360: 		if !seen[stat.Name] {
361: 			seen[stat.Name] = true
362: 			names = append(names, stat.Name)
363: 		}
364: 	}
365: 	sort.Strings(names)
366: 
367: 	return strings.Join(names, ",")
368: }

370: // nodeLinks returns the lab link interfaces of a node from its pod's clabwire listing. A pod is
371: // listed once, and again when its interfaces change (a pod gets its link interfaces as clabwire
372: // wires them).
373: func (p *interfacePoller) nodeLinks(
374: 	ctx context.Context,
375: 	target interfaceSampleTarget,
376: 	names string,
377: ) ([]clabwireInterface, error) {
378: 	key := target.pod.Namespace + "/" + target.pod.Name
379: 
380: 	p.listingsMu.Lock()
381: 	listing := p.listings[key]
382: 	p.listingsMu.Unlock()
383: 
384: 	if listing == nil || listing.names != names {
385: 		entries, err := p.r.listPodInterfaces(ctx, target.pod.Namespace, target.pod.Name)
386: 		if err != nil {
387: 			return nil, err
388: 		}
389: 
390: 		listing = &podInterfaceListing{
391: 			names:  names,
392: 			byNode: map[string][]clabwireInterface{},
393: 		}
394: 		for _, entry := range entries {
395: 			listing.byNode[entry.Node] = append(listing.byNode[entry.Node], entry)
396: 		}
397: 
398: 		p.listingsMu.Lock()
399: 		p.listings[key] = listing
400: 		p.listingsMu.Unlock()
401: 	}
402: 
403: 	return listing.byNode[target.node.Name], nil
404: }

406: // commandNotExecutable reports an exec that failed because the command does not exist in the
407: // container.
408: func commandNotExecutable(rc int, err error) bool {
409: 	if rc == exitCommandNotExecutable || rc == exitCommandNotFound {
410: 		return true
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	return err != nil && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "executable file not found")
414: }

416: // reportedInterfaces are the interfaces reported for a node, by name, with the alias the
417: // topology gave them: its lab link interfaces, the management interface and loopback.
418: func reportedInterfaces(links []clabwireInterface) map[string]string {
419: 	reported := map[string]string{
420: 		loopbackInterface:   "",
421: 		managementInterface: "",
422: 	}
423: 	for _, link := range links {
424: 		reported[link.Interface] = link.Alias
425: 	}
426: 
427: 	return reported
428: }

430: // interfaceEventData describes an interface the way the local runtimes' netlink events do: the
431: // alias is the topology's name for the interface (an alias clabernetes set for its own use is
432: // not reported), the operational state uses netlink's names, lab link and management
433: // interfaces are veth pairs, loopback a device, and loopback has no hardware address.
434: func interfaceEventData(iface c9sIfaceState, alias string) clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData {
435: 	if alias == "" && !strings.HasPrefix(iface.Alias, clabernetesAliasPrefix) {
436: 		alias = iface.Alias
437: 	}
438: 
439: 	mac := iface.MAC
440: 	if mac == zeroMAC {
441: 		mac = ""
442: 	}
443: 
444: 	linkType := interfaceTypeVeth
445: 	if iface.Name == loopbackInterface {
446: 		linkType = interfaceTypeDevice
447: 	}
448: 
449: 	return clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
450: 		Name:      iface.Name,
451: 		Alias:     alias,
452: 		Index:     iface.Index,
453: 		MTU:       iface.MTU,
454: 		MAC:       mac,
455: 		OperState: netlinkOperState(iface.OperState),
456: 		Type:      linkType,
457: 	}
458: }
459: 
460: // netlinkOperState names an operational state from sysfs (RFC 2863, as in
461: // /sys/class/net/<if>/operstate) the way netlink, and so the local runtimes' events, name it.
462: func netlinkOperState(operState string) string {
463: 	switch operState {
464: 	case "notpresent":
465: 		return "not-present"
466: 	case "lowerlayerdown":
467: 		return "lower-layer-down"
468: 	case "":
469: 		return "unknown"
470: 	default:
471: 		return operState
472: 	}
473: }

476: 	state := sample.target.state
477: 	node := sample.target.node
478: 	key := c9sNodeKey(state.Namespace, state.Name, node.Name)
479: 
480: 	tracked, known := p.nodes[key]
481: 	if !known {
482: 		tracked = &trackedNode{ifaces: map[string]clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{}}
483: 		p.nodes[key] = tracked
484: 	}
485: 	tracked.lab = state
486: 	tracked.node = node
487: 
488: 	reported := reportedInterfaces(sample.links)
489: 
490: 	if sample.hasStates {
491: 		p.processStates(ctx, tracked, reported, sample)
492: 	}
493: 
494: 	if !p.opts.includeStats {
495: 		return
496: 	}
497: 	for _, stat := range sample.stats {
498: 		alias, ok := reported[stat.Name]
499: 		if !ok {
500: 			continue
501: 		}
502: 
503: 		statsKey := c9sIfaceStatsKey(state.Namespace, state.Name, node.Name, stat.Name)
504: 		current := c9sIfaceStatsSample{Stats: stat, Timestamp: sample.timestamp}
505: 		if previous, ok := p.statsSamples[statsKey]; ok {
506: 			data, ok := tracked.ifaces[stat.Name]
507: 			if !ok {
508: 				data = interfaceEventData(c9sIfaceState{Name: stat.Name}, alias)
509: 				data.OperState = ""
510: 			}
511: 			data.Stats = c9sIfaceStatsData(previous, current)
512: 			p.emit(ctx, tracked, interfaceActionStats, data, current.Timestamp)
513: 		}
514: 
515: 		p.statsSamples[statsKey] = current
516: 	}
517: }

519: // processStates reports the interfaces that appeared (snapshot in the first round with
520: // --initial-state, create later), changed (update) or disappeared (delete) since the last
521: // sample, like the netlink events of the local runtimes.
522: func (p *interfacePoller) processStates(
523: 	ctx context.Context,
524: 	tracked *trackedNode,
525: 	reported map[string]string,
526: 	sample interfaceSample,
527: ) {
528: 	present := map[string]bool{}
529: 	for _, iface := range sample.ifaces {
530: 		alias, ok := reported[iface.Name]
531: 		if !ok {
532: 			continue
533: 		}
534: 
535: 		data := interfaceEventData(iface, alias)
536: 		present[iface.Name] = true
537: 		previous, seen := tracked.ifaces[iface.Name]
538: 		tracked.ifaces[iface.Name] = data
539: 
540: 		switch {
541: 		case seen && previous == data:
542: 		case !seen && p.firstRound:
543: 			// Interfaces that exist when the stream starts are only reported with
544: 			// --initial-state; later changes are always reported.
545: 			if p.opts.includeInitialState {
546: 				p.emit(ctx, tracked, interfaceActionSnapshot, data, sample.timestamp)
547: 			}
548: 		case !seen:
549: 			p.emit(ctx, tracked, interfaceActionCreate, data, sample.timestamp)
550: 		default:
551: 			p.emit(ctx, tracked, interfaceActionUpdate, data, sample.timestamp)
552: 		}
553: 	}
554: 
555: 	for _, name := range sortedInterfaceNames(tracked.ifaces) {
556: 		if present[name] {
557: 			continue
558: 		}
559: 
560: 		p.emit(ctx, tracked, interfaceActionDelete, tracked.ifaces[name], sample.timestamp)
561: 		p.forgetStats(tracked, name)
562: 		delete(tracked.ifaces, name)
563: 	}
564: }

566: func sortedInterfaceNames(ifaces map[string]clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData) []string {
567: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(ifaces))
568: 	for name := range ifaces {
569: 		names = append(names, name)
570: 	}
571: 	sort.Strings(names)
572: 
573: 	return names
574: }

577: 	delete(p.statsSamples,
578: 		c9sIfaceStatsKey(tracked.lab.Namespace, tracked.lab.Name, tracked.node.Name, ifName))

585: 	data clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData,

591: // c9sInterfaceEvent is an interface event of a node. The actor is the node, as for its container
592: // events. The interface itself is in Interface; the events command reports it with the
593: // attributes of the local runtimes' interface events.
594: func c9sInterfaceEvent(
595: 	tracked *trackedNode,
596: 	action string,
597: 	data clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData,
598: 	timestamp time.Time,
599: ) clablabruntime.Event {
600: 	key := c9sNodeKey(tracked.lab.Namespace, tracked.lab.Name, tracked.node.Name)
601: 
602: 	attributes := map[string]string{
603: 		"namespace": tracked.lab.Namespace,
604: 		"lab":       tracked.lab.Name,
605: 		"node":      tracked.node.Name,
606: 		"origin":    clabernetesAppValue,
607: 	}
608: 	if tracked.node.Pod != "" {
609: 		attributes["pod"] = tracked.node.Pod
610: 	}
611: 
612: 	node := tracked.node
613: 
614: 	return clablabruntime.Event{
615: 		Timestamp:   timestamp,
616: 		Type:        clablabruntime.EventTypeInterface,
617: 		Action:      action,
618: 		ActorID:     key,
619: 		ActorName:   fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", tracked.lab.Name, tracked.node.Name),
620: 		ActorFullID: key,
621: 		Attributes:  attributes,
622: 		Lab:         tracked.lab,
623: 		Node:        &node,
624: 		Interface:   &data,
625: 	}
626: }

628: // c9sIfaceStatsData computes the counters and rates of a stats event from two samples.
629: func c9sIfaceStatsData(previous, current c9sIfaceStatsSample) *clablabruntime.InterfaceStats {
630: 	interval := current.Timestamp.Sub(previous.Timestamp)
631: 	if interval <= 0 {
632: 		interval = time.Second
633: 	}
634: 
635: 	seconds := interval.Seconds()
636: 	stat := current.Stats
637: 
638: 	return &clablabruntime.InterfaceStats{
639: 		RxBytes:   stat.RxBytes,
640: 		TxBytes:   stat.TxBytes,
641: 		RxPackets: stat.RxPackets,
642: 		TxPackets: stat.TxPackets,
643: 		RxBps:     float64(counterDelta(stat.RxBytes, previous.Stats.RxBytes)*8) / seconds,
644: 		TxBps:     float64(counterDelta(stat.TxBytes, previous.Stats.TxBytes)*8) / seconds,
645: 		RxPps:     float64(counterDelta(stat.RxPackets, previous.Stats.RxPackets)) / seconds,
646: 		TxPps:     float64(counterDelta(stat.TxPackets, previous.Stats.TxPackets)) / seconds,
647: 		Interval:  interval,
648: 	}
649: }

651: // parseInterfaceSample splits the output of interfaceSampleScript into the /proc/net/dev
652: // counters and the sysfs interface states. hasStates is false for output without the sysfs
653: // section, such as a plain cat of /proc/net/dev.
654: func parseInterfaceSample(data []byte) ([]c9sIfaceStats, []c9sIfaceState, bool, error) {
655: 	text := string(data)
656: 
657: 	procPart, sysfsPart, hasStates := strings.Cut(text, interfaceSysfsMarker+"\n")
658: 	if !hasStates {
659: 		procPart, _, hasStates = strings.Cut(text, interfaceSysfsMarker)
660: 	}
661: 
662: 	stats, err := parseProcNetDev([]byte(procPart))
663: 	if err != nil {
664: 		return nil, nil, false, err
665: 	}
666: 	if !hasStates {
667: 		return stats, nil, false, nil
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	return stats, parseSysfsInterfaces(sysfsPart), true, nil
671: }
672: 
673: func parseSysfsInterfaces(data string) []c9sIfaceState {
674: 	lines := strings.Split(data, "\n")
675: 	states := make([]c9sIfaceState, 0, len(lines))
676: 
677: 	for _, line := range lines {
678: 		fields := strings.SplitN(line, "\t", 7) //nolint:mnd
679: 		if len(fields) < 5 || strings.TrimSpace(fields[0]) == "" {
680: 			continue
681: 		}
682: 
683: 		state := c9sIfaceState{
684: 			Name:      strings.TrimSpace(fields[0]),
685: 			MAC:       strings.TrimSpace(fields[3]),
686: 			OperState: strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(fields[4])),
687: 		}
688: 		state.Index, _ = strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(fields[1]))
689: 		state.MTU, _ = strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(fields[2]))
690: 		if len(fields) > 5 {
691: 			state.Flags, _ = strconv.ParseUint(
692: 				strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(fields[5]), "0x"), 16, 64)
693: 		}
694: 		if len(fields) > 6 {
695: 			state.Alias = strings.TrimSpace(fields[6])
696: 		}
697: 		if state.OperState == "" {
698: 			state.OperState = "unknown"
699: 		}
700: 
701: 		states = append(states, state)
702: 	}
703: 
704: 	return states
705: }
706: 
707: func parseProcNetDev(data []byte) ([]c9sIfaceStats, error) {
708: 	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
709: 	stats := make([]c9sIfaceStats, 0, len(lines))
710: 
711: 	for _, line := range lines {
712: 		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
713: 		if line == "" || !strings.Contains(line, ":") {
714: 			continue
715: 		}
716: 
717: 		parts := strings.SplitN(line, ":", 2)
718: 		if len(parts) != 2 {
719: 			continue
720: 		}
721: 
722: 		ifName := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
723: 		fields := strings.Fields(parts[1])
724: 		if len(fields) < 16 {
725: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected /proc/net/dev line for %q: %q", ifName, line)
726: 		}
727: 
728: 		rxBytes, err := strconv.ParseUint(fields[0], 10, 64)
729: 		if err != nil {
730: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse rx bytes for %q: %w", ifName, err)
731: 		}
732: 		rxPackets, err := strconv.ParseUint(fields[1], 10, 64)
733: 		if err != nil {
734: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse rx packets for %q: %w", ifName, err)
735: 		}
736: 		txBytes, err := strconv.ParseUint(fields[8], 10, 64)
737: 		if err != nil {
738: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse tx bytes for %q: %w", ifName, err)
739: 		}
740: 		txPackets, err := strconv.ParseUint(fields[9], 10, 64)
741: 		if err != nil {
742: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse tx packets for %q: %w", ifName, err)
743: 		}
744: 
745: 		stats = append(stats, c9sIfaceStats{
746: 			Name:      ifName,
747: 			RxBytes:   rxBytes,
748: 			RxPackets: rxPackets,
749: 			TxBytes:   txBytes,
750: 			TxPackets: txPackets,
751: 		})
752: 	}
753: 
754: 	return stats, nil
755: }

757: // c9sNodeKey is the actor ID of a node: <namespace>/<lab>/<node>, the same value inspect
758: // reports as container_id.
759: func c9sNodeKey(namespace, lab, node string) string {
760: 	return namespace + "/" + lab + "/" + node
761: }
762: 
763: func c9sIfaceStatsKey(namespace, lab, node, ifName string) string {
764: 	return c9sNodeKey(namespace, lab, node) + "/" + ifName
765: }
766: 
767: func counterDelta(current, previous uint64) uint64 {
768: 	if current < previous {
769: 		return 0
770: 	}
771: 
772: 	return current - previous
773: }

78: 	runtimeEvents, runtimeErrs, err := runtime.StreamEvents(ctx, streamOpts)
79: 	if err != nil {
80: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to stream events for runtime %q: %w", opts.Runtime, err)
81: 	}
82: 
83: 	errCh := make(chan error, 1)
84: 	go forwardRuntimeEvents(ctx, runtime, registry, runtimeEvents, runtimeErrs, eventCh, errCh)
85: 
86: 	runtimeErrors := errCh
87: 
88: 	for {
89: 		select {
90: 		case ev := <-eventCh:
91: 			if err := printer(ev); err != nil {
92: 				log.Debugf("failed to write event: %v", err)
93: 			}
94: 		case err, ok := <-runtimeErrors:
95: 			if !ok {
96: 				runtimeErrors = nil
97: 
98: 				continue
99: 			}
100: 
101: 			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
102: 				return err
103: 			}
104: 		case <-ctx.Done():
105: 			return nil
106: 		}
107: 	}
108: }

110: func streamLabRuntimeEvents(ctx context.Context, clab *clabcore.CLab, opts Options) error {
111: 	printer, err := newFormatter(opts.Format, opts.writer())
112: 	if err != nil {
113: 		return err
114: 	}
115: 
116: 	runtimeEvents, runtimeErrs, err := clab.LabRuntime.StreamEvents(
117: 		ctx,
118: 		labRuntimeEventStreamRequest(clab.Config.Name, clab.LabRuntimeIdentity(), opts),
119: 	)
120: 	if err != nil {
121: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to stream events for lab runtime %q: %w", opts.Runtime, err)
122: 	}
123: 
124: 	for runtimeEvents != nil || runtimeErrs != nil {
125: 		select {
126: 		case ev, ok := <-runtimeEvents:
127: 			if !ok {
128: 				runtimeEvents = nil
129: 
130: 				continue
131: 			}
132: 
133: 			if err := printer(aggregatedEventFromLabRuntimeEvent(clab, ev)); err != nil {
134: 				log.Debugf("failed to write event: %v", err)
135: 			}
136: 		case err, ok := <-runtimeErrs:
137: 			if !ok {
138: 				runtimeErrs = nil
139: 
140: 				continue
141: 			}
142: 
143: 			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
144: 				return err
145: 			}
146: 		case <-ctx.Done():
147: 			return nil
148: 		}
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	return nil
152: }

154: // labRuntimeEventStreamRequest scopes a lab runtime event stream. A selected lab (--topo or
155: // --name) limits the stream to that lab in its namespace. Without one the stream covers every
156: // namespace, unless a namespace override (--namespace, CLAB_KUBE_NAMESPACE) limits it to that
157: // namespace; the runtime applies the override.
158: func labRuntimeEventStreamRequest(
159: 	labName string,
160: 	identity clablabruntime.Identity,
161: 	opts Options,
162: ) clablabruntime.EventStreamRequest {
163: 	return clablabruntime.EventStreamRequest{
164: 		Name:                  labName,
165: 		Identity:              identity,
166: 		AllNamespaces:         labName == "",
167: 		IncludeInitialState:   opts.IncludeInitialState,
168: 		IncludeInterfaceStats: opts.IncludeInterfaceStats,
169: 		StatsInterval:         opts.StatsInterval,
170: 	}
171: }
172: 
173: // aggregatedEventFromLabRuntimeEvent reports a lab runtime event with the attributes the
174: // container runtimes' events have. A container event describes its node with the container
175: // record inspect reports for it, the way a Docker event carries the container's labels: as a
176: // snapshot like the snapshots of local containers, otherwise with the labels, image,
177: // management addresses and ports a Docker event and its enrichment carry. An interface event
178: // carries the attributes of the netlink interface events. The runtime's own attributes come on
179: // top.
180: func aggregatedEventFromLabRuntimeEvent(
181: 	clab *clabcore.CLab,
182: 	ev clablabruntime.Event,
183: ) aggregatedEvent {
184: 	ts := ev.Timestamp
185: 	if ts.IsZero() {
186: 		ts = time.Now()
187: 	}
188: 
189: 	var attributes map[string]string
190: 	switch {
191: 	case ev.Type == clablabruntime.EventTypeContainer && ev.Lab != nil && ev.Node != nil &&
192: 		clab != nil:
193: 		container := clab.LabRuntimeContainer(ev.Lab, *ev.Node)
194: 		if ev.Attributes["origin"] == clablabruntime.EventOriginSnapshot {
195: 			attributes = aggregatedEventFromContainerSnapshot(&container).Attributes
196: 		} else {
197: 			attributes = containerAttributes(&container)
198: 		}
199: 	case ev.Type == clablabruntime.EventTypeInterface && ev.Interface != nil:
200: 		lab := ev.Attributes["lab"]
201: 		if ev.Lab != nil {
202: 			lab = ev.Lab.Name
203: 		}
204: 		attributes = labRuntimeInterfaceAttributes(lab, ev.ActorName, ev.Interface)
205: 	}
206: 
207: 	for key, value := range ev.Attributes {
208: 		if attributes == nil {
209: 			attributes = make(map[string]string, len(ev.Attributes))
210: 		}
211: 		attributes[key] = value
212: 	}
213: 
214: 	return aggregatedEvent{
215: 		Timestamp:   ts,
216: 		Type:        ev.Type,
217: 		Action:      ev.Action,
218: 		ActorID:     ev.ActorID,
219: 		ActorName:   ev.ActorName,
220: 		ActorFullID: ev.ActorFullID,
221: 		Attributes:  attributes,
222: 	}
223: }
224: 
225: // containerAttributes are the attributes a container event reports for a container: its labels
226: // and image, which Docker puts on every container event, and the management addresses and
227: // ports the events command adds.
228: func containerAttributes(container *clabruntime.GenericContainer) map[string]string {
229: 	attributes := cloneStringMap(container.Labels)
230: 	if attributes == nil {
231: 		attributes = make(map[string]string)
232: 	}
233: 
234: 	if container.Image != "" {
235: 		attributes["image"] = container.Image
236: 	}
237: 
238: 	if container.NetworkSettings.IPv4addr != "" {
239: 		attributes["mgmt_ipv4"] = container.GetContainerIPv4()
240: 	}
241: 
242: 	if container.NetworkSettings.IPv6addr != "" {
243: 		attributes["mgmt_ipv6"] = container.GetContainerIPv6()
244: 	}
245: 
246: 	if ports := exposedPortsAttributeValue(container.Ports); ports != "" {
247: 		attributes["ports"] = ports
248: 	}
249: 
250: 	return attributes
251: }

253: func forwardRuntimeEvents(
254: 	ctx context.Context,
255: 	runtime clabruntime.ContainerRuntime,
256: 	registry *netlinkRegistry,
257: 	runtimeEvents <-chan clabruntime.ContainerEvent,
258: 	runtimeErrs <-chan error,
259: 	eventSink chan<- aggregatedEvent,
260: 	errSink chan<- error,
261: ) {
262: 	defer close(errSink)
263: 
264: 	sendErr := func(err error) {
265: 		select {
266: 		case errSink <- err:
267: 		case <-ctx.Done():
268: 		}
269: 	}
270: 
271: 	for {
272: 		select {
273: 		case <-ctx.Done():
274: 			return
275: 		case err, ok := <-runtimeErrs:
276: 			if !ok {
277: 				return
278: 			}
279: 
280: 			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
281: 				sendErr(err)
282: 
283: 				return
284: 			}
285: 		case ev, ok := <-runtimeEvents:
286: 			if !ok {
287: 				return
288: 			}
289: 
290: 			registry.HandleContainerEvent(runtime, ev)
291: 
292: 			aggregated := aggregatedEventFromContainerEvent(ctx, runtime, ev)
293: 			select {
294: 			case eventSink <- aggregated:
295: 			case <-ctx.Done():
296: 				return
297: 			}
298: 		}
299: 	}
300: }

302: func aggregatedEventFromContainerEvent(
303: 	ctx context.Context,
304: 	runtime clabruntime.ContainerRuntime,
305: 	ev clabruntime.ContainerEvent,
306: ) aggregatedEvent {
307: 	ts := ev.Timestamp
308: 	if ts.IsZero() {
309: 		ts = time.Now()
310: 	}
311: 
312: 	attributes := cloneStringMap(ev.Attributes)
313: 
314: 	actorFullID := ev.ActorFullID
315: 	if actorFullID == "" {
316: 		actorFullID = ev.ActorID
317: 	}
318: 
319: 	actorName := ev.ActorName
320: 	if actorName == "" && attributes != nil {
321: 		actorName = attributes["name"]
322: 	}
323: 
324: 	attributes = ensureContainerAttributes(ctx, runtime, attributes, actorFullID, actorName)
325: 
326: 	short := ev.ActorID
327: 	if short == "" {
328: 		short = actorFullID
329: 	}
330: 
331: 	action := strings.ToLower(ev.Action)
332: 	if action == "" {
333: 		action = ev.Action
334: 	}
335: 
336: 	eventType := strings.ToLower(ev.Type)
337: 	if eventType == "" {
338: 		eventType = ev.Type
339: 	}
340: 
341: 	return aggregatedEvent{
342: 		Timestamp:   ts,
343: 		Type:        eventType,
344: 		Action:      action,
345: 		ActorID:     clabutils.ShortID(short),
346: 		ActorName:   actorName,
347: 		ActorFullID: actorFullID,
348: 		Attributes:  attributes,
349: 	}
350: }

352: func ensureContainerAttributes(
353: 	ctx context.Context,
354: 	runtime clabruntime.ContainerRuntime,
355: 	attributes map[string]string,
356: 	actorFullID, actorName string,
357: ) map[string]string {
358: 	if runtime == nil {
359: 		return attributes
360: 	}
361: 
362: 	hasIPv4 := attributes != nil && attributes["mgmt_ipv4"] != ""
363: 	hasIPv6 := attributes != nil && attributes["mgmt_ipv6"] != ""
364: 	hasPorts := attributes != nil && attributes["ports"] != ""
365: 
366: 	if hasIPv4 && hasIPv6 && hasPorts {
367: 		return attributes
368: 	}
369: 
370: 	filters := make([]*clabtypes.GenericFilter, 0, 2)
371: 
372: 	if actorName == "" && attributes != nil {
373: 		actorName = attributes["name"]
374: 	}
375: 
376: 	if actorName != "" {
377: 		filters = append(filters, &clabtypes.GenericFilter{FilterType: "name", Match: actorName})
378: 	}
379: 
380: 	if actorFullID != "" {
381: 		filters = append(filters, &clabtypes.GenericFilter{FilterType: "id", Match: actorFullID})
382: 	}
383: 
384: 	if len(filters) == 0 {
385: 		return attributes
386: 	}
387: 
388: 	containers, err := runtime.ListContainers(ctx, filters)
389: 	if err != nil {
390: 		log.Debugf("failed to resolve container for event: %v", err)
391: 
392: 		return attributes
393: 	}
394: 
395: 	container := selectContainerForEvent(containers, actorFullID, actorName)
396: 	if container == nil {
397: 		return attributes
398: 	}
399: 
400: 	if attributes == nil {
401: 		attributes = make(map[string]string)
402: 	}
403: 
404: 	if !hasIPv4 {
405: 		if ipv4 := container.GetContainerIPv4(); ipv4 != "" && ipv4 != clabconstants.NotApplicable {
406: 			attributes["mgmt_ipv4"] = ipv4
407: 		}
408: 	}
409: 
410: 	if !hasIPv6 {
411: 		if ipv6 := container.GetContainerIPv6(); ipv6 != "" && ipv6 != clabconstants.NotApplicable {
412: 			attributes["mgmt_ipv6"] = ipv6
413: 		}
414: 	}
415: 
416: 	if !hasPorts {
417: 		if ports := exposedPortsAttributeValue(container.Ports); ports != "" {
418: 			attributes["ports"] = ports
419: 		}
420: 	}
421: 
422: 	if len(attributes) == 0 {
423: 		return nil
424: 	}
425: 
426: 	return attributes
427: }

429: func selectContainerForEvent(
430: 	containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer,
431: 	actorFullID, actorName string,
432: ) *clabruntime.GenericContainer {
433: 	if len(containers) == 0 {
434: 		return nil
435: 	}
436: 
437: 	if actorFullID != "" {
438: 		for idx := range containers {
439: 			container := &containers[idx]
440: 
441: 			switch {
442: 			case container.ID == actorFullID:
443: 				return container
444: 			case strings.HasPrefix(container.ID, actorFullID):
445: 				return container
446: 			case container.ShortID == actorFullID:
447: 				return container
448: 			}
449: 		}
450: 	}
451: 
452: 	if actorName != "" {
453: 		for idx := range containers {
454: 			container := &containers[idx]
455: 
456: 			for _, name := range container.Names {
457: 				if name == actorName {
458: 					return container
459: 				}
460: 			}
461: 		}
462: 	}
463: 
464: 	return &containers[0]
465: }

467: func emitContainerSnapshots(
468: 	ctx context.Context,
469: 	containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer,
470: 	sink chan<- aggregatedEvent,
471: ) {
472: 	for idx := range containers {
473: 		container := containers[idx]
474: 		if !isRunningContainer(&container) && !strings.EqualFold(container.State, "exited") {
475: 			continue
476: 		}
477: 
478: 		event := aggregatedEventFromContainerSnapshot(&container)
479: 		if event.ActorID == "" && event.ActorName == "" {
480: 			continue
481: 		}
482: 
483: 		select {
484: 		case sink <- event:
485: 		case <-ctx.Done():
486: 			return
487: 		}
488: 	}
489: }

491: func aggregatedEventFromContainerSnapshot(
492: 	container *clabruntime.GenericContainer,
493: ) aggregatedEvent {
494: 	if container == nil {
495: 		return aggregatedEvent{}
496: 	}
497: 
498: 	state := strings.ToLower(container.State)
499: 
500: 	short := container.ShortID
501: 	if short == "" {
502: 		short = clabutils.ShortID(container.ID)
503: 	}
504: 
505: 	attributes := containerAttributes(container)
506: 
507: 	if _, ok := attributes["origin"]; !ok {
508: 		attributes["origin"] = "snapshot"
509: 	}
510: 
511: 	if container.Status != "" {
512: 		attributes["status"] = container.Status
513: 	}
514: 
515: 	if state != "" {
516: 		attributes["state"] = state
517: 	}
518: 
519: 	if container.NetworkName != "" {
520: 		attributes["network"] = container.NetworkName
521: 	}
522: 
523: 	if len(attributes) == 0 {
524: 		attributes = nil
525: 	}
526: 
527: 	actorName := firstContainerName(container)
528: 
529: 	action := state
530: 	if action == "" {
531: 		action = "snapshot"
532: 	}
533: 
534: 	return aggregatedEvent{
535: 		Timestamp:   time.Now(),
536: 		Type:        "container",
537: 		Action:      action,
538: 		ActorID:     clabutils.ShortID(short),
539: 		ActorName:   actorName,
540: 		ActorFullID: container.ID,
541: 		Attributes:  attributes,
542: 	}
543: }

545: func cloneStringMap(input map[string]string) map[string]string {
546: 	if len(input) == 0 {
547: 		return nil
548: 	}
549: 
550: 	result := make(map[string]string, len(input))
551: 	for k, v := range input {
552: 		result[k] = v
553: 	}
554: 
555: 	return result
556: }

558: func isRunningContainer(container *clabruntime.GenericContainer) bool {
559: 	if container == nil {
560: 		return false
561: 	}
562: 
563: 	return strings.EqualFold(container.State, "running")
564: }
