820: 	topology := getTestTopology(t, r, "lab-ns", "lab1")
821: 	if got := topology.GetAnnotations()[annotationTopologyFile]; got != "/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml" {
822: 		t.Fatalf("Topology annotation = %q", got)
823: 	}
824: 	state, err := r.Inspect(context.Background(),
825: 		clablabruntime.InspectRequest{Name: "lab1", Namespace: "lab-ns"})
826: 	if err != nil {
827: 		t.Fatal(err)
828: 	}
829: 	if state.TopologyPath != "/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml" {
830: 		t.Fatalf("TopologyPath = %q", state.TopologyPath)
831: 	}
832: 
833: 	if _, err := r.Deploy(context.Background(),
834: 		sourceDeployRequest("/srv/labs/lab1.clab.yml", false)); err != nil {
835: 		t.Fatal(err)
836: 	}
837: 	topology = getTestTopology(t, r, "lab-ns", "lab1")
838: 	if got := topology.GetAnnotations()[annotationTopologyFile]; got != "/srv/labs/lab1.clab.yml" {
839: 		t.Fatalf("Topology annotation after a deploy from another file = %q", got)
840: 	}
841: 
842: 	// without a Topology resource: on the Nodes only, kept from their creation
843: 	r = newTestRuntime()
844: 	if _, err := r.Deploy(context.Background(),
845: 		sourceDeployRequest("/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml", true)); err != nil {
846: 		t.Fatal(err)
847: 	}
848: 	assertPrimitiveTopologyFile(t, r, "/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml")
849: 	state, err = r.Inspect(context.Background(),
850: 		clablabruntime.InspectRequest{Name: "lab1", Namespace: "lab-ns"})
851: 	if err != nil {
852: 		t.Fatal(err)
853: 	}
854: 	if state.TopologyPath != "/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml" {
855: 		t.Fatalf("TopologyPath without a Topology = %q", state.TopologyPath)
856: 	}

858: 	plan, err := r.Plan(context.Background(),
859: 		sourceDeployRequest("/srv/labs/lab1.clab.yml", true))

861: 		t.Fatal(err)
862: 	}
863: 	for _, change := range plan.Changes {
864: 		if change.Kind == "Node" {
865: 			t.Fatalf("a deploy from another file would change %+v and replace its pod", change)
866: 		}
867: 	}
868: 	if _, err := r.Deploy(context.Background(),
869: 		sourceDeployRequest("/srv/labs/lab1.clab.yml", true)); err != nil {
870: 		t.Fatal(err)
871: 	}

875: func assertPrimitiveTopologyFile(t *testing.T, r *Runtime, want string) {
876: 	t.Helper()
877: 
878: 	for _, gvr := range []struct {
879: 		name string
880: 		want string
881: 	}{{"nodes", want}, {"links", ""}, {"nodeprofiles", ""}} {
882: 		resource := nodeGVR
883: 		switch gvr.name {
884: 		case "links":
885: 			resource = linkGVR
886: 		case "nodeprofiles":
887: 			resource = nodeProfileGVR
888: 		}
889: 		list, err := r.client.Resource(resource).Namespace("lab-ns").
890: 			List(context.Background(), metav1.ListOptions{})
891: 		if err != nil {
892: 			t.Fatal(err)
893: 		}
894: 		for idx := range list.Items {
895: 			if got := list.Items[idx].GetAnnotations()[annotationTopologyFile]; got != gvr.want {
896: 				t.Fatalf("%s %s annotation = %q, want %q", gvr.name, list.Items[idx].GetName(),
897: 					got, gvr.want)
898: 			}
899: 		}
900: 	}
901: }

198: func attributeKeys(attributes map[string]string) []string {
199: 	keys := make([]string, 0, len(attributes))
200: 	for key := range attributes {
201: 		keys = append(keys, key)
202: 	}
203: 	sort.Strings(keys)
204: 
205: 	return keys
206: }

208: // assertAttributeParity checks that the c9s event carries every attribute of the Docker event,
209: // apart from the ones listed.
210: func assertAttributeParity(t *testing.T, docker, c9s aggregatedEvent, dockerOnly map[string]bool) {
211: 	t.Helper()
212: 
213: 	dockerAttributes := mergedEventAttributes(docker)
214: 	c9sAttributes := mergedEventAttributes(c9s)
215: 	var missing []string
216: 	for key := range dockerAttributes {
217: 		if _, ok := c9sAttributes[key]; !ok && !dockerOnly[key] {
218: 			missing = append(missing, key)
219: 		}
220: 	}
221: 	if len(missing) != 0 {
222: 		sort.Strings(missing)
223: 		t.Fatalf("c9s %s %s lacks %v\ndocker: %v\nc9s:    %v", c9s.Type, c9s.Action, missing,
224: 			attributeKeys(dockerAttributes), attributeKeys(c9sAttributes))
225: 	}
226: }

253: ) {
254: 	t.Helper()
255: 
256: 	for _, node := range []string{"client", "srl1"} {

258: 		state, nodeState := c9sNode(dockerLab, path, node)
259: 		dockerOnly := dockerOnlyContainerAttributes
260: 		if byName && node == "srl1" {
261: 			// The type is the SR Linux default; the cluster has only the types a topology
262: 			// sets, so a lab read by name does not know it.
263: 			dockerOnly = map[string]bool{clabconstants.NodeType: true}
264: 			for key := range dockerOnlyContainerAttributes {

266: 			}
267: 		}

269: 		for _, tt := range []struct {
270: 			action, state string
271: 			extra         map[string]string
272: 		}{
273: 			{"create", "created", nil},
274: 			{"start", "running", nil},
275: 			{"kill", "running", map[string]string{"signal": "15"}},
276: 			{"stop", "exited", nil},
277: 			{"die", "exited", map[string]string{"exitCode": "137", "execDuration": "3"}},
278: 			{"health_status: healthy", "running", nil},
279: 			{"destroy", "exited", nil},

282: 			var c9sExtra map[string]string

284: 				c9sExtra = tt.extra

289: 			got := mergedEventAttributes(c9s)
290: 			want := map[string]string{

293: 				clabconstants.LongName:     "parity-" + node,
294: 				clabconstants.NodeKind:     dockerLab.Nodes[node].Config().Kind,
295: 				clabconstants.TopoFile:     path,

308: 				}
309: 			}

311: 			dockerAttributes := mergedEventAttributes(docker)
312: 			for _, key := range []string{
313: 				clabconstants.Containerlab, clabconstants.NodeName, clabconstants.NodeKind,
314: 				clabconstants.NodeType, clabconstants.TopoFile, clabconstants.Owner, "image",
315: 				"ports",
316: 			} {

319: 				}
320: 				if got[key] != dockerAttributes[key] {

398: // dockerInterfaceEvent is a netlink interface event of a Docker container.
399: func dockerInterfaceEvent(
400: 	container clabruntime.GenericContainer,
401: 	action string,
402: 	snapshot ifaceSnapshot,
403: 	stats *ifaceStatsMetrics,
404: ) aggregatedEvent {
405: 	attributes := interfaceAttributes(&container, snapshot)
406: 	if stats != nil {
407: 		interfaceStatsAttributes(attributes, *stats)
408: 	}
409: 
410: 	return aggregatedEvent{
411: 		Type: "interface", Action: action, ActorID: container.ShortID,
412: 		ActorName: container.Names[0], ActorFullID: container.ID, Attributes: attributes,
413: 	}
414: }

435: // TestInterfaceEventParity compares the interface events of the lab link (linux eth1, SR Linux
436: // e1-1 with its alias ethernet-1/1), the management interface and loopback.
437: func TestInterfaceEventParity(t *testing.T) {
438: 	path, dockerLab := parityLab(t)
439: 
440: 	tests := []struct {
441: 		node string
442: 		data clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData
443: 	}{
444: 		{
445: 			"client",
446: 			clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
447: 				Name:      "eth1",
448: 				Index:     7,
449: 				MTU:       9500,
450: 				MAC:       "aa:c1:ab:56:aa:46",
451: 				OperState: "up",
452: 				Type:      "veth",
453: 			},
454: 		},
455: 		{"srl1", clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
456: 			Name: "e1-1", Alias: "ethernet-1/1", Index: 7, MTU: 9500, MAC: "aa:c1:ab:56:aa:47",
457: 			OperState: "lower-layer-down", Type: "veth",
458: 		}},
459: 		{
460: 			"client",
461: 			clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
462: 				Name:      "eth0",
463: 				Index:     4,
464: 				MTU:       1500,
465: 				MAC:       "02:42:ac:14:14:02",
466: 				OperState: "up",
467: 				Type:      "veth",
468: 			},
469: 		},
470: 		{"client", clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
471: 			Name: "lo", Index: 1, MTU: 65536, OperState: "unknown", Type: "device",
472: 		}},
473: 	}
474: 	for _, tt := range tests {
475: 		container := dockerContainer(t, dockerLab, tt.node)
476: 		state, nodeState := c9sNode(dockerLab, path, tt.node)
477: 		snapshot := ifaceSnapshot{
478: 			Index: tt.data.Index, Name: tt.data.Name, Alias: tt.data.Alias, MTU: tt.data.MTU,
479: 			MAC: tt.data.MAC, OperState: tt.data.OperState, Type: tt.data.Type,
480: 		}
481: 		metrics := ifaceStatsMetrics{
482: 			RxBytes: 2000, TxBytes: 3000, RxPackets: 20, TxPackets: 30,
483: 			RxBps: 8000, TxBps: 12000, RxPps: 10, TxPps: 15, Interval: 2 * time.Second,
484: 		}
485: 
486: 		for _, action := range []string{"snapshot", "create", "update", "delete", "stats"} {
487: 			var stats *ifaceStatsMetrics
488: 			data := tt.data
489: 			if action == "stats" {
490: 				stats = &metrics
491: 				data.Stats = &clablabruntime.InterfaceStats{
492: 					RxBytes: 2000, TxBytes: 3000, RxPackets: 20, TxPackets: 30,
493: 					RxBps: 8000, TxBps: 12000, RxPps: 10, TxPps: 15, Interval: 2 * time.Second,
494: 				}
495: 			}
496: 			docker := dockerInterfaceEvent(container, action, snapshot, stats)
497: 			c9s := c9sInterfaceEvent(state, nodeState, action, data)
498: 			assertAttributeParity(t, docker, c9s, nil)
499: 
500: 			dockerAttributes := mergedEventAttributes(docker)
501: 			got := mergedEventAttributes(c9s)
502: 			for key, value := range dockerAttributes {
503: 				switch key {
504: 				case "id", "name", "lab", "origin":
505: 					// the node's own ID, name and lab; the source of the event
506: 					continue
507: 				}
508: 				if got[key] != value {
509: 					t.Fatalf("%s %s %s: %s = %q, docker %q", tt.node, tt.data.Name, action, key,
510: 						got[key], value)
511: 				}
512: 			}
513: 			if got["name"] != "parity-"+tt.node || got["lab"] != "parity" ||
514: 				got["id"] != "c9s-parity/parity/"+tt.node {
515: 				t.Fatalf("%s %s %s: node attributes %v", tt.node, tt.data.Name, action, got)
516: 			}
517: 		}
518: 	}
519: }

159: 		alias string
160: 	}{
161: 		{name: "linux", link: "eth1"},
162: 		{name: "srl", link: "e1-1", alias: "ethernet-1/1"},
163: 	}
164: 	for _, tt := range tests {
165: 		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
166: 			t.Parallel()
167: 
168: 			links := []clabwireInterface{{
169: 				Node: "r1", Interface: tt.link, Alias: tt.alias,
170: 				PeerNode: "r2", PeerInterface: tt.link,
171: 			}}
172: 			sink := make(chan clablabruntime.Event, 64)
173: 			p := newInterfacePoller(&Runtime{}, eventScope{},
174: 				interfacePollOptions{includeInitialState: true}, sink)
175: 			ctx := context.Background()
176: 			start := time.Now()
177: 
178: 			p.processSample(
179: 				ctx,
180: 				interfaceTestSample("r1", start, links, podInterfaces(tt.link, "up")),
181: 			)
182: 			got := interfacesByName(drain(sink))
183: 			if len(got) != 3 {
184: 				t.Fatalf("first round reported %v, want %s, eth0 and lo", got, tt.link)
185: 			}
186: 			link := got[tt.link]
187: 			if link.Action != interfaceActionSnapshot ||
188: 				link.Type != clablabruntime.EventTypeInterface ||
189: 				link.ActorID != "c9s-lab1/lab1/r1" ||
190: 				link.ActorFullID != "c9s-lab1/lab1/r1" ||
191: 				link.ActorName != "lab1-r1" || link.Interface.Alias != tt.alias ||
192: 				link.Interface.OperState != "up" || link.Interface.Type != "veth" ||
193: 				link.Lab == nil || link.Node == nil || link.Node.Name != "r1" ||
194: 				link.Attributes["origin"] != "clabernetes" ||
195: 				link.Attributes["pod"] != "lab1-r1-abc" ||
196: 				link.Attributes["namespace"] != "c9s-lab1" {
197: 				t.Fatalf("%s event = %+v", tt.link, link)
198: 			}
199: 			if got["lo"].Interface.Type != "device" || got["eth0"].Interface.Alias != "" {
200: 				t.Fatalf("eth0/lo = %+v %+v", got["eth0"].Interface, got["lo"].Interface)
201: 			}
202: 
203: 			// unchanged: nothing
204: 			p.firstRound = false
205: 			p.processSample(ctx, interfaceTestSample("r1", start.Add(time.Second), links,
206: 				podInterfaces(tt.link, "up")))
207: 			if events := drain(sink); len(events) != 0 {
208: 				t.Fatalf("unchanged interfaces reported %+v", events)
209: 			}
210: 
211: 			// the peer goes away: the link loses its carrier
212: 			p.processSample(ctx, interfaceTestSample("r1", start.Add(2*time.Second), links,
213: 				podInterfaces(tt.link, "lowerlayerdown")))
214: 			events := drain(sink)
215: 			if len(events) != 1 || events[0].Action != interfaceActionUpdate ||
216: 				events[0].Interface.Name != tt.link ||
217: 				events[0].Interface.OperState != "lower-layer-down" {
218: 				t.Fatalf("carrier loss reported %+v", events)
219: 			}
220: 
221: 			// the link interface disappears, then comes back
222: 			withoutLink := podInterfaces(tt.link, "up")
223: 			withoutLink = withoutLink[:len(withoutLink)-1]
224: 			p.processSample(
225: 				ctx,
226: 				interfaceTestSample("r1", start.Add(3*time.Second), links, withoutLink),
227: 			)
228: 			events = drain(sink)
229: 			if len(events) != 1 || events[0].Action != interfaceActionDelete ||
230: 				events[0].Interface.Name != tt.link {
231: 				t.Fatalf("removed link reported %+v", events)
232: 			}
233: 			p.processSample(ctx, interfaceTestSample("r1", start.Add(4*time.Second), links,
234: 				podInterfaces(tt.link, "up")))
235: 			events = drain(sink)
236: 			if len(events) != 1 || events[0].Action != interfaceActionCreate ||
237: 				events[0].Interface.Alias != tt.alias {
238: 				t.Fatalf("new link reported %+v", events)
239: 			}
240: 
241: 			// the node stops: its interfaces are deleted
242: 			p.retireStoppedNodes(ctx, map[string]bool{})
243: 			got = interfacesByName(drain(sink))
244: 			if len(got) != 3 || got[tt.link].Action != interfaceActionDelete ||
245: 				got["eth0"].Action != interfaceActionDelete || len(p.nodes) != 0 {
246: 				t.Fatalf("stopped node reported %+v", got)
247: 			}
248: 		})
249: 	}
250: }

299: // listingExec answers clabwire --list-interfaces with the listing of the pod and counts the
300: // listings.
301: type listingExec struct {
302: 	mu       sync.Mutex
303: 	listings map[string][]clabwireInterface
304: 	calls    int
305: }
306: 
307: func (l *listingExec) exec(
308: 	_ context.Context,
309: 	_, pod, container string,
310: 	command []string,
311: 	_ io.Reader,
312: 	stdout, _ io.Writer,
313: ) error {
314: 	l.mu.Lock()
315: 	defer l.mu.Unlock()
316: 
317: 	if container != clabwireContainer || !slices.Contains(command, "--list-interfaces") {
318: 		return nil
319: 	}
320: 	l.calls++
321: 
322: 	return json.NewEncoder(stdout).Encode(l.listings[pod])
323: }

369: func TestContainerTransitionActions(t *testing.T) {
370: 	t.Parallel()
371: 
372: 	const (
373: 		created = clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated
374: 		running = clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning
375: 		exited  = clablabruntime.ContainerStateExited
376: 		healthy = clablabruntime.ContainerHealthHealthy
377: 		start   = clablabruntime.ContainerHealthStarting
378: 		sick    = clablabruntime.ContainerHealthUnhealthy
379: 	)
380: 	tracked := func(state, health, pod string) *trackedContainer {
381: 		return &trackedContainer{state: state, health: health, pod: pod}
382: 	}
383: 
384: 	tests := []struct {
385: 		name     string
386: 		previous *trackedContainer
387: 		next     *trackedContainer
388: 		want     string
389: 	}{
390: 		{"new pending node", nil, tracked(created, "", ""), "create"},
391: 		{
392: 			"new running node", nil, tracked(running, start, "p1"),
393: 			"create,start,health_status: starting",
394: 		},
395: 		{
396: 			"new ready node", nil, tracked(running, healthy, "p1"),
397: 			"create,start,health_status: healthy",
398: 		},
399: 		{"new stopped node", nil, tracked(exited, "", ""), "create,stop"},
400: 		{
401: 			"pod starts", tracked(created, "", "p1"), tracked(running, start, "p1"),
402: 			"start,health_status: starting",
403: 		},
404: 		{
405: 			"device ready", tracked(running, start, "p1"), tracked(running, healthy, "p1"),
406: 			"health_status: healthy",
407: 		},
408: 		{"still booting", tracked(running, start, "p1"), tracked(running, start, "p1"), ""},
409: 		{"no change", tracked(running, healthy, "p1"), tracked(running, healthy, "p1"), ""},
410: 		{
411: 			"device not ready again", tracked(running, healthy, "p1"), tracked(running, sick, "p1"),
412: 			"health_status: unhealthy",
413: 		},
414: 		{"stop", tracked(running, healthy, "p1"), tracked(exited, "", ""), "kill,stop,die"},
415: 		{
416: 			"start", tracked(exited, "", ""), tracked(running, healthy, "p2"),
417: 			"start,health_status: healthy",
418: 		},
419: 		{
420: 			"restart, new pod pending", tracked(running, healthy, "p1"), tracked(created, "", "p2"),
421: 			"kill,stop,die",
422: 		},
423: 		{
424: 			"restart, new pod running", tracked(running, healthy, "p1"),
425: 			tracked(running, start, "p2"), "kill,stop,die,start,health_status: starting",
426: 		},
427: 		{"stopped before it ran", tracked(created, "", "p1"), tracked(exited, "", ""), "stop"},
428: 		{"stopped node rescheduled", tracked(exited, "", ""), tracked(created, "", "p2"), ""},
429: 	}
430: 	for _, tt := range tests {
431: 		got := strings.Join(containerTransitionActions(tt.previous, tt.next), ",")
432: 		if got != tt.want {
433: 			t.Fatalf("%s: actions = %q, want %q", tt.name, got, tt.want)
434: 		}
435: 	}
436: 
437: 	if got := strings.Join(containerRemovalActions(tracked(running, healthy, "p1")), ","); got !=
438: 		"kill,die,destroy" {
439: 		t.Fatalf("removal of a running node = %q", got)
440: 	}
441: 	if got := strings.Join(
442: 		containerRemovalActions(tracked(exited, "", "")),
443: 		",",
444: 	); got != "destroy" {
445: 		t.Fatalf("removal of a stopped node = %q", got)
446: 	}
447: 
448: 	// health: a running node that was healthy and is not ready anymore in the same pod is
449: 	// unhealthy; in a new pod it starts again
450: 	previous := tracked(running, healthy, "p1")
451: 	if got := containerHealth(previous, tracked(running, "", "p1"), start); got != sick {
452: 		t.Fatalf("health in the same pod = %q", got)
453: 	}
454: 	if got := containerHealth(previous, tracked(running, "", "p2"), start); got != start {
455: 		t.Fatalf("health in a new pod = %q", got)
456: 	}
457: }

459: // trackerTestNode is a Node of lab1 in lab-ns.
460: func trackerTestNode(
461: 	name string,
462: 	runState string,
463: 	conditions ...map[string]any,
464: ) *unstructured.Unstructured {
465: 	status := map[string]any{
466: 		"readiness":        "notready",
467: 		"directContainers": []any{map[string]any{"name": "node-" + name, "id": name}},
468: 	}
469: 	rawConditions := []any{}
470: 	for _, condition := range conditions {
471: 		rawConditions = append(rawConditions, condition)
472: 		if condition["type"] == "Ready" && condition["status"] == "True" {
473: 			status["readiness"] = "ready"
474: 		}
475: 	}
476: 	status["conditions"] = rawConditions
477: 
478: 	return &unstructured.Unstructured{Object: map[string]any{
479: 		"apiVersion": c9sAPIVersion,
480: 		"kind":       "Node",
481: 		"metadata": map[string]any{
482: 			"name": name, "namespace": "lab-ns", "uid": "uid-" + name,
483: 			"labels": map[string]any{
484: 				labelTopologyOwner: "lab1", labelOriginalNodeName: strings.ToUpper(name),
485: 			},
486: 		},
487: 		"spec":   map[string]any{"kind": "linux", "image": "alpine", "runState": runState},
488: 		"status": status,
489: 	}}
490: }
491: 
492: func condition(conditionType, status string) map[string]any {
493: 	return map[string]any{"type": conditionType, "status": status}
494: }

496: func trackerTestPod(name string, phase corev1.PodPhase) *corev1.Pod {
497: 	pod := captureTestPod(name, "r1")
498: 	pod.Status.Phase = phase
499: 
500: 	return pod
501: }

503: type trackerHarness struct {
504: 	t       *testing.T
505: 	r       *Runtime
506: 	tracker *containerTracker
507: 	sink    chan clablabruntime.Event

510: func newTrackerHarness(
511: 	t *testing.T,
512: 	node *unstructured.Unstructured,
513: 	pods ...*corev1.Pod,
514: ) *trackerHarness {
515: 	t.Helper()
516: 
517: 	kubeObjects := make([]k8sruntime.Object, 0, len(pods))
518: 	for _, pod := range pods {
519: 		kubeObjects = append(kubeObjects, pod)
520: 	}
521: 	r := newTestRuntimeWithKubeObjects([]*unstructured.Unstructured{node}, kubeObjects)
522: 	r.labNamespaceOverride = "lab-ns"
523: 	sink := make(chan clablabruntime.Event, 64)
524: 
525: 	return &trackerHarness{
526: 		t: t, r: r, sink: sink,
527: 		tracker: &containerTracker{r: r, sink: sink, nodes: map[string]*trackedContainer{}},
528: 	}
529: }

569: // refresh reads lab1 again and returns the reported actions with their state attribute.
570: func (h *trackerHarness) refresh() string {
571: 	h.t.Helper()
572: 
573: 	if !h.tracker.refresh(context.Background(), labRef{namespace: "lab-ns", lab: "lab1"}) {
574: 		h.t.Fatal("refresh failed")
575: 	}
576: 
577: 	var actions []string
578: 	for _, ev := range drain(h.sink) {
579: 		if ev.Type != clablabruntime.EventTypeContainer || ev.ActorID != "lab-ns/lab1/r1" ||
580: 			ev.ActorFullID != "lab-ns/lab1/r1" || ev.ActorName != "lab1-r1" ||
581: 			ev.Lab == nil || ev.Node == nil || ev.Node.TopologyName != "R1" ||
582: 			ev.Attributes["lab"] != "lab1" || ev.Attributes["node"] != "r1" ||
583: 			ev.Attributes["namespace"] != "lab-ns" {
584: 			h.t.Fatalf("container event = %+v", ev)
585: 		}
586: 		action := ev.Action + "=" + ev.Attributes["state"]
587: 		if signal := ev.Attributes["signal"]; signal != "" {
588: 			action += "/" + signal
589: 		}
590: 		actions = append(actions, action)
591: 	}
592: 
593: 	return strings.Join(actions, ",")
594: }

596: // TestContainerTrackerReportsTheNodeLifecycle drives one node through boot, readiness, stop,
597: // start, restart and removal on the fake cluster and checks the Docker container events.
598: func TestContainerTrackerReportsTheNodeLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
599: 	t.Parallel()
600: 
601: 	node := trackerTestNode("r1", nodeRunStateRunning)
602: 	h := newTrackerHarness(t, node, trackerTestPod("lab1-r1-a", corev1.PodPending))
603: 	h.seed(true)
604: 	snapshot := drain(h.sink)
605: 	if len(snapshot) != 1 || snapshot[0].Action != "created" ||
606: 		snapshot[0].Attributes["origin"] != clablabruntime.EventOriginSnapshot ||
607: 		snapshot[0].Attributes["state"] != "created" {
608: 		t.Fatalf("snapshot = %+v", snapshot)
609: 	}
610: 
611: 	// the pod runs, the device boots
612: 	h.deletePod("lab1-r1-a")
613: 	h.addPod(trackerTestPod("lab1-r1-a", corev1.PodRunning))
614: 	if got := h.refresh(); got != "start=running,health_status: starting=running" {
615: 		t.Fatalf("pod running: %s", got)
616: 	}
617: 
618: 	// the device is ready
619: 	h.setNode(trackerTestNode("r1", nodeRunStateRunning,
620: 		condition("Ready", "True"), condition(nodeConditionContainersReady, "True")))
621: 	if got := h.refresh(); got != "health_status: healthy=running" {
622: 		t.Fatalf("ready: %s", got)
623: 	}
624: 	if got := h.refresh(); got != "" {
625: 		t.Fatalf("unchanged: %s", got)
626: 	}
627: 
628: 	// stop: the Node is stopped and its pod goes
629: 	h.setNode(trackerTestNode("r1", nodeRunStateStopped,
630: 		condition(nodeConditionStopped, "True")))
631: 	h.deletePod("lab1-r1-a")
632: 	if got := h.refresh(); got != "kill=running/15,stop=exited,die=exited" {
633: 		t.Fatalf("stop: %s", got)
634: 	}
635: 
636: 	// start: a new pod
637: 	h.setNode(trackerTestNode("r1", nodeRunStateRunning))
638: 	h.addPod(trackerTestPod("lab1-r1-b", corev1.PodPending))
639: 	if got := h.refresh(); got != "" {
640: 		t.Fatalf("start requested: %s", got)
641: 	}
642: 	h.deletePod("lab1-r1-b")
643: 	h.addPod(trackerTestPod("lab1-r1-b", corev1.PodRunning))
644: 	h.setNode(
645: 		trackerTestNode("r1", nodeRunStateRunning, condition(nodeConditionContainersReady, "True")),
646: 	)
647: 	if got := h.refresh(); got != "start=running,health_status: healthy=running" {
648: 		t.Fatalf("started: %s", got)
649: 	}
650: 
651: 	// restart: the pod is replaced
652: 	h.deletePod("lab1-r1-b")
653: 	h.addPod(trackerTestPod("lab1-r1-c", corev1.PodRunning))
654: 	if got := h.refresh(); got !=
655: 		"kill=running/15,stop=exited,die=exited,start=running,health_status: healthy=running" {
656: 		t.Fatalf("restart: %s", got)
657: 	}
658: 
659: 	// destroy
660: 	if err := h.r.client.Resource(nodeGVR).Namespace("lab-ns").
661: 		Delete(context.Background(), "r1", metav1.DeleteOptions{}); err != nil {
662: 		t.Fatal(err)
663: 	}
664: 	if got := h.refresh(); got != "kill=running/15,die=exited,destroy=exited" {
665: 		t.Fatalf("destroy: %s", got)
666: 	}
667: 	if len(h.tracker.nodes) != 0 {
668: 		t.Fatalf("destroyed node still tracked: %+v", h.tracker.nodes)
669: 	}
670: }

672: func TestContainerTrackerSeedsWithoutSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
673: 	t.Parallel()
674: 
675: 	h := newTrackerHarness(t, trackerTestNode("r1", nodeRunStateRunning,
676: 		condition("Ready", "True")), trackerTestPod("lab1-r1-a", corev1.PodRunning))
677: 	h.seed(false)
678: 	if events := drain(h.sink); len(events) != 0 {
679: 		t.Fatalf("seed without --initial-state reported %+v", events)
680: 	}
681: 	if got := h.refresh(); got != "" {
682: 		t.Fatalf("unchanged after seed: %s", got)
683: 	}
684: }

692: 		if deleted {
693: 			p.DeletionTimestamp = &deleting
694: 		}
695: 
696: 		return p
697: 	}
698: 
699: 	tests := []struct {
700: 		name          string
701: 		stopRequested bool
702: 		pod           *corev1.Pod
703: 		want          string
704: 	}{
705: 		{"no pod yet", false, nil, "created"},
706: 		{"pod scheduled, init containers", false, pod(corev1.PodPending, false), "created"},
707: 		{"device containers run", false, pod(corev1.PodRunning, false), "running"},
708: 		{"pod being deleted (restart)", false, pod(corev1.PodRunning, true), "exited"},
709: 		{"pod ended", false, pod(corev1.PodFailed, false), "exited"},
710: 		{"stop requested, pod terminating", true, pod(corev1.PodRunning, true), "exited"},
711: 		{"stopped", true, nil, "exited"},
712: 	}
713: 	for _, tt := range tests {
714: 		if got := nodeContainerState(tt.stopRequested, tt.pod); got != tt.want {
715: 			t.Fatalf("%s: %q, want %q", tt.name, got, tt.want)
716: 		}
717: 	}
718: }

822: 		t.Fatalf("Topology annotation = %q", got)
823: 	}
824: 	state, err := r.Inspect(context.Background(),
825: 		clablabruntime.InspectRequest{Name: "lab1", Namespace: "lab-ns"})
826: 	if err != nil {
827: 		t.Fatal(err)
828: 	}
829: 	if state.TopologyPath != "/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml" {
830: 		t.Fatalf("TopologyPath = %q", state.TopologyPath)
831: 	}
832: 
833: 	if _, err := r.Deploy(context.Background(),
834: 		sourceDeployRequest("/srv/labs/lab1.clab.yml", false)); err != nil {
835: 		t.Fatal(err)
836: 	}
837: 	topology = getTestTopology(t, r, "lab-ns", "lab1")
838: 	if got := topology.GetAnnotations()[annotationTopologyFile]; got != "/srv/labs/lab1.clab.yml" {
839: 		t.Fatalf("Topology annotation after a deploy from another file = %q", got)
840: 	}

842: 	// without a Topology resource: on the Nodes only, kept from their creation
843: 	r = newTestRuntime()
844: 	if _, err := r.Deploy(context.Background(),
845: 		sourceDeployRequest("/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml", true)); err != nil {
846: 		t.Fatal(err)
847: 	}
848: 	assertPrimitiveTopologyFile(t, r, "/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml")
849: 	state, err = r.Inspect(context.Background(),
850: 		clablabruntime.InspectRequest{Name: "lab1", Namespace: "lab-ns"})
851: 	if err != nil {
852: 		t.Fatal(err)
853: 	}
854: 	if state.TopologyPath != "/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml" {
855: 		t.Fatalf("TopologyPath without a Topology = %q", state.TopologyPath)
856: 	}

858: 	plan, err := r.Plan(context.Background(),
859: 		sourceDeployRequest("/srv/labs/lab1.clab.yml", true))
860: 	if err != nil {
861: 		t.Fatal(err)
862: 	}
863: 	for _, change := range plan.Changes {
864: 		if change.Kind == "Node" {
865: 			t.Fatalf("a deploy from another file would change %+v and replace its pod", change)
866: 		}
867: 	}
868: 	if _, err := r.Deploy(context.Background(),
869: 		sourceDeployRequest("/srv/labs/lab1.clab.yml", true)); err != nil {
870: 		t.Fatal(err)
871: 	}
872: 	assertPrimitiveTopologyFile(t, r, "/home/alice/labs/lab1.clab.yml")

875: func assertPrimitiveTopologyFile(t *testing.T, r *Runtime, want string) {
876: 	t.Helper()
877: 
878: 	for _, gvr := range []struct {
879: 		name string
880: 		want string
881: 	}{{"nodes", want}, {"links", ""}, {"nodeprofiles", ""}} {
882: 		resource := nodeGVR
883: 		switch gvr.name {
884: 		case "links":
885: 			resource = linkGVR
886: 		case "nodeprofiles":
887: 			resource = nodeProfileGVR
888: 		}
889: 		list, err := r.client.Resource(resource).Namespace("lab-ns").
890: 			List(context.Background(), metav1.ListOptions{})
891: 		if err != nil {
892: 			t.Fatal(err)
893: 		}
894: 		for idx := range list.Items {
895: 			if got := list.Items[idx].GetAnnotations()[annotationTopologyFile]; got != gvr.want {
896: 				t.Fatalf("%s %s annotation = %q, want %q", gvr.name, list.Items[idx].GetName(),
897: 					got, gvr.want)
898: 			}
899: 		}
900: 	}
901: }

938: 	newTopology := topologyObject("lab1", "lab-ns", "", "topology:\n")

940: 	updated = reconciledPrimitiveObject(topology, newTopology)
941: 	if got := updated.GetAnnotations()[annotationTopologyFile]; got != "/new.clab.yml" {

stats.Interface)\n\t}\n}\n\n// listingExec answers clabwire --list-interfaces with the listing of the pod and counts the\n// listings.\ntype listingExec struct {\n\tmu       sync.Mutex\n\tlistings pods kept: %+v\", p.listings)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestContainerTransitionActions(t *testing.T) {\n\tt.Parallel()\n\n\tconst (\n\t\tcreated = clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated\n\t\trunning = string\n\t}{\n\t\t{\"new pending node\", nil, tracked(created, \"\", \"\"), \"create\"},\n\t\t{\n\t\t\t\"new running node\", nil, tracked(running, start, \"p1\"),\n\t\t\t\"create,start,health_status: \"\", \"\"), \"create,stop\"},\n\t\t{\n\t\t\t\"pod starts\", tracked(created, \"\", \"p1\"), tracked(running, start, \"p1\"),\n\t\t\t\"start,health_status: starting\",\n\t\t},\n\t\t{\n\t\t\t\"device ready\", tracked(running, start, \"p1\"), tracked(running, healthy, \"p1\"),\n\t\t\t\"health_status: healthy\",\n\t\t},\n\t\t{\"still booting\", tracked(running, start, \"p1\"), tracked(running, start, \"p1\"), \"\"},\n\t\t{\"no change\", tracked(running, healthy, \"p1\"), tracked(running, healthy, \"p1\"), \"\"},\n\t\t{\n\t\t\t\"device not ready again\", tracked(running, healthy, \"p1\"), tracked(running, sick, \"p1\"),\n\t\t\t\"health_status: unhealthy\",\n\t\t},\n\t\t{\"stop\", tracked(running, healthy, \"p1\"), tracked(exited, \"\", \"\"), \"kill,stop,die\"},\n\t\t{\n\t\t\t\"start\", tracked(exited, \"\", \"\"), tracked(running, healthy, \"p2\"),\n\t\t\t\"start,health_status: healthy\",\n\t\t},\n\t\t{\n\t\t\t\"restart, new pod pending\", tracked(running, healthy, \"p1\"), tracked(created, \"\", \"p2\"),\n\t\t\t\"kill,stop,die\",\n\t\t},\n\t\t{\n\t\t\t\"restart, new pod running\", tracked(running, healthy, \"stop\"},\n\t\t{\"stopped node rescheduled\", tracked(exited, \"\", \"\"), tracked(created, \"\", \"p2\"), \"\"},\n\t}\n\tfor _, tt := range tests {\n\t\tgot := metav1.DeleteOptions{}); err != nil {\n\t\th.t.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (h *trackerHarness) addPod(pod *corev1.Pod) {\n\th.t.Helper()\n\n\tif _, err := reported actions with their state attribute.\nfunc (h *trackerHarness) refresh() string {\n\th.t.Helper()\n\n\tif !h.tracker.refresh(context.Background(), labRef{namespace: \"lab-ns\", lab: \"lab1\"}) 24: // The clabwire packet capture contract (clabernetes 0.11 or newer).
25: const (
26: 	clabwireContainer = "clabwire"
27: 	clabwireManager   = "/clabernetes/manager"
28: 	// captureAuditSchema is the schema of the JSON audit lines clabwire writes to stderr.
29: 	captureAuditSchema = "c9s.direct-packet-capture-audit/v1alpha1"
30: 
31: 	captureAuditStarted   = "Started"
32: 	captureAuditSucceeded = "Succeeded"
33: 	captureAuditFailed    = "Failed"
34: 	captureAuditDenied    = "Denied"
35: 
36: 	// maxCaptureSegment is the longest single clabwire capture; longer captures are chained.
37: 	maxCaptureSegment = time.Hour
38: 	// maxClabwirePackets is the packet limit of a single clabwire capture.
39: 	maxClabwirePackets = 1_000_000
40: 	// maxCaptureOverlap is how long two chained segments run side by side.
41: 	maxCaptureOverlap = 10 * time.Second
42: 	// maxCaptureCutWindow is the half-width of the window around the cut in which packets of
43: 	// two segments are matched by content; it covers the difference between the timestamps
44: 	// two clabwire processes give the same packet.
45: 	maxCaptureCutWindow = 500 * time.Millisecond
46: 	// minCaptureSegment is the shortest segment the chain requests.
47: 	minCaptureSegment = 100 * time.Millisecond
48: 	// captureEndGrace is how long a capture with a duration waits for its last clabwire
49: 	// process to end after the duration passed.
50: 	captureEndGrace = 30 * time.Second
51: 	// captureStartRetries bounds the attempts to start a follow-up segment.
52: 	captureStartRetries = 3
53: 	// captureStdinCloseGrace is how long a segment's exec may take to end after its stdin was
54: 	// closed before the stream is cut.
55: 	captureStdinCloseGrace = 3 * time.Second
56: 	// clabwireStopOnStdinClose makes clabwire end a capture when its stdin closes. A
57: 	// Kubernetes exec does not stop its process when the stream ends, but it closes the
58: 	// process's stdin, so every capture runs with stdin attached and this flag.
59: 	clabwireStopOnStdinClose = "--stop-on-stdin-close"
60: 
61: 	// envCaptureSegment overrides the segment length. It exists to exercise chaining in tests
62: 	// without hour-long captures.
63: 	envCaptureSegment = "CLAB_C9S_CAPTURE_SEGMENT"
64: 	// defaultCaptureReorderWindow is how long the merged stream holds a packet back so packets
65: 	// of other nodes stamped earlier but delivered later still go out before it.
66: 	defaultCaptureReorderWindow = 250 * time.Millisecond
67: 	// envCaptureReorderWindow overrides the reorder window; 0 writes packets as they arrive.
68: 	// It is an internal knob, not a supported setting.
69: 	envCaptureReorderWindow = "CLAB_C9S_CAPTURE_REORDER_WINDOW"

151: func captureSegmentFromEnv() time.Duration {
152: 	value, err := time.ParseDuration(os.Getenv(envCaptureSegment))
153: 	if err != nil || value <= 0 {
154: 		return 0
155: 	}
156: 
157: 	return value
158: }
159: 
160: // CaptureInterfaces lists the capturable lab link interfaces of the requested nodes, or of every
161: // node, as clabwire reports them, with their peers. Node names are reported as the topology
162: // spells them.
163: func (r *Runtime) CaptureInterfaces(
164: 	ctx context.Context,
165: 	req clablabruntime.NodeRequest,
166: ) ([]clablabruntime.CaptureInterface, error) {
167: 	r, err := r.connect(ctx, req.Identity)
168: 	if err != nil {
169: 		return nil, err
170: 	}
171: 
172: 	locations, err := r.LocateNode(ctx, clablabruntime.NodeRequest{
173: 		Name: req.Name, Namespace: req.Namespace, Nodes: req.Nodes, Identity: req.Identity,
174: 	})
175: 	if err != nil {
176: 		return nil, err
177: 	}
178: 	if len(req.Nodes) == 0 {
179: 		// a lab-wide listing skips nodes that do not run
180: 		running := locations[:0]
181: 		for _, location := range locations {
182: 			if location.Pod != "" {
183: 				running = append(running, location)
184: 			}
185: 		}
186: 		locations = running
187: 	}
188: 
189: 	listed, err := r.listCaptureInterfaces(ctx, req.Name, locations)
190: 	if err != nil {
191: 		return nil, err
192: 	}
193: 	names, err := r.nodeDisplayNames(ctx, req.Name, locations)
194: 	if err != nil {
195: 		return nil, err
196: 	}
197: 
198: 	result := make([]clablabruntime.CaptureInterface, 0)
199: 	for _, location := range locations {
200: 		for _, entry := range listed[location.NodeName] {
201: 			result = append(result, clablabruntime.CaptureInterface{
202: 				Node:          names.display(entry.Node),
203: 				Interface:     entry.Interface,
204: 				Alias:         entry.Alias,
205: 				PeerNode:      names.display(entry.PeerNode),
206: 				PeerInterface: entry.PeerInterface,
207: 			})
208: 		}
209: 	}
210: 	sort.SliceStable(result, func(i, j int) bool {
211: 		if result[i].Node != result[j].Node {
212: 			return result[i].Node < result[j].Node
213: 		}
214: 
215: 		return result[i].Interface < result[j].Interface
216: 	})
217: 
218: 	return result, nil
219: }
220: 
221: // listCaptureInterfaces runs one --list-interfaces per pod and returns the entries per Node.
222: func (r *Runtime) listCaptureInterfaces(
223: 	ctx context.Context,
224: 	lab string,
225: 	locations []clablabruntime.NodeLocation,
226: ) (map[string][]clabwireInterface, error) {
227: 	pods := map[string]clablabruntime.NodeLocation{}
228: 	wanted := map[string]bool{}
229: 	for _, location := range locations {
230: 		if location.Pod == "" {
231: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("c9s node %s/%s/%s has no pod; is it running?",
232: 				location.Namespace, lab, location.NodeName)
233: 		}
234: 		pods[location.Namespace+"/"+location.Pod] = location
235: 		wanted[location.NodeName] = true
236: 	}
237: 
238: 	var mu sync.Mutex
239: 	result := map[string][]clabwireInterface{}
240: 	group, groupCtx := errgroup.WithContext(ctx)
241: 	group.SetLimit(interfaceSampleWorkers)
242: 	for _, location := range pods {
243: 		group.Go(func() error {
244: 			entries, err := r.listPodInterfaces(groupCtx, location.Namespace, location.Pod)
245: 			if err != nil {
246: 				return err
247: 			}
248: 
249: 			mu.Lock()
250: 			defer mu.Unlock()
251: 			for _, entry := range entries {
252: 				if wanted[entry.Node] {
253: 					result[entry.Node] = append(result[entry.Node], entry)
254: 				}
255: 			}
256: 
257: 			return nil
258: 		})
259: 	}
260: 	if err := group.Wait(); err != nil {
261: 		return nil, err
262: 	}
263: 
264: 	return result, nil
265: }
266: 
267: // listPodInterfaces runs clabwire's --list-interfaces in a pod: the lab link interfaces of the
268: // pod's nodes, with their aliases and peers.
269: func (r *Runtime) listPodInterfaces(
270: 	ctx context.Context,
271: 	namespace, pod string,
272: ) ([]clabwireInterface, error) {
273: 	var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
274: 	err := r.execInPodContainer()(ctx, namespace, pod, clabwireContainer,
275: 		[]string{clabwireManager, "node-runtime", "packet-capture", "--list-interfaces"},
276: 		nil, &stdout, &stderr)
277: 	if err != nil {
278: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list the capturable interfaces of pod %s/%s: %w%s",
279: 			namespace, pod, err, stderrSuffix(stderr.Bytes()))
280: 	}
281: 
282: 	var entries []clabwireInterface
283: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(stdout.Bytes(), &entries); err != nil {
284: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse the capturable interfaces of pod %s/%s: %w",
285: 			namespace, pod, err)
286: 	}
287: 
288: 	return entries, nil
289: }
290: 
291: func stderrSuffix(stderr []byte) string {
292: 	text := strings.TrimSpace(string(stderr))
293: 	if text == "" {
294: 		return ""
295: 	}
296: 
297: 	return ": " + text
298: }
299: 
300: // nodeNames maps the node names the cluster carries to the names the topology file uses.
301: type nodeNames map[string]string
302: 
303: func (n nodeNames) display(name string) string {
304: 	if original := n[name]; original != "" {
305: 		return original
306: 	}
307: 
308: 	return name
309: }
310: 
311: // nodeDisplayNames reads the original node names from the c9s.run/originalNodeName label of the
312: // lab's Nodes.
313: func (r *Runtime) nodeDisplayNames(
314: 	ctx context.Context,
315: 	lab string,
316: 	locations []clablabruntime.NodeLocation,
317: ) (nodeNames, error) {
318: 	names := nodeNames{}
319: 	if len(locations) == 0 {
320: 		return names, nil
321: 	}
322: 
323: 	nodes, err := r.nodesForTopology(ctx, lab, locations[0].Namespace)
324: 	if err != nil {
325: 		return nil, err
326: 	}
327: 	for idx := range nodes.Items {
328: 		if original := nodes.Items[idx].GetLabels()[labelOriginalNodeName]; original != "" {
329: 			names[nodes.Items[idx].GetName()] = original
330: 		}
331: 	}
332: 
333: 	return names, nil
334: }
335: 
336: // captureGroup is the part of a capture one clabwire process serves: the requested interfaces of
337: // one node, in one pod.
338: type captureGroup struct {
339: 	location clablabruntime.NodeLocation
340: 	display  string
341: 	// interfaces are the planned interface names, in the order the merged stream lists them.
342: 	interfaces []string
343: 	// ids are the merged interface IDs of interfaces.
344: 	ids []uint32
345: }
346: 
347: // resolvedCapture is a validated capture request.
348: type resolvedCapture struct {
349: 	groups []*captureGroup
350: 	// names are the merged interface names (<node>:<interface>), indexed by merged ID.
351: 	names []string
352: }
353: 
354: // resolveCaptureTargets locates every target node, checks every interface against the
355: // interfaces clabwire allows, and groups the targets per node.
356: func (r *Runtime) resolveCaptureTargets(
357: 	ctx context.Context,
358: 	req clablabruntime.CaptureRequest,
359: ) (*resolvedCapture, error) {
360: 	nodeOrder := make([]string, 0, len(req.Targets))
361: 	seenNodes := map[string]bool{}
362: 	for _, target := range req.Targets {
363: 		if !seenNodes[target.Node] {
364: 			seenNodes[target.Node] = true
365: 			nodeOrder = append(nodeOrder, target.Node)
366: 		}
367: 	}
368: 
369: 	locations, err := r.LocateNode(ctx, clablabruntime.NodeRequest{
370: 		Name: req.Name, Namespace: req.Namespace, Nodes: nodeOrder, Identity: req.Identity,
371: 	})
372: 	if err != nil {
373: 		return nil, err
374: 	}
375: 	byRequest := make(map[string]clablabruntime.NodeLocation, len(nodeOrder))
376: 	for idx, name := range nodeOrder {
377: 		byRequest[name] = locations[idx]
378: 	}
379: 
380: 	listed, err := r.listCaptureInterfaces(ctx, req.Name, locations)
381: 	if err != nil {
382: 		return nil, err
383: 	}
384: 	names, err := r.nodeDisplayNames(ctx, req.Name, locations)
385: 	if err != nil {
386: 		return nil, err
387: 	}
388: 
389: 	resolved := &resolvedCapture{}
390: 	groups := map[string]*captureGroup{}
391: 	seen := map[string]bool{}
392: 	for _, target := range req.Targets {
393: 		location := byRequest[target.Node]
394: 		entry, ok := findCaptureInterface(listed[location.NodeName], target.Interface)
395: 		if !ok {
396: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("interface %q of node %q is not a capturable link "+
397: 				"interface; capturable: %s", target.Interface, target.Node,
398: 				describeCaptureInterfaces(listed[location.NodeName]))
399: 		}
400: 
401: 		key := location.NodeName + "\x00" + entry.Interface
402: 		if seen[key] {
403: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("interface %q of node %q is requested more than once",
404: 				entry.Interface, target.Node)
405: 		}
406: 		seen[key] = true
407: 
408: 		group := groups[location.NodeName]
409: 		if group == nil {
410: 			group = &captureGroup{
411: 				location: location,
412: 				display:  names.display(location.NodeName),
413: 			}
414: 			groups[location.NodeName] = group
415: 			resolved.groups = append(resolved.groups, group)
416: 		}
417: 
418: 		id := uint32(len(resolved.names)) //nolint:gosec // bounded by the targets
419: 		group.interfaces = append(group.interfaces, entry.Interface)
420: 		group.ids = append(group.ids, id)
421: 		resolved.names = append(resolved.names, group.display+":"+entry.Interface)
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	return resolved, nil
425: }
426: 
427: // findCaptureInterface matches a requested interface by its planned name or its alias.
428: func findCaptureInterface(entries []clabwireInterface, name string) (clabwireInterface, bool) {
429: 	for _, entry := range entries {
430: 		if entry.Interface == name {
431: 			return entry, true
432: 		}
433: 	}
434: 	for _, entry := range entries {
435: 		if entry.Alias != "" && entry.Alias == name {
436: 			return entry, true
437: 		}
438: 	}
439: 
440: 	return clabwireInterface{}, false
441: }
442: 
443: func describeCaptureInterfaces(entries []clabwireInterface) string {
444: 	if len(entries) == 0 {
445: 		return "none"
446: 	}
447: 
448: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(entries))
449: 	for _, entry := range entries {
450: 		name := entry.Interface
451: 		if entry.Alias != "" {
452: 			name += " (" + entry.Alias + ")"
453: 		}
454: 		names = append(names, name)
455: 	}
456: 
457: 	return strings.Join(names, ", ")
458: }
459: 
460: // Capture streams pcapng from lab link interfaces to w: one section, one Interface Description
461: // Block per target in request order named <node>:<interface>, then the packets of every target.
462: //
463: // Each node's interfaces are captured by one clabwire process in the node's pod. clabwire limits
464: // a capture to one hour, so a longer capture (or one without Duration) chains captures: the next
465: // one starts before the current one ends, and the stream switches at a cut in the overlap. See
466: // captureChain for how packets of the overlap are kept once.
467: //
468: // Packets go out in timestamp order across nodes, through a reorder buffer (captureReorder).
469: //
470: // Every clabwire process runs with stdin attached and --stop-on-stdin-close: a Kubernetes exec
471: // does not stop its process when the stream closes, so containerlab closes stdin whenever a
472: // segment ends (the capture ends, fails, its output fails, or a newer segment took over) and
473: // clabwire ends the capture itself.
474: //
475: // Capture returns when Duration has passed, PacketLimit packets were written, or ctx ends; an
476: // ended ctx is not an error. Every block reaches w in one write, so the stream is a valid capture
477: // whenever it stops. A clabwire Denied or Failed audit record is returned as an error.
478: func (r *Runtime) Capture(
479: 	ctx context.Context,
480: 	req clablabruntime.CaptureRequest,
481: 	w io.Writer,
482: ) error {
483: 	if err := clabcapture.ValidateRequest(&req); err != nil {
484: 		return err
485: 	}
486: 
487: 	r, err := r.connect(ctx, req.Identity)
488: 	if err != nil {
489: 		return err
490: 	}
491: 
492: 	resolved, err := r.resolveCaptureTargets(ctx, req)
493: 	if err != nil {
494: 		return err
495: 	}
496: 
497: 	captureCtx, stop := context.WithCancel(ctx)
498: 	defer stop()
499: 
500: 	out, err := clabcapture.NewOutput(w, resolved.names, req.SnapLength, req.PacketLimit,
501: 		r.captureReorderWindowLength(), stop)
502: 	if err != nil {
503: 		return err
504: 	}
505: 
506: 	run := &captureRun{
507: 		r:       r,
508: 		req:     req,
509: 		out:     out,
510: 		segment: r.captureSegmentLength(),
511: 	}
512: 	if req.Duration > 0 {
513: 		run.deadline = time.Now().Add(req.Duration)
514: 	}
515: 	run.overlap = min(maxCaptureOverlap, run.segment/3)
516: 	run.window = min(maxCaptureCutWindow, run.overlap/4)
517: 
518: 	if req.Duration > 0 {
519: 		// a clabwire process that does not end on its own does not hold the capture open
520: 		var cancelTimeout context.CancelFunc
521: 		captureCtx, cancelTimeout = context.WithTimeout(captureCtx,
522: 			req.Duration+run.overlap+captureEndGrace)
523: 		defer cancelTimeout()
524: 	}
525: 
526: 	group, groupCtx := errgroup.WithContext(captureCtx)
527: 	for _, captureGroup := range resolved.groups {
528: 		chain := &captureChain{capture: run, group: captureGroup}
529: 		group.Go(func() error {
530: 			return chain.run(groupCtx)
531: 		})
532: 	}
533: 
534: 	err = group.Wait()
535: 	if writeErr := out.Close(); writeErr != nil {
536: 		return writeErr
537: 	}
538: 	if err != nil && !(errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) && captureCtx.Err() != nil) {
539: 		return err
540: 	}
541: 
542: 	return nil
543: }
544: 
545: // captureRun is the state a capture's chains share.
546: type captureRun struct {
547: 	r   *Runtime
548: 	req clablabruntime.CaptureRequest
549: 	// out is the merged stream; it writes the packets of every chain in timestamp order and
550: 	// stops every chain once the packet limit is reached.
551: 	out *clabcapture.Output
552: 
553: 	segment  time.Duration
554: 	overlap  time.Duration
555: 	window   time.Duration
556: 	deadline time.Time
557: }
558: 
559: // emit writes a packet under its merged interface ID. It reports false once the packet limit is
560: // reached and the capture stops.
561: func (run *captureRun) emit(id uint32, packet *clabcapture.Packet) (bool, error) {
562: 	return run.out.Emit(id, packet)
563: }
564: 
565: func (run *captureRun) reportGap(gap clablabruntime.CaptureGap) {
566: 	clabcapture.ReportGap(run.req.OnGap, gap)
567: }
568: 
569: // captureSegment is one clabwire capture process of a chain.
570: type captureSegment struct {
571: 	index      int
572: 	localStart time.Time
573: 	duration   time.Duration
574: 	cancel     context.CancelFunc
575: 	// closeStdin closes the stdin of the segment's clabwire process, which ends it; it may be
576: 	// called any number of times.
577: 	closeStdin func()
578: 	// stopTimer closes stdin once the segment is no longer needed after a switch-over.
579: 	stopTimer *time.Timer
580: 	// started and ended are the pod-clock times of the Started and Succeeded audit records.
581: 	started time.Time
582: 	ended   time.Time
583: 	done    bool
584: }
585: 
586: func (s *captureSegment) plannedEnd() time.Time {
587: 	return s.started.Add(s.duration)
588: }
589: 
590: // segmentEvent is something a segment reported: a packet, an audit record, or its end.
591: type segmentEvent struct {
592: 	segment *captureSegment
593: 	packet  *clabcapture.Packet
594: 	audit   *captureAudit
595: 	done    bool
596: 	err     error
597: }
598: 
599: // captureChain runs the chained clabwire captures of one group.
600: //
601: // Chaining and the cut: segment k+1 starts `overlap` before segment k is due to end, so both
602: // capture the same packets for a while. clabwire stamps packets when it reads them, so two
603: // processes give the same packet timestamps a few microseconds apart, and timestamps alone
604: // cannot pair them. The chain therefore cuts in the middle of the overlap and matches packets by
605: // content close to the cut:
606: //
607: //  1. When segment k+1 reports Started (pod clock, from its audit record), the cut is
608: //     T = midpoint of [Started(k+1), Started(k) + duration(k)]: both segments run then.
609: //  2. Segment k keeps streaming live, but only packets stamped before T; it remembers the
610: //     content of what it wrote since segment k+1 started.
611: //  3. Segment k+1's packets are held back until segment k has ended. Then the ones stamped
612: //     before T-W are dropped (segment k had them), the ones stamped within W of T are dropped
613: //     when segment k wrote the same bytes on the same interface, and every other one is written.
614: //     From then on segment k+1 streams live.
615: //
616: // Once the pod clock passed T+W, segment k's stdin is closed so it ends without running to its
617: // planned end. While packets are held back, the chain holds the reorder buffer at T-W, so other
618: // nodes' later packets do not overtake them in the merged stream.
619: //
620: // W (500 ms, less for short test segments) covers the stamping difference. Identical frames on
621: // the same interface within W of the cut can be paired with each other, which can drop a true
622: // repeat; nothing else is lost or doubled. A follow-up segment that does not start in time leaves
623: // a gap, which is reported through CaptureRequest.OnGap (or logged), never silently ignored.
624: type captureChain struct {
625: 	capture *captureRun
626: 	group   *captureGroup
627: 
628: 	events chan segmentEvent
629: 	wg     sync.WaitGroup
630: 
631: 	active *captureSegment
632: 	next   *captureSegment
633: 	// cut is the switch time between active and next, in nanoseconds; zero until known.
634: 	cut int64
635: 	// emitted remembers the content of the packets active wrote while next runs.
636: 	emitted map[uint64]int
637: 	// held are the packets of next until active ends.
638: 	held     []*clabcapture.Packet
639: 	segments int
640: 	retries  int
641: 	// final is set once no further segment is due.
642: 	final bool
643: 	// stopping is set once ctx ended: the segments are asked to end and what they still
644: 	// deliver is written.
645: 	stopping bool
646: }
647: 
648: // run runs the chain until its last segment ended. When ctx ends, it stops the segments and
649: // keeps writing the packets they read until then; a segment that does not end within
650: // captureStdinCloseGrace is cut.
651: func (c *captureChain) run(ctx context.Context) error {
652: 	c.events = make(chan segmentEvent, 256)
653: 	// the segments outlive ctx so they can deliver their last packets; segmentsCtx cuts them
654: 	segmentsCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.WithoutCancel(ctx))
655: 	var abort *time.Timer
656: 	defer func() {
657: 		if abort != nil {
658: 			abort.Stop()
659: 		}
660: 		cancel()
661: 		c.drain()
662: 		c.capture.out.Release(c)
663: 	}()
664: 
665: 	c.active = c.start(segmentsCtx, c.segmentDuration(time.Now()))
666: 	timer := time.NewTimer(c.nextStartIn())
667: 	defer timer.Stop()
668: 
669: 	done := ctx.Done()
670: 	for {
671: 		select {
672: 		case <-done:
673: 			done = nil
674: 			c.stop(timer)
675: 			abort = time.AfterFunc(captureStdinCloseGrace, cancel)
676: 		case <-segmentsCtx.Done():
677: 			return nil
678: 		case <-timer.C:
679: 			if c.next == nil && !c.final {
680: 				c.startNext(segmentsCtx)
681: 			}
682: 		case event := <-c.events:
683: 			stop, err := c.handle(segmentsCtx, event, timer)
684: 			if err != nil || stop {
685: 				return err
686: 			}
687: 		}
688: 	}
689: }
690: 
691: // stop ends the chain early, like a deadline would: no further segment starts and the running
692: // ones are asked to end. The chain then writes what they deliver until they ended.
693: func (c *captureChain) stop(timer *time.Timer) {
694: 	c.stopping = true
695: 	c.final = true
696: 	timer.Stop()
697: 	c.active.closeStdin()
698: 	if c.next != nil {
699: 		c.next.closeStdin()
700: 	}
701: }
702: 
703: // drain waits for the segment goroutines after the chain ended.
704: func (c *captureChain) drain() {
705: 	done := make(chan struct{})
706: 	go func() {
707: 		c.wg.Wait()
708: 		close(done)
709: 	}()
710: 	for {
711: 		select {
712: 		case <-done:
713: 			return
714: 		case <-c.events:
715: 		}
716: 	}
717: }
718: 
719: // segmentDuration is the requested duration of a segment starting now.
720: func (c *captureChain) segmentDuration(now time.Time) time.Duration {
721: 	duration := c.capture.segment
722: 	if !c.capture.deadline.IsZero() {
723: 		duration = min(duration, c.capture.deadline.Sub(now))
724: 	}
725: 
726: 	return max(duration, minCaptureSegment)
727: }
728: 
729: // nextStartIn is the time until the follow-up of the active segment is due. It marks the chain
730: // final when none is due.
731: func (c *captureChain) nextStartIn() time.Duration {
732: 	if c.stopping {
733: 		c.final = true
734: 		return maxCaptureSegment
735: 	}
736: 	activeEnd := c.active.localStart.Add(c.active.duration)
737: 	if !c.capture.deadline.IsZero() &&
738: 		!activeEnd.Before(c.capture.deadline.Add(-c.capture.window)) {
739: 		c.final = true
740: 		return maxCaptureSegment
741: 	}
742: 	c.final = false
743: 
744: 	return max(time.Until(activeEnd.Add(-c.capture.overlap)), 0)
745: }
746: 
747: func (c *captureChain) startNext(ctx context.Context) {
748: 	c.next = c.start(ctx, c.segmentDuration(time.Now()))
749: 	c.emitted = map[uint64]int{}
750: 	c.held = nil
751: 	c.cut = 0
752: }
753: 
754: func (c *captureChain) handle(
755: 	ctx context.Context,
756: 	event segmentEvent,
757: 	timer *time.Timer,
758: ) (bool, error) {
759: 	segment := event.segment
760: 
761: 	switch {
762: 	case event.audit != nil:
763: 		return false, c.handleAudit(segment, event.audit)
764: 	case event.packet != nil:
765: 		return c.handlePacket(segment, event.packet)
766: 	case event.done:
767: 		segment.done = true
768: 		if segment.stopTimer != nil {
769: 			segment.stopTimer.Stop()
770: 		}
771: 		if event.err != nil && !c.stopping {

796: func (c *captureChain) handleAudit(segment *captureSegment, audit *captureAudit) error {
797: 	switch audit.Status {
798: 	case captureAuditStarted:
799: 		segment.started = audit.Time
800: 		log.Debug("Capture segment started", "node", c.group.display, "segment", segment.index,
801: 			"interfaces", strings.Join(c.group.interfaces, ","), "duration", segment.duration)
802: 		if segment == c.next && !c.active.started.IsZero() {
803: 			c.setCut()
804: 		}
805: 		if segment == c.next {
806: 			c.retries = 0
807: 		}
808: 	case captureAuditSucceeded:
809: 		segment.ended = audit.Time
810: 		log.Debug("Capture segment succeeded", "node", c.group.display,
811: 			"segment", segment.index, "packets", audit.Packets)
812: 	case captureAuditDenied, captureAuditFailed:
813: 		return captureAuditError(c.group.display, audit)
814: 	}
815: 
816: 	return nil
817: }

819: // captureAuditError turns a Denied or Failed clabwire audit record into an error.
820: func captureAuditError(node string, audit *captureAudit) error {
821: 	verb := "failed"

823: 		verb = "was denied"
824: 	}
825: 	interfaces := make([]string, 0, len(audit.Interfaces))
826: 	for _, intf := range audit.Interfaces {

834: // setCut places the cut in the middle of the overlap of the active and the next segment, both
835: // measured on the pod clock.
836: func (c *captureChain) setCut() {
837: 	overlapStart := c.next.started
838: 	overlapEnd := c.active.plannedEnd()
839: 	if overlapEnd.Sub(overlapStart) < 2*c.capture.window {
840: 		// the overlap is too short to match packets around a cut: the switch is reported as a
841: 		// gap once the active segment ended
842: 		c.cut = 0
843: 		return
844: 	}
845: 	c.cut = overlapStart.Add(overlapEnd.Sub(overlapStart) / 2).UnixNano()
846: 
847: 	window := c.capture.window.Nanoseconds()
848: 	// Packets the next segment holds back are stamped from T-W on: other chains' packets after
849: 	// that wait in the reorder buffer until the switch, so the merged stream stays in order.
850: 	c.capture.out.Hold(c, c.cut-window)
851: 
852: 	// The active segment only matters for packets stamped before T. Once the pod clock passed
853: 	// T+W, it is closed: packets it read until then are still delivered, and the ones it reads
854: 	// later are stamped after T and dropped anyway. The next segment's Started record was
855: 	// written on the pod clock no later than now, so the pod clock passes T+W no later than
856: 	// (T - Started + W) from now.
857: 	active := c.active
858: 	active.stopTimer = time.AfterFunc(
859: 		time.Duration(c.cut-c.next.started.UnixNano()+window), active.closeStdin)
860: }

862: func (c *captureChain) handlePacket(
863: 	segment *captureSegment,
864: 	packet *clabcapture.Packet,
865: ) (bool, error) {
866: 	switch segment {
867: 	case c.active:
868: 		if c.cut != 0 && packet.Timestamp >= c.cut {
869: 			return false, nil
870: 		}
871: 		if c.next != nil {
872: 			c.emitted[packetKey(packet)]++
873: 		}
874: 
875: 		return c.emit(packet)
876: 	case c.next:
877: 		c.held = append(c.held, packet)
878: 	}
879: 
880: 	return false, nil
881: }

883: func (c *captureChain) emit(packet *clabcapture.Packet) (bool, error) {
884: 	if int(packet.InterfaceID) >= len(c.group.ids) {
885: 		return true, fmt.Errorf("clabwire wrote a packet for interface %d of %d",
886: 			packet.InterfaceID, len(c.group.ids))
887: 	}
888: 	more, err := c.capture.emit(c.group.ids[packet.InterfaceID], packet)
889: 
890: 	return !more, err
891: }

893: // switchSegments makes the next segment the active one after the active one ended, writing the
894: // held packets of the next one that the active one did not write.
895: func (c *captureChain) switchSegments(ctx context.Context, timer *time.Timer) (bool, error) {
896: 	// the held packets are in the reorder buffer once this returns
897: 	defer c.capture.out.Release(c)
898: 
899: 	ended := c.active
900: 	if c.stopping && c.next != nil && c.next.started.IsZero() {
901: 		// the chain is stopping: a follow-up that has not started takes nothing over
902: 		c.next, c.held, c.emitted, c.cut = nil, nil, nil, 0
903: 	}
904: 	if c.final && c.next == nil {
905: 		return true, nil
906: 	}
907: 
908: 	if c.next == nil || c.next.started.IsZero() || c.cut == 0 {
909: 		from := ended.ended
910: 		if from.IsZero() {
911: 			from = ended.plannedEnd()
912: 		}
913: 		gap := clablabruntime.CaptureGap{
914: 			Node: c.group.display, Interfaces: c.group.interfaces, From: from,
915: 			Reason: "the follow-up capture did not overlap the previous one",
916: 		}
917: 		if c.next != nil && !c.next.started.IsZero() {
918: 			gap.To = c.next.started
919: 		}
920: 		c.capture.reportGap(gap)
921: 	}
922: 
923: 	if c.next != nil && c.next.done && !c.stopping {
924: 		// the follow-up already ended (it started too late to take over): keep what it
925: 		// captured and continue with a fresh segment
926: 		for _, packet := range c.held {
927: 			if stop, err := c.emit(packet); stop || err != nil {
928: 				return true, err
929: 			}
930: 		}
931: 		c.next, c.held, c.emitted, c.cut = nil, nil, nil, 0
932: 	}
933: 
934: 	if c.next == nil {
935: 		if !c.capture.deadline.IsZero() &&
936: 			!time.Now().Before(c.capture.deadline.Add(-c.capture.window)) {
937: 			return true, nil
938: 		}
939: 		c.active = c.start(ctx, c.segmentDuration(time.Now()))
940: 		resetTimer(timer, c.nextStartIn())
941: 
942: 		return false, nil
943: 	}
944: 
945: 	window := c.capture.window.Nanoseconds()
946: 	for _, packet := range c.held {
947: 		if c.cut != 0 {
948: 			if packet.Timestamp < c.cut-window {
949: 				continue
950: 			}
951: 			if packet.Timestamp < c.cut+window {
952: 				key := packetKey(packet)
953: 				if c.emitted[key] > 0 {
954: 					c.emitted[key]--
955: 					continue
956: 				}
957: 			}
958: 		}
959: 		if stop, err := c.emit(packet); stop || err != nil {
960: 			return true, err
961: 		}
962: 	}
963: 
964: 	c.active, c.next = c.next, nil
965: 	c.held, c.emitted, c.cut = nil, nil, 0
966: 	if c.active.done {
967: 		// the chain is stopping and the follow-up ended before the active one
968: 		return true, nil
969: 	}
970: 	resetTimer(timer, c.nextStartIn())
971: 
972: 	return false, nil
973: }

975: func resetTimer(timer *time.Timer, d time.Duration) {
976: 	if !timer.Stop() {
977: 		select {
978: 		case <-timer.C:
979: 		default:
980: 		}
981: 	}
982: 	timer.Reset(d)
983: }

985: // packetKey identifies a packet by its interface and content.
986: func packetKey(packet *clabcapture.Packet) uint64 {
987: 	hash := fnv.New64a()
988: 	var id [4]byte
989: 	id[0] = byte(packet.InterfaceID)
990: 	id[1] = byte(packet.InterfaceID >> 8)
991: 	_, _ = hash.Write(id[:])
992: 	_, _ = hash.Write(packet.Data)
993: 
994: 	return hash.Sum64()
995: }

997: // start runs one clabwire capture and reports its packets, audit records and end as events.
998: func (c *captureChain) start(ctx context.Context, duration time.Duration) *captureSegment {
999: 	segmentCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
1000: 	stdinReader, stdinWriter := io.Pipe()
1001: 	segment := &captureSegment{
1002: 		index: c.segments, localStart: time.Now(), duration: duration, cancel: cancel,
1003: 		closeStdin: func() { _ = stdinWriter.Close() },
1004: 	}
1005: 	c.segments++
1006: 
1007: 	command := []string{
1008: 		clabwireManager, "node-runtime", "packet-capture",
1009: 		"--nodeName", c.group.location.NodeName,
1010: 		"--format", "pcapng",
1011: 		"--snapLength", strconv.Itoa(c.capture.req.SnapLength),
1012: 		"--duration", duration.String(),
1013: 		clabwireStopOnStdinClose,
1014: 	}
1015: 	for _, name := range c.group.interfaces {
1016: 		command = append(command, "--interface", name)
1017: 	}
1018: 	if c.capture.req.PacketLimit > 0 {
1019: 		remaining := int64(c.capture.req.PacketLimit) - c.capture.out.Written()
1020: 		command = append(command, "--packetLimit",
1021: 			strconv.FormatInt(min(max(remaining, 1), maxClabwirePackets), 10))
1022: 	}
1023: 
1024: 	send := func(event segmentEvent) {
1025: 		event.segment = segment
1026: 		select {
1027: 		case c.events <- event:
1028: 		case <-segmentCtx.Done():
1029: 		}
1030: 	}
1031: 
1032: 	stdoutReader, stdoutWriter := io.Pipe()
1033: 	stderr := &auditLineWriter{send: func(audit *captureAudit) { send(segmentEvent{audit: audit}) }}
1034: 
1035: 	// The exec outlives the segment's context by up to captureStdinCloseGrace: when the segment
1036: 	// ends for any reason (the capture is cancelled or failed, the output failed, or a newer
1037: 	// segment took over), its stdin is closed first so clabwire ends on its own, and the stream
1038: 	// is cut only if it does not.
1039: 	execCtx, cancelExec := context.WithCancel(context.WithoutCancel(segmentCtx))
1040: 	execDone := make(chan struct{})
1041: 
1042: 	c.wg.Add(3)
1043: 	readDone := make(chan error, 1)
1044: 	go func() {
1045: 		defer c.wg.Done()
1046: 		readDone <- c.readSegment(stdoutReader, func(packet *clabcapture.Packet) {
1047: 			send(segmentEvent{packet: packet})
1048: 		})
1049: 		_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, stdoutReader)
1050: 	}()
1051: 	go func() {
1052: 		defer c.wg.Done()
1053: 		select {
1054: 		case <-execDone:
1055: 			return
1056: 		case <-segmentCtx.Done():
1057: 		}
1058: 		segment.closeStdin()
1059: 		grace := time.NewTimer(captureStdinCloseGrace)
1060: 		defer grace.Stop()
1061: 		select {
1062: 		case <-execDone:
1063: 		case <-grace.C:
1064: 			log.Debug("Capture segment did not end after its stdin closed, cutting the stream",
1065: 				"node", c.group.display, "segment", segment.index)
1066: 			cancelExec()
1067: 		}
1068: 	}()
1069: 	go func() {
1070: 		defer c.wg.Done()
1071: 		defer cancel()
1072: 		defer cancelExec()
1073: 
1074: 		err := c.capture.r.execInPodContainer()(execCtx, c.group.location.Namespace,
1075: 			c.group.location.Pod, clabwireContainer, command, stdinReader, stdoutWriter, stderr)
1076: 		close(execDone)
1077: 		// the process ended: release the stdin copy of the exec stream
1078: 		segment.closeStdin()
1079: 		_ = stdoutWriter.Close()
1080: 		readErr := <-readDone
1081: 		stderr.flush()
1082: 		if err == nil && readErr != nil {
1083: 			err = readErr
1084: 		}
1085: 		if err != nil && stderr.text() != "" {
1086: 			if unsupported := unsupportedClabwire(
1087: 				c.group.location,
1088: 				stderr.text(),
1089: 			); unsupported != nil {
1090: 				err = unsupported
1091: 			} else {
1092: 				err = fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", err, stderr.text())
1093: 			}
1094: 		}
1095: 		send(segmentEvent{done: true, err: err})
1096: 	}()
1097: 
1098: 	return segment
1099: }

1101: // unsupportedClabwire recognizes a clabwire that rejects --stop-on-stdin-close, which every
1102: // capture passes: its release predates the capture contract the runtime needs.
1103: func unsupportedClabwire(location clablabruntime.NodeLocation, stderr string) error {
1104: 	if !strings.Contains(stderr, "flag provided but not defined") ||
1105: 		!strings.Contains(stderr, strings.TrimPrefix(clabwireStopOnStdinClose, "-")) {
1106: 		return nil
1107: 	}
1108: 
1109: 	return &unsupportedClabernetesError{reason: fmt.Sprintf(
1110: 		"clabwire in pod %s/%s does not accept packet-capture %s",
1111: 		location.Namespace, location.Pod, clabwireStopOnStdinClose)}
1112: }

1114: // readSegment checks that a segment's interfaces are the requested ones and passes its packets
1115: // on with the segment's interface index.
1116: func (c *captureChain) readSegment(stdout io.Reader, packet func(*clabcapture.Packet)) error {
1117: 	reader := clabcapture.NewReader(stdout)
1118: 	interfaces := 0
1119: 	for {
1120: 		event, err := reader.Next()
1121: 		if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
1122: 			return nil
1123: 		}
1124: 		if errors.Is(err, io.ErrUnexpectedEOF) {
1125: 			// the process was stopped inside a block
1126: 			return nil
1127: 		}
1128: 		if err != nil {
1129: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to read the clabwire capture: %w", err)
1130: 		}
1131: 		if event.Interface != nil {
1132: 			if interfaces >= len(c.group.interfaces) ||
1133: 				event.Interface.Name != c.group.interfaces[interfaces] {
1134: 				return fmt.Errorf("clabwire described interface %q, want %s in order",
1135: 					event.Interface.Name, strings.Join(c.group.interfaces, ", "))
1136: 			}
1137: 			interfaces++
1138: 			continue
1139: 		}
1140: 		if event.Packet != nil {
1141: 			packet(event.Packet)
1142: 		}
1143: 	}
1144: }

1146: // auditLineWriter parses clabwire's stderr: audit records go to send, other lines are kept for
1147: // error messages.
1148: type auditLineWriter struct {
1149: 	send func(*captureAudit)
1150: 
1151: 	mu      sync.Mutex
1152: 	partial []byte
1153: 	other   []string
1154: }
1155: 
1156: func (w *auditLineWriter) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
1157: 	w.mu.Lock()
1158: 	w.partial = append(w.partial, data...)
1159: 	var lines [][]byte
1160: 	for {
1161: 		idx := bytes.IndexByte(w.partial, '\n')
1162: 		if idx < 0 {
1163: 			break
1164: 		}
1165: 		lines = append(lines, append([]byte(nil), w.partial[:idx]...))
1166: 		w.partial = w.partial[idx+1:]
1167: 	}
1168: 	w.mu.Unlock()
1169: 
1170: 	for _, line := range lines {
1171: 		w.line(line)
1172: 	}
1173: 
1174: 	return len(data), nil
1175: }
1176: 
1177: func (w *auditLineWriter) flush() {
1178: 	w.mu.Lock()
1179: 	line := w.partial
1180: 	w.partial = nil
1181: 	w.mu.Unlock()
1182: 	if len(bytes.TrimSpace(line)) != 0 {
1183: 		w.line(line)
1184: 	}
1185: }
1186: 
1187: func (w *auditLineWriter) line(line []byte) {
1188: 	line = bytes.TrimSpace(line)
1189: 	if len(line) == 0 {
1190: 		return
1191: 	}
1192: 
1193: 	var audit captureAudit
1194: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(
1195: 		line,
1196: 		&audit,
1197: 	); err == nil &&
1198: 		audit.SchemaVersion == captureAuditSchema {
1199: 		w.send(&audit)
1200: 		return
1201: 	}
1202: 
1203: 	w.mu.Lock()
1204: 	defer w.mu.Unlock()
1205: 	if len(w.other) < 20 {
1206: 		w.other = append(w.other, string(line))
1207: 	}
1208: }
1209: 
1210: func (w *auditLineWriter) text() string {
1211: 	w.mu.Lock()
1212: 	defer w.mu.Unlock()
1213: 
1214: 	return strings.Join(w.other, "; ")
1215: }
