A nonzero exit returns\n73: // a *labruntime.CommandExitError.\n74: type podExecFunc func(\n75: \tctx context.Context,\n76: \tnamespace, pod, container string,\n77: \tcommand []string,\n78: \tstdin io.Reader,\n79: \tstdout, stderr io.Writer,\n80: ) error\n81: \n82: // clabwireInterface is one entry of `packet-capture --list-interfaces`.\n83: type clabwireInterface struct {\n84: \tNode          string `json:\"node\"`\n85: \tInterface     string `json:\"interface\"`\n86: \tAlias         string `json:\"alias,omitempty\"`\n87: \tPeerNode      string `json:\"peerNode\"`\n88: \tPeerInterface string `json:\"peerInterface\"`\n89: }\n90: \n91: // captureAudit is one clabwire audit line.\n92: type captureAudit struct {\n93: \tSchemaVersion string    `json:\"schemaVersion\"`\n94: \tTime          time.Time `json:\"time\"`\n95: \tStatus        string    `json:\"status\"`\n96: \tNodeName      string    `json:\"nodeName\"`\n97: \tFormat        string    `json:\"format\"`\n98: \tReason        string    `json:\"reason\"`\n99: \tPackets       int       `json:\"packets\"`\n100: \tInterfaces    []struct {\n101: \t\tName    string `json:\"name\"`\n102: \t\tID      string `json:\"id\"`\n103: \t\tPackets int    `json:\"packets\"`\n104: \t} `json:\"interfaces\"`\n105: }\n106: \n107: func (r *Runtime) execInPodContainer() podExecFunc {\n108: \tif r.podExec != nil {\n109: \t\treturn r.podExec\n110: \t}\n111: \n112: \treturn r.streamPodExec\n113: }\n114: \n115: // captureSegmentLength is the length of one clabwire capture before the next takes over.\n116: func (r *Runtime) captureSegmentLength() time.Duration {\n117: \tif r.captureSegment > 0 && r.captureSegment <= maxCaptureSegment {\n118: \t\treturn r.captureSegment\n119: \t}\n120: \n121: \treturn maxCaptureSegment\n122: }\n123: \n124: // captureReorderWindowLength is the reorder window of the merged stream; zero disables\n125: // reordering.\n126: func (r *Runtime) captureReorderWindowLength() time.Duration {\n127: \tswitch {\n128: \tcase r.captureReorderWindow < 0:\n129: \t\treturn 0\n130: \tcase r.captureReorderWindow > 0:\n131: \t\treturn r.captureReorderWindow\n132: \t}\n133: \n134: \treturn defaultCaptureReorderWindow\n135: }\n136: \n137: // captureReorderWindowFromEnv reads the reorder window knob: unset or invalid keeps the\n138: // default (0), \"0\" disables reordering (-1).\n139: func captureReorderWindowFromEnv() time.Duration {\n140: \tvalue, err := time.ParseDuration(os.Getenv(envCaptureReorderWindow))\n141: \tswitch {\n142: \tcase err != nil || value < 0:\n143: \t\treturn 0\n144: \tcase value == 0:\n145: \t\treturn -1\n146: \t}\n147: \n148: \treturn value\n149: }\n150: \n151: func captureSegmentFromEnv() time.Duration {\n152: \tvalue, err := time.ParseDuration(os.Getenv(envCaptureSegment))\n153: \tif err != nil || value <= 0 {\n154: \t\treturn 0\n155: \t}\n156: \n157: \treturn value\n158: }\n159: \n160: // CaptureInterfaces lists the capturable lab link interfaces of the requested nodes, or of every\n161: // node, as clabwire reports them, with their peers. Node names are reported as the topology\n162: // spells them.\n163: func (r *Runtime) CaptureInterfaces(\n164: \tctx context.Context,\n165: \treq clablabruntime.NodeRequest,\n166: ) ([]clablabruntime.CaptureInterface, error) {\n167: \tr, err := r.connect(ctx, req.Identity)\n168: \tif err != nil {\n169: \t\treturn nil, err\n170: \t}\n171: \n172: \tlocations, err := r.LocateNode(ctx, clablabruntime.NodeRequest{\n173: \t\tName: req.Name, Namespace: req.Namespace, Nodes: req.Nodes, Identity: req.Identity,\n174: \t})\n175: \tif err != nil {\n176: \t\treturn nil, err\n177: \t}\n178: \tif len(req.Nodes) == 0 {\n179: \t\t// a lab-wide listing skips nodes that do not run\n180: \t\trunning := locations[:0]\n181: \t\tfor _, location := range locations {\n182: \t\t\tif location.Pod != \"\" {\n183: \t\t\t\trunning = append(running, location)\n184: \t\t\t}\n185: \t\t}\n186: \t\tlocations = running\n187: \t}\n188: \n189: \tlisted, err := r.listCaptureInterfaces(ctx, req.Name, locations)\n190: \tif err != nil {\n191: \t\treturn nil, err\n192: \t}\n193: \tnames, err := r.nodeDisplayNames(ctx, req.Name, locations)\n194: \tif err != nil {\n195: \t\treturn nil, err\n196: \t}\n197: \n198: \tresult := make([]clablabruntime.CaptureInterface, 0)\n199: \tfor _, location := range locations {\n200: \t\tfor _, entry := range listed[location.NodeName] {\n201: \t\t\tresult = append(result, clablabruntime.CaptureInterface{\n202: \t\t\t\tNode:          names.display(entry.Node),\n203: \t\t\t\tInterface:     entry.Interface,\n204: \t\t\t\tAlias:         entry.Alias,\n205: \t\t\t\tPeerNode:      names.display(entry.PeerNode),\n206: \t\t\t\tPeerInterface: entry.PeerInterface,\n207: \t\t\t})\n208: \t\t}\n209: \t}\n210: \tsort.SliceStable(result, func(i, j int) bool {\n211: \t\tif result[i].Node != result[j].Node {\n212: \t\t\treturn result[i].Node < result[j].Node\n213: \t\t}\n214: \n215: \t\treturn result[i].Interface < result[j].Interface\n216: \t})\n217: \n218: \treturn result, nil\n219: }\n220: \n221: // listCaptureInterfaces runs one --list-interfaces per pod and returns the entries per Node.\n222: func (r *Runtime) listCaptureInterfaces(\n223: \tctx context.Context,\n224: \tlab string,\n225: \tlocations []clablabruntime.NodeLocation,\n226: ) (map[string][]clabwireInterface, error) {\n227: \tpods := map[string]clablabruntime.NodeLocation{}\n228: \twanted := map[string]bool{}\n229: \tfor _, location := range locations {\n230: \t\tif location.Pod == \"\" {\n231: \t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"c9s node %s/%s/%s has no pod; is it running?\",\n232: \t\t\t\tlocation.Namespace, lab, location.NodeName)\n233: \t\t}\n234: \t\tpods[location.Namespace+\"/\"+location.Pod] = location\n235: \t\twanted[location.NodeName] = true\n236: \t}\n237: \n238: \tvar mu sync.Mutex\n239: \tresult := map[string][]clabwireInterface{}\n240: \tgroup, groupCtx := errgroup.WithContext(ctx)\n241: \tgroup.SetLimit(interfaceSampleWorkers)\n242: \tfor _, location := range pods {\n243: \t\tgroup.Go(func() error {\n244: \t\t\tentries, err := r.listPodInterfaces(groupCtx, location.Namespace, location.Pod)\n245: \t\t\tif err != nil {\n246: \t\t\t\treturn err\n247: \t\t\t}\n248: \n249: \t\t\tmu.Lock()\n250: \t\t\tdefer mu.Unlock()\n251: \t\t\tfor _, entry := range entries {\n252: \t\t\t\tif wanted[entry.Node] {\n253: \t\t\t\t\tresult[entry.Node] = append(result[entry.Node], entry)\n254: \t\t\t\t}\n255: \t\t\t}\n256: \n257: \t\t\treturn nil\n258: \t\t})\n259: \t}\n260: \tif err := group.Wait(); err != nil {\n261: \t\treturn nil, err\n262: \t}\n263: \n264: \treturn result, nil\n265: }\n266: \n267: // listPodInterfaces runs clabwire's --list-interfaces in a pod: the lab link interfaces of the\n268: // pod's nodes, with their aliases and peers.\n269: func (r *Runtime) listPodInterfaces(\n270: \tctx context.Context,\n271: \tnamespace, pod string,\n272: ) ([]clabwireInterface, error) {\n273: \tvar stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer\n274: \terr := r.execInPodContainer()(ctx, namespace, pod, clabwireContainer,\n275: \t\t[]string{clabwireManager, \"node-runtime\", \"packet-capture\", \"--list-interfaces\"},\n276: \t\tnil, &stdout, &stderr)\n277: \tif err != nil {\n278: \t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to list the capturable interfaces of pod %s/%s: %w%s\",\n279: \t\t\tnamespace, pod, err, stderrSuffix(stderr.Bytes()))\n280: \t}\n281: \n282: \tvar entries []clabwireInterface\n283: \tif err := json.Unmarshal(stdout.Bytes(), &entries); err != nil {\n284: \t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to parse the capturable interfaces of pod %s/%s: %w\",\n285: \t\t\tnamespace, pod, err)\n286: \t}\n287: \n288: \treturn entries, nil\n289: }\n290: \n291: func stderrSuffix(stderr []byte) string {\n292: \ttext := strings.TrimSpace(string(stderr))\n293: \tif text == \"\" {\n294: \t\treturn \"\"\n295: \t}\n296: \n297: \treturn \": \" + text\n298: }\n299: \n300: // nodeNames maps the node names the cluster carries to the names the topology file uses.\n301: type nodeNames map[string]string\n302: \n303: func (n nodeNames) display(name string) string {\n304: \tif original := n[name]; original != \"\" {\n305: \t\treturn original\n306: \t}\n307: \n308: \treturn name\n309: }\n310: \n311: // nodeDisplayNames reads the original node names from the c9s.run/originalNodeName label of the\n312: // lab's Nodes.\n313: func (r *Runtime) nodeDisplayNames(\n314: \tctx context.Context,\n315: \tlab string,\n316: \tlocations []clablabruntime.NodeLocation,\n317: ) (nodeNames, error) {\n318: \tnames := nodeNames{}\n319: \tif len(locations) == 0 {\n320: \t\treturn names, nil\n321: \t}\n322: \n323: \tnodes, err := r.nodesForTopology(ctx, lab, locations[0].Namespace)\n324: \tif err != nil {\n325: \t\treturn nil, err\n326: \t}\n327: \tfor idx := range nodes.Items {\n328: \t\tif original := nodes.Items[idx].GetLabels()[labelOriginalNodeName]; original != \"\" {\n329: \t\t\tnames[nodes.Items[idx].GetName()] = original\n330: \t\t}\n331: \t}\n332: \n333: \treturn names, nil\n334: }\n335: \n336: // captureGroup is the part of a capture one clabwire process serves: the requested interfaces of\n337: // one node, in one pod.\n338: type captureGroup struct {\n339: \tlocation clablabruntime.NodeLocation\n340: \tdisplay  string\n341: \t// interfaces are the planned interface names, in the order the merged stream lists them.\n342: \tinterfaces []string\n343: \t// ids are the merged interface IDs of interfaces.\n344: \tids []uint32\n345: }\n346: \n347: // resolvedCapture is a validated capture request.\n348: type resolvedCapture struct {\n349: \tgroups []*captureGroup\n350: \t// names are the merged interface names (<node>:<interface>), indexed by merged ID.\n351: \tnames []string\n352: }\n353: \n354: // resolveCaptureTargets locates every target node, checks every interface against the\n355: // interfaces clabwire allows, and groups the targets per node.\n356: func (r *Runtime) resolveCaptureTargets(\n357: \tctx context.Context,\n358: \treq clablabruntime.CaptureRequest,\n359: ) (*resolvedCapture, error) {\n360: \tnodeOrder := make([]string, 0, len(req.Targets))\n361: \tseenNodes := map[string]bool{}\n362: \tfor _, target := range req.Targets {\n363: \t\tif !seenNodes[target.Node] {\n364: \t\t\tseenNodes[target.Node] = true\n365: \t\t\tnodeOrder = append(nodeOrder, target.Node)\n366: \t\t}\n367: \t}\n368: \n369: \tlocations, err := r.LocateNode(ctx, clablabruntime.NodeRequest{\n370: \t\tName: req.Name, Namespace: req.Namespace, Nodes: nodeOrder, Identity: req.Identity,\n371: \t})\n372: \tif err != nil {\n373: \t\treturn nil, err\n374: \t}\n375: \tbyRequest := make(map[string]clablabruntime.NodeLocation, len(nodeOrder))\n376: \tfor idx, name := range nodeOrder {\n377: \t\tbyRequest[name] = locations[idx]\n378: \t}\n379: \n380: \tlisted, err := r.listCaptureInterfaces(ctx, req.Name, locations)\n381: \tif err != nil {\n382: \t\treturn nil, err\n383: \t}\n384: \tnames, err := r.nodeDisplayNames(ctx, req.Name, locations)\n385: \tif err != nil {\n386: \t\treturn nil, err\n387: \t}\n388: \n389: \tresolved := &resolvedCapture{}\n390: \tgroups := map[string]*captureGroup{}\n391: \tseen := map[string]bool{}\n392: \tfor _, target := range req.Targets {\n393: \t\tlocation := byRequest[target.Node]\n394: \t\tentry, ok := findCaptureInterface(listed[location.NodeName], target.Interface)\n395: \t\tif !ok {\n396: \t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"interface %q of node %q is not a capturable link \"+\n397: \t\t\t\t\"interface; capturable: %s\", target.Interface, target.Node,\n398: \t\t\t\tdescribeCaptureInterfaces(listed[location.NodeName]))\n399: \t\t}\n400: \n401: \t\tkey := location.NodeName + \"\\x00\" + entry.Interface\n402: \t\tif seen[key] {\n403: \t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"interface %q of node %q is requested more than once\",\n404: \t\t\t\tentry.Interface, target.Node)\n405: \t\t}\n406: \t\tseen[key] = true\n407: \n408: \t\tgroup := groups[location.NodeName]\n409: \t\tif group == nil {\n410: \t\t\tgroup = &captureGroup{\n411: \t\t\t\tlocation: location,\n412: \t\t\t\tdisplay:  names.display(location.NodeName),\n413: \t\t\t}\n414: \t\t\tgroups[location.NodeName] = group\n415: \t\t\tresolved.groups = append(resolved.groups, group)\n416: \t\t}\n417: \n418: \t\tid := uint32(len(resolved.names)) //nolint:gosec // bounded by the targets\n419: \t\tgroup.interfaces = append(group.interfaces, entry.Interface)\n420: \t\tgroup.ids = append(group.ids, id)\n421: \t\tresolved.names = append(resolved.names, group.display+\":\"+entry.Interface)\n422: \t}\n423: \n424: \treturn resolved, nil\n425: }\n426: \n427: // findCaptureInterface matches a requested interface by its planned name or its alias.\n428: func findCaptureInterface(entries []clabwireInterface, name string) (clabwireInterface, bool) {\n429: \tfor _, entry := range entries {\n430: \t\tif entry.Interface == name {\n431: \t\t\treturn entry, true\n432: \t\t}\n433: \t}\n434: \tfor _, entry := range entries {\n435: \t\tif entry.Alias != \"\" && entry.Alias == name {\n436: \t\t\treturn entry, true\n437: \t\t}\n438: \t}\n439: \n440: \treturn clabwireInterface{}, false\n441: }\n442: \n443: func describeCaptureInterfaces(entries []clabwireInterface) string {\n444: \tif len(entries) == 0 {\n445: \t\treturn \"none\"\n446: \t}\n447: \n448: \tnames := make([]string, 0, len(entries))\n449: \tfor _, entry := range entries {\n450: \t\tname := entry.Interface\n451: \t\tif entry.Alias != \"\" {\n452: \t\t\tname += \" (\" + entry.Alias + \")\"\n453: \t\t}\n454: \t\tnames = append(names, name)\n455: \t}\n456: \n457: \treturn strings.Join(names, \", \")\n458: }\n459: \n460: // Capture streams pcapng from lab link interfaces to w: one section, one Interface Description\n461: // Block per target in request order named <node>:<interface>, then the packets of every target.\n462: //\n463: // Each node's interfaces are captured by one clabwire process in the node's pod. clabwire limits\n464: // a capture to one hour, so a longer capture (or one without Duration) chains captures: the next\n465: // one starts before the current one ends, and the stream switches at a cut in the overlap. See\n466: // captureChain for how packets of the overlap are kept once.\n467: //\n468: // Packets go out in timestamp order across nodes, through a reorder buffer (captureReorder).\n469: //\n470: // Every clabwire process runs with stdin attached and --stop-on-stdin-close: a Kubernetes exec\n471: // does not stop its process when the stream closes, so containerlab closes stdin whenever a\n472: // segment ends (the capture ends, fails, its output fails, or a newer segment took over) and\n473: // clabwire ends the capture itself.\n474: //\n475: // Capture returns when Duration has passed, PacketLimit packets were written, or ctx ends; an\n476: // ended ctx is not an error. Every block reaches w in one write, so the stream is a valid capture\n477: // whenever it stops. A clabwire Denied or Failed audit record is returned as an error.\n478: func (r *Runtime) Capture(\n479: \tctx context.Context,\n480: \treq clablabruntime.CaptureRequest,\n481: \tw io.Writer,\n482: ) error {\n483: \tif err := clabcapture.ValidateRequest(&req); err != nil {\n484: \t\treturn err\n485: \t}\n486: \n487: \tr, err := r.connect(ctx, req.Identity)\n488: \tif err != nil {\n489: \t\treturn err\n490: \t}\n491: \n492: \tresolved, err := r.resolveCaptureTargets(ctx, req)\n493: \tif err != nil {\n494: \t\treturn err\n495: \t}\n496: \n497: \tcaptureCtx, stop := context.WithCancel(ctx)\n498: \tdefer stop()\n499: \n500: \tout, err := clabcapture.NewOutput(w, resolved.names, req.SnapLength, req.PacketLimit,\n501: \t\tr.captureReorderWindowLength(), stop)\n502: \tif err != nil {\n503: \t\treturn err\n504: \t}\n505: \n506: \trun := &captureRun{\n507: \t\tr:       r,\n508: \t\treq:     req,\n509: \t\tout:     out,\n510: \t\tsegment: r.captureSegmentLength(),\n511: \t}\n512: \tif req.Duration > 0 {\n513: \t\trun.deadline = time.Now().Add(req.Duration)\n514: \t}\n515: \trun.overlap = min(maxCaptureOverlap, run.segment/3)\n516: \trun.window = min(maxCaptureCutWindow, run.overlap/4)\n517: \n518: \tif req.Duration > 0 {\n519: \t\t// a clabwire process that does not end on its own does not hold the capture open\n520: \t\tvar cancelTimeout context.CancelFunc\n521: \t\tcaptureCtx, cancelTimeout = context.WithTimeout(captureCtx,\n522: \t\t\treq.Duration+run.overlap+captureEndGrace)\n523: \t\tdefer cancelTimeout()\n524: \t}\n525: \n526: \tgroup, groupCtx := errgroup.WithContext(captureCtx)\n527: \tfor _, captureGroup := range resolved.groups {\n528: \t\tchain := &captureChain{capture: run, group: captureGroup}\n529: \t\tgroup.Go(func() error {\n530: \t\t\treturn chain.run(groupCtx)\n531: \t\t})\n532: \t}\n533: \n534: \terr = group.Wait()\n535: \tif writeErr := out.Close(); writeErr != nil {\n536: \t\treturn writeErr\n537: \t}\n538: \tif err != nil && !(errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) && captureCtx.Err() != nil) {\n539: \t\treturn err\n540: \t}\n541: \n542: \treturn nil\n543: }\n544: \n545: // captureRun is the state a capture's chains share.\n546: type captureRun struct {\n547: \tr   *Runtime\n548: \treq clablabruntime.CaptureRequest\n549: \t// out is the merged stream; it writes the packets of every chain in timestamp order and\n550: \t// stops every chain once the packet limit is reached.\n551: \tout *clabcapture.Output\n552: \n553: \tsegment  time.Duration\n554: \toverlap  time.Duration\n555: \twindow   time.Duration\n556: \tdeadline time.Time\n557: }\n558: \n559: // emit writes a packet under its merged interface ID. It reports false once the packet limit is\n560: // reached and the capture stops.\n561: func (run *captureRun) emit(id uint32, packet *clabcapture.Packet) (bool, error) {\n562: \treturn run.out.Emit(id, packet)\n563: }\n564: \n565: func (run *captureRun) reportGap(gap clablabruntime.CaptureGap) {\n566: \tclabcapture.ReportGap(run.req.OnGap, gap)\n567: }\n568: \n569: // captureSegment is one clabwire capture process of a chain.\n570: type captureSegment struct {\n571: \tindex      int\n572: \tlocalStart time.Time\n573: \tduration   time.Duration\n574: \tcancel     context.CancelFunc\n575: \t// closeStdin closes the stdin of the segment's clabwire process, which ends it; it may be\n576: \t// called any number of times.\n577: \tcloseStdin func()\n578: \t// stopTimer closes stdin once the segment is no longer needed after a switch-over.\n579: \tstopTimer *time.Timer\n580: \t// started and ended are the pod-clock times of the Started and Succeeded audit records.\n581: \tstarted time.Time\n582: \tended   time.Time\n583: \tdone    bool\n584: }\n585: \n586: func (s *captureSegment) plannedEnd() time.Time {\n587: \treturn s.started.Add(s.duration)\n588: }\n589: \n590: // segmentEvent is something a segment reported: a packet, an audit record, or its end.\n591: type segmentEvent struct {\n592: \tsegment *captureSegment\n593: \tpacket  *clabcapture.Packet\n594: \taudit   *captureAudit\n595: \tdone    bool\n596: \terr     error\n597: }\n598: \n599: // captureChain runs the chained clabwire captures of one group.\n600: //\n601: // Chaining and the cut: segment k+1 starts `overlap` before segment k is due to end, so both\n602: // capture the same packets for a while. clabwire stamps packets when it reads them, so two\n603: // processes give the same packet timestamps a few microseconds apart, and timestamps alone\n604: // cannot pair them. The chain therefore cuts in the middle of the overlap and matches packets by\n605: // content close to the cut:\n606: //\n607: //  1. When segment k+1 reports Started (pod clock, from its audit record), the cut is\n608: //     T = midpoint of [Started(k+1), Started(k) + duration(k)]: both segments run then.\n609: //  2. Segment k keeps streaming live, but only packets stamped before T; it remembers the\n610: //     content of what it wrote since segment k+1 started.\n611: //  3. Segment k+1's packets are held back until segment k has ended. Then the ones stamped\n612: //     before T-W are dropped (segment k had them), the ones stamped within W of T are dropped\n613: //     when segment k wrote the same bytes on the same interface, and every other one is written.\n614: //     From then on segment k+1 streams live.\n615: //\n616: // Once the pod clock passed T+W, segment k's stdin is closed so it ends without running to its\n617: // planned end. While packets are held back, the chain holds the reorder buffer at T-W, so other\n618: // nodes' later packets do not overtake them in the merged stream.\n619: //\n620: // W (500 ms, less for short test segments) covers the stamping difference. Identical frames on\n621: // the same interface within W of the cut can be paired with each other, which can drop a true\n622: // repeat; nothing else is lost or doubled. A follow-up segment that does not start in time leaves\n623: // a gap, which is reported through CaptureRequest.OnGap (or logged), never silently ignored.\n624: type captureChain struct {\n625: \tcapture *captureRun\n626: \tgroup   *captureGroup\n627: \n628: \tevents chan segmentEvent\n629: \twg     sync.WaitGroup\n630: \n631: \tactive *captureSegment\n632: \tnext   *captureSegment\n633: \t// cut is the switch time between active and next, in nanoseconds; zero until known.\n634: \tcut int64\n635: \t// emitted remembers the content of the packets active wrote while next runs.\n636: \temitted map[uint64]int\n637: \t// held are the packets of next until active ends.\n638: \theld     []*clabcapture.Packet\n639: \tsegments int\n640: \tretries  int\n641: \t// final is set once no further segment is due.\n642: \tfinal bool\n643: \t// stopping is set once ctx ended: the segments are asked to end and what they still\n644: \t// deliver is written.\n645: \tstopping bool\n646: }\n647: \n648: // run runs the chain until its last segment ended. 1742: +// Container event actions, as the Docker runtime reports them.

1757: +// trackedContainer is the last reported container state of a node.
1758: +type trackedContainer struct {
1759: +	ref    labRef
1760: +	state  string
1761: +	health string
1762: +	pod    string
1763: +	// lab and node are the last observation, which a removed node is described with.
1764: +	lab  *clablabruntime.LabState
1765: +	node clablabruntime.NodeState
1766: +}
1767: +
1768: +// containerTracker turns the node states of the labs in an event scope into the container
1769: +// events the Docker runtime emits for the same lifecycle: create and start when a node's pod
1770: +// starts, kill, stop and die when it stops (on request, or between the pods of a restart),
1771: +// destroy when the node is removed, and health_status as its device becomes ready.
1772: +type containerTracker struct {
1773: +	r     *Runtime
1774: +	sink  chan<- clablabruntime.Event
1775: +	nodes map[string]*trackedContainer
1776: +}
1777: +
1778: +// trackContainers reports the container events of a scope. It reads the labs once, reporting
1779: +// them as a snapshot when the stream includes the initial state, and then reads a lab again
1780: +// whenever its Topology, Nodes or pods change. Changes that arrive together are read once.
1781: +func (r *Runtime) trackContainers(
1782: +	ctx context.Context,
1783: +	scope eventScope,
1784: +	includeInitialState bool,
1785: +	changed <-chan labRef,
1786: +	eventSink chan<- clablabruntime.Event,
1787: +	errSink chan<- error,
1788: +) {
1789: +	tracker := &containerTracker{r: r, sink: eventSink, nodes: map[string]*trackedContainer{}}
1790: +
1791: +	states, err := r.labStates(ctx, scope)
1792: +	if err != nil {
1793: +		sendEventError(ctx, errSink, err)
1794: +		return
1795: +	}
1796: +	for _, state := range states {
1797: +		tracker.observeLab(ctx, labRef{namespace: state.Namespace, lab: state.Name}, state,
1798: +			&observeSeed{snapshot: includeInitialState})
1799: +	}
1800: +
1801: +	pending := map[labRef]bool{}
1802: +	timer := time.NewTimer(time.Hour)
1803: +	timer.Stop()
1804: +	defer timer.Stop()
1805: +	armed := false
1806: +	arm := func(delay time.Duration) {
1807: +		if !armed {
1808: +			timer.Reset(delay)
1809: +			armed = true
1810: +		}
1811: +	}
1812: +
1813: +	for {
1814: +		select {
1815: +		case <-ctx.Done():
1816: +			return
1817: +		case ref := <-changed:
1818: +			pending[ref] = true
1819: +			arm(containerRefreshDelay)
1820: +		case <-timer.C:
1821: +			armed = false
1822: +			refs := pending
1823: +			pending = map[labRef]bool{}
1824: +			for ref := range refs {
1825: +				if !tracker.refresh(ctx, ref) {
1826: +					pending[ref] = true
1827: +				}
1828: +			}
1829: +			if len(pending) != 0 {
1830: +				arm(containerRefreshRetryDelay)
1831: +			}
1832: +		}
1833: +	}
1834: +}

1837: +// reporting changes, and reports them as a snapshot when asked to.

1843: +// its nodes as destroyed. It returns false when the lab could not be read.
1844: +func (t *containerTracker) refresh(ctx context.Context, ref labRef) bool {
1845: +	state, err := t.r.Inspect(ctx, clablabruntime.InspectRequest{
1846: +		Name:      ref.lab,

1848: +	})

1855: +			}
1856: +

1858: +		}
1859: +		state = nil
1860: +	}

1862: +	t.observeLab(ctx, ref, state, nil)
1863: +
1864: +	return true
1865: +}

1869: +func (t *containerTracker) observeLab(

3675: +// sampledInterfaceNames lists the interface names a sample saw, sorted and comma-joined.
3676: +func sampledInterfaceNames(sample interfaceSample) string {
3677: +	names := make([]string, 0, len(sample.stats)+len(sample.ifaces))
3678: +	seen := map[string]bool{}
3679: +	for _, iface := range sample.ifaces {
3680: +		if !seen[iface.Name] {
3681: +			seen[iface.Name] = true
3682: +			names = append(names, iface.Name)
3683: +		}
3684: +	}
3685: +	for _, stat := range sample.stats {
3686: +		if !seen[stat.Name] {
3687: +			seen[stat.Name] = true
3688: +			names = append(names, stat.Name)
3689: +		}
3690: +	}
3691: +	sort.Strings(names)
3692: +
3693: +	return strings.Join(names, ",")
3694: +}

3696: +// nodeLinks returns the lab link interfaces of a node from its pod's clabwire listing. A pod is
3697: +// listed once, and again when its interfaces change (a pod gets its link interfaces as clabwire
3698: +// wires them).
3699: +func (p *interfacePoller) nodeLinks(
3700: +	ctx context.Context,
3701: +	target interfaceSampleTarget,
3702: +	names string,
3703: +) ([]clabwireInterface, error) {
3704: +	key := target.pod.Namespace + "/" + target.pod.Name
3705: +
3706: +	p.listingsMu.Lock()
3707: +	listing := p.listings[key]
3708: +	p.listingsMu.Unlock()
3709: +
3710: +	if listing == nil || listing.names != names {
3711: +		entries, err := p.r.listPodInterfaces(ctx, target.pod.Namespace, target.pod.Name)
3712: +		if err != nil {
3713: +			return nil, err
3714: +		}
3715: +
3716: +		listing = &podInterfaceListing{
3717: +			names:  names,
3718: +			byNode: map[string][]clabwireInterface{},
3719: +		}
3720: +		for _, entry := range entries {
3721: +			listing.byNode[entry.Node] = append(listing.byNode[entry.Node], entry)
3722: +		}
3723: +
3724: +		p.listingsMu.Lock()
3725: +		p.listings[key] = listing
3726: +		p.listingsMu.Unlock()
3727: +	}
3728: +
3729: +	return listing.byNode[target.node.Name], nil
3730: +}

3732:  // commandNotExecutable reports an exec that failed because the command does not exist in the
3733:  // container.
3734:  func commandNotExecutable(rc int, err error) bool {
3735:  	if rc == exitCommandNotExecutable || rc == exitCommandNotFound {
3736:  		return true
3737:  	}
3738:  
3739:  	return err != nil && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "executable file not found")
3740:  }

3742: +// reportedInterfaces are the interfaces reported for a node, by name, with the alias the
3743: +// topology gave them: its lab link interfaces, the management interface and loopback.
3744: +func reportedInterfaces(links []clabwireInterface) map[string]string {
3745: +	reported := map[string]string{
3746: +		loopbackInterface:   "",
3747: +		managementInterface: "",
3748: +	}
3749: +	for _, link := range links {
3750: +		reported[link.Interface] = link.Alias
3751: +	}
3752: +
3753: +	return reported
3754: +}
3755: +
3756: +// interfaceEventData describes an interface the way the local runtimes' netlink events do: the
3757: +// alias is the topology's name for the interface (an alias clabernetes set for its own use is
3758: +// not reported), the operational state uses netlink's names, lab link and management
3759: +// interfaces are veth pairs, loopback a device, and loopback has no hardware address.
3760: +func interfaceEventData(iface c9sIfaceState, alias string) clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData {
3761: +	if alias == "" && !strings.HasPrefix(iface.Alias, clabernetesAliasPrefix) {
3762: +		alias = iface.Alias
3763: +	}
3764: +
3765: +	mac := iface.MAC
3766: +	if mac == zeroMAC {
3767: +		mac = ""
3768: +	}
3769: +
3770: +	linkType := interfaceTypeVeth
3771: +	if iface.Name == loopbackInterface {
3772: +		linkType = interfaceTypeDevice
3773: +	}
3774: +
3775: +	return clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
3776: +		Name:      iface.Name,
3777: +		Alias:     alias,
3778: +		Index:     iface.Index,
3779: +		MTU:       iface.MTU,
3780: +		MAC:       mac,
3781: +		OperState: netlinkOperState(iface.OperState),
3782: +		Type:      linkType,
3783: +	}
3784: +}
3785: +
3786: +// netlinkOperState names an operational state from sysfs (RFC 2863, as in
3787: +// /sys/class/net/<if>/operstate) the way netlink, and so the local runtimes' events, name it.
3788: +func netlinkOperState(operState string) string {
3789: +	switch operState {
3790: +	case "notpresent":
3791: +		return "not-present"
3792: +	case "lowerlayerdown":
3793: +		return "lower-layer-down"
3794: +	case "":
3795: +		return "unknown"
3796: +	default:
3797: +		return operState
3798: +	}
3799: +}

4502: +// nodeContainerState is the state of a node in container runtime terms, from its pod: created
4503: +// while the pod is scheduled and prepared (init containers), running once the device containers

4508: +	case pod == nil && stopRequested:
4509: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateExited
4510: +	case pod == nil:
4511: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated
4512: +	case stopRequested || pod.DeletionTimestamp != nil:
4513: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateExited
4514: +	}
4515: +
4516: +	switch pod.Status.Phase {
4517: +	case corev1.PodRunning:
4518: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning
4519: +	case corev1.PodSucceeded, corev1.PodFailed:
4520: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateExited
4521: +	default:
4522: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated
4523: +	}
4524: +}

169: +// These tests build the events the Docker runtime and the c9s lab runtime report for the same
170: +// node and compare them: every attribute a Docker event carries is in the c9s event, with the
171: +// same meaning, apart from the ones c9s has no equivalent for.
172: +
173: +// dockerOnlyContainerAttributes are the Docker container event attributes c9s has no
174: +// equivalent for: the Docker event scope, the Docker management bridge, and the exit code and
175: +// run time of a container process, which Kubernetes does not keep once the pod is gone.
176: +var dockerOnlyContainerAttributes = map[string]bool{ //nolint:gochecknoglobals
177: +	"scope":                     true,
178: +	clabconstants.NodeMgmtNetBr: true,
179: +	clabconstants.NodeLabDir:    true,
180: +	"exitCode":                  true,
181: +	"execDuration":              true,
182: +}
183: +
184: +const parityTopology = `name: parity
185: +mgmt:
186: +  network: clab
187: +topology:
188: +  nodes:
189: +    client:
190: +      kind: linux
191: +      image: ghcr.io/srl-labs/network-multitool
192: +    srl1:
193: +      kind: nokia_srlinux
194: +      image: ghcr.io/nokia/srlinux:25.10
195: +  links:
196: +    - endpoints: ["client:eth1", "srl1:ethernet-1/1"]
197: +`

199: +// parityLab loads the topology as a Docker deploy does and returns its labels per node.
200: +func parityLab(t *testing.T) (string, *clabcore.CLab) {
201: +	t.Helper()
202: +
203: +	dir := t.TempDir()
204: +	path := filepath.Join(dir, "parity.clab.yml")
205: +	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(parityTopology), 0o600); err != nil {
206: +		t.Fatal(err)
207: +	}
208: +	t.Setenv("USER", "alice")
209: +	t.Setenv("SUDO_USER", "")
210: +
211: +	c, err := clabcore.NewContainerLab(clabcore.WithTopoPath(path, nil))
212: +	if err != nil {
213: +		t.Fatal(err)
214: +	}
215: +
216: +	return path, c
217: +}

219: +// fakeDockerRuntime answers the container lookup the events command makes for a Docker event.
220: +type fakeDockerRuntime struct {
221: +	clabruntime.ContainerRuntime
222: +	container clabruntime.GenericContainer
223: +}
224: +
225: +func (f *fakeDockerRuntime) ListContainers(
226: +	context.Context,
227: +	[]*clabtypes.GenericFilter,
228: +) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {
229: +	return []clabruntime.GenericContainer{f.container}, nil
230: +}

232: +// dockerContainer is the container Docker runs for a node.
233: +func dockerContainer(t *testing.T, c *clabcore.CLab, node string) clabruntime.GenericContainer {
234: +	t.Helper()
235: +
236: +	cfg := c.Nodes[node].Config()
237: +	labels := cloneStringMap(cfg.Labels)
238: +	labels[clabconstants.NodeMgmtNetBr] = "br-92bb9fb46cd2"
239: +
240: +	return clabruntime.GenericContainer{
241: +		Names:   []string{cfg.LongName},
242: +		ID:      "57b7763f3b4d97ff0c96b1dab8294b836199628a2d9400549948a963732e185a",
243: +		ShortID: "57b7763f3b4d",
244: +		Image:   cfg.Image,
245: +		State:   "running",
246: +		Status:  "Up 19 seconds",
247: +		Labels:  labels,
248: +		NetworkSettings: clabruntime.GenericMgmtIPs{
249: +			IPv4addr: "172.20.20.2", IPv4pLen: 24, IPv6addr: "3fff:172:20:20::2", IPv6pLen: 64,
250: +		},
251: +		NetworkName: "clab",
252: +		Ports: []*clabtypes.GenericPortBinding{
253: +			{ContainerPort: 22, Protocol: "tcp"}, {ContainerPort: 80, Protocol: "tcp"},
254: +		},
255: +	}
256: +}

258: +// dockerContainerEvent is a Docker container event as `containerlab events` reports it: the
259: +// Docker message (container labels, image and name as attributes, plus the action's own) through
260: +// the events command's conversion and enrichment.
261: +func dockerContainerEvent(
262: +	t *testing.T,
263: +	container clabruntime.GenericContainer,
264: +	action string,
265: +	extra map[string]string,
266: +) aggregatedEvent {
267: +	t.Helper()
268: +
269: +	attributes := cloneStringMap(container.Labels)
270: +	attributes["image"] = container.Image
271: +	attributes["name"] = container.Names[0]
272: +	for k, v := range extra {
273: +		attributes[k] = v
274: +	}
275: +	data := clabutils.DockerMessageToEventData(dockerEvents.Message{
276: +		Type:     dockerEvents.ContainerEventType,
277: +		Action:   dockerEvents.Action(action),
278: +		Actor:    dockerEvents.Actor{ID: container.ID, Attributes: attributes},
279: +		Scope:    "local",
280: +		TimeNano: time.Now().UnixNano(),
281: +	})
282: +
283: +	return aggregatedEventFromContainerEvent(context.Background(),
284: +		&fakeDockerRuntime{container: container},
285: +		clabruntime.ContainerEvent{
286: +			Timestamp: data.Timestamp, Type: data.Type, Action: data.Action,
287: +			ActorID: data.ActorID, ActorName: data.ActorName, ActorFullID: data.ActorFullID,
288: +			Attributes: data.Attributes,
289: +		})
290: +}

292: +// c9sNode is the same node as the c9s runtime reports it, deployed from the same file.
293: +func c9sNode(
294: +	c *clabcore.CLab,
295: +	path, node string,
296: +) (*clablabruntime.LabState, clablabruntime.NodeState) {
297: +	cfg := c.Nodes[node].Config()
298: +	state := &clablabruntime.LabState{
299: +		Name: "parity", Namespace: "c9s-parity", Owner: "alice", TopologyPath: path,
300: +		State: "running", Ready: true,
301: +	}
302: +	nodeState := clablabruntime.NodeState{
303: +		Name: node, Kind: cfg.Kind, Image: cfg.Image, State: "ready", Ready: true,
304: +		ContainerState:  clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning,
305: +		Health:          clablabruntime.ContainerHealthHealthy,
306: +		MgmtIPv4Address: "172.20.20.84/24", MgmtIPv6Address: "3fff:172:20:20::84/64",
307: +		Pod: node + "-88598986c-rbdfq", Container: "node-" + node, NodeUID: "uid-" + node,
308: +		ExposedPorts: []clablabruntime.ExposedPort{
309: +			{
310: +				Port:       22,
311: +				ExposePort: 22,
312: +				Protocol:   "tcp",
313: +			},
314: +			{Port: 80, ExposePort: 80, Protocol: "tcp"},
315: +		},
316: +	}
317: +	state.Nodes = []clablabruntime.NodeState{nodeState}
318: +
319: +	return state, nodeState
320: +}

322: +// c9sContainerEvent is the event the c9s runtime emits, as `containerlab events` reports it.
323: +func c9sContainerEvent(
324: +	clab *clabcore.CLab,
325: +	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
326: +	node clablabruntime.NodeState,
327: +	action, containerState string,
328: +	extra map[string]string,
329: +) aggregatedEvent {
330: +	key := state.Namespace + "/" + state.Name + "/" + node.Name
331: +	attributes := map[string]string{
332: +		"namespace": state.Namespace, "lab": state.Name, "node": node.Name, "pod": node.Pod,
333: +		"state": containerState,
334: +	}
335: +	for k, v := range extra {
336: +		attributes[k] = v
337: +	}
338: +
339: +	return aggregatedEventFromLabRuntimeEvent(clab, clablabruntime.Event{
340: +		Type: clablabruntime.EventTypeContainer, Action: action,
341: +		ActorID: key, ActorName: state.Name + "-" + node.Name, ActorFullID: key,
342: +		Attributes: attributes, Lab: state, Node: &node,
343: +	})
344: +}
345: +
346: +func attributeKeys(attributes map[string]string) []string {
347: +	keys := make([]string, 0, len(attributes))
348: +	for key := range attributes {
349: +		keys = append(keys, key)
350: +	}
351: +	sort.Strings(keys)
352: +
353: +	return keys
354: +}
355: +
356: +// assertAttributeParity checks that the c9s event carries every attribute of the Docker event,
357: +// apart from the ones listed.
358: +func assertAttributeParity(t *testing.T, docker, c9s aggregatedEvent, dockerOnly map[string]bool) {
359: +	t.Helper()
360: +
361: +	dockerAttributes := mergedEventAttributes(docker)
362: +	c9sAttributes := mergedEventAttributes(c9s)
363: +	var missing []string
364: +	for key := range dockerAttributes {
365: +		if _, ok := c9sAttributes[key]; !ok && !dockerOnly[key] {
366: +			missing = append(missing, key)
367: +		}
368: +	}
369: +	if len(missing) != 0 {
370: +		sort.Strings(missing)
371: +		t.Fatalf("c9s %s %s lacks %v\ndocker: %v\nc9s:    %v", c9s.Type, c9s.Action, missing,
372: +			attributeKeys(dockerAttributes), attributeKeys(c9sAttributes))
373: +	}
374: +}

376: +// TestContainerEventParity compares the container events of a node's lifecycle, with the c9s
377: +// lab read with its topology file (events -t) and without it (events --name), where the
378: +// attributes come from the cluster alone.
379: +func TestContainerEventParity(t *testing.T) {
380: +	path, dockerLab := parityLab(t)
381: +	byName, err := clabcore.NewContainerLab(clabcore.WithLabNameOnly("parity"))
382: +	if err != nil {
383: +		t.Fatal(err)
384: +	}
385: +
386: +	for _, mode := range []struct {
387: +		name string
388: +		lab  *clabcore.CLab
389: +	}{{"with the topology", dockerLab}, {"by name", byName}} {
390: +		t.Run(mode.name, func(t *testing.T) {
391: +			assertContainerEventParity(t, path, dockerLab, mode.lab, mode.lab == byName)
392: +		})
393: +	}
394: +}
395: +
396: +func assertContainerEventParity(
397: +	t *testing.T,
398: +	path string,
399: +	dockerLab, c9sLab *clabcore.CLab,
400: +	byName bool,
401: +) {
402: +	t.Helper()
403: +
404: +	for _, node := range []string{"client", "srl1"} {
405: +		container := dockerContainer(t, dockerLab, node)
406: +		state, nodeState := c9sNode(dockerLab, path, node)
407: +		dockerOnly := dockerOnlyContainerAttributes
408: +		if byName && node == "srl1" {
409: +			// The type is the SR Linux default; the cluster has only the types a topology
410: +			// sets, so a lab read by name does not know it.
411: +			dockerOnly = map[string]bool{clabconstants.NodeType: true}
412: +			for key := range dockerOnlyContainerAttributes {
413: +				dockerOnly[key] = true
414: +			}
415: +		}
416: +
417: +		for _, tt := range []struct {
418: +			action, state string
419: +			extra         map[string]string
420: +		}{
421: +			{"create", "created", nil},
422: +			{"start", "running", nil},
423: +			{"kill", "running", map[string]string{"signal": "15"}},
424: +			{"stop", "exited", nil},
425: +			{"die", "exited", map[string]string{"exitCode": "137", "execDuration": "3"}},
426: +			{"health_status: healthy", "running", nil},
427: +			{"destroy", "exited", nil},
428: +		} {
429: +			docker := dockerContainerEvent(t, container, tt.action, tt.extra)
430: +			var c9sExtra map[string]string
431: +			if tt.action == "kill" {
432: +				c9sExtra = tt.extra
433: +			}
434: +			c9s := c9sContainerEvent(c9sLab, state, nodeState, tt.action, tt.state, c9sExtra)
435: +			assertAttributeParity(t, docker, c9s, dockerOnly)
436: +
437: +			got := mergedEventAttributes(c9s)
438: +			want := map[string]string{
439: +				clabconstants.Containerlab: "parity",
440: +				clabconstants.NodeName:     node,
441: +				clabconstants.LongName:     "parity-" + node,
442: +				clabconstants.NodeKind:     dockerLab.Nodes[node].Config().Kind,
443: +				clabconstants.TopoFile:     path,
444: +				clabconstants.Owner:        "alice",
445: +				"image":                    container.Image,
446: +				"name":                     "parity-" + node,
447: +				"id":                       "c9s-parity/parity/" + node,
448: +				"mgmt_ipv4":                "172.20.20.84/24",
449: +				"mgmt_ipv6":                "3fff:172:20:20::84/64",
450: +				"ports":                    "22/tcp;80/tcp",
451: +				"state":                    tt.state,
452: +			}
453: +			for key, value := range want {
454: +				if got[key] != value {
455: +					t.Fatalf("%s %s: %s = %q, want %q", node, tt.action, key, got[key], value)
456: +				}
457: +			}
458: +			// the label values have Docker's format
459: +			dockerAttributes := mergedEventAttributes(docker)
460: +			for _, key := range []string{
461: +				clabconstants.Containerlab, clabconstants.NodeName, clabconstants.NodeKind,
462: +				clabconstants.NodeType, clabconstants.TopoFile, clabconstants.Owner, "image",
463: +				"ports",
464: +			} {
465: +				if dockerOnly[key] {
466: +					continue
467: +				}
468: +				if got[key] != dockerAttributes[key] {
469: +					t.Fatalf("%s %s: %s = %q, docker %q", node, tt.action, key, got[key],
470: +						dockerAttributes[key])
471: +				}
472: +			}
473: +			if c9s.ActorID != c9s.ActorFullID || c9s.ActorName != "parity-"+node {
474: +				t.Fatalf("%s %s: actor = %+v", node, tt.action, c9s)
475: +			}
476: +		}
477: +	}
478: +}

480: +// TestContainerSnapshotParity compares the --initial-state events of a running node, with the
481: +// c9s lab read with its topology file.
482: +func TestContainerSnapshotParity(t *testing.T) {
483: +	path, dockerLab := parityLab(t)
484: +	c9sLab := dockerLab
485: +
486: +	for _, node := range []string{"client", "srl1"} {
487: +		container := dockerContainer(t, dockerLab, node)
488: +		docker := aggregatedEventFromContainerSnapshot(&container)
489: +
490: +		state, nodeState := c9sNode(dockerLab, path, node)
491: +		c9s := c9sContainerEvent(c9sLab, state, nodeState, "running", "running",
492: +			map[string]string{"origin": clablabruntime.EventOriginSnapshot})
493: +
494: +		assertAttributeParity(t, docker, c9s, dockerOnlyContainerAttributes)
495: +		got := mergedEventAttributes(c9s)
496: +		if docker.Action != c9s.Action || got["origin"] != "snapshot" ||
497: +			got["state"] != "running" ||
498: +			got["status"] != "healthy" ||
499: +			got["network"] != "c9s-parity" {
500: +			t.Fatalf("%s snapshot = %s %v", node, c9s.Action, got)
501: +		}
502: +	}
503: +}

546: +// dockerInterfaceEvent is a netlink interface event of a Docker container.
547: +func dockerInterfaceEvent(
548: +	container clabruntime.GenericContainer,
549: +	action string,
550: +	snapshot ifaceSnapshot,
551: +	stats *ifaceStatsMetrics,
552: +) aggregatedEvent {
553: +	attributes := interfaceAttributes(&container, snapshot)
554: +	if stats != nil {
555: +		interfaceStatsAttributes(attributes, *stats)
556: +	}
557: +
558: +	return aggregatedEvent{
559: +		Type: "interface", Action: action, ActorID: container.ShortID,
560: +		ActorName: container.Names[0], ActorFullID: container.ID, Attributes: attributes,
561: +	}
562: +}
563: +
564: +func c9sInterfaceEvent(
565: +	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
566: +	node clablabruntime.NodeState,
567: +	action string,
568: +	iface clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData,
569: +) aggregatedEvent {
570: +	key := state.Namespace + "/" + state.Name + "/" + node.Name
571: +
572: +	return aggregatedEventFromLabRuntimeEvent(nil, clablabruntime.Event{
573: +		Type: clablabruntime.EventTypeInterface, Action: action,
574: +		ActorID: key, ActorName: state.Name + "-" + node.Name, ActorFullID: key,
575: +		Attributes: map[string]string{
576: +			"namespace": state.Namespace, "lab": state.Name, "node": node.Name, "pod": node.Pod,
577: +			"origin": "clabernetes",
578: +		},
579: +		Lab: state, Node: &node, Interface: &iface,
580: +	})
581: +}

583: +// TestInterfaceEventParity compares the interface events of the lab link (linux eth1, SR Linux
584: +// e1-1 with its alias ethernet-1/1), the management interface and loopback.
585: +func TestInterfaceEventParity(t *testing.T) {
586: +	path, dockerLab := parityLab(t)
587: +
588: +	tests := []struct {
589: +		node string
590: +		data clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData
591: +	}{
592: +		{
593: +			"client",
594: +			clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
595: +				Name:      "eth1",
596: +				Index:     7,
597: +				MTU:       9500,
598: +				MAC:       "aa:c1:ab:56:aa:46",
599: +				OperState: "up",
600: +				Type:      "veth",
601: +			},
602: +		},
603: +		{"srl1", clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
604: +			Name: "e1-1", Alias: "ethernet-1/1", Index: 7, MTU: 9500, MAC: "aa:c1:ab:56:aa:47",
605: +			OperState: "lower-layer-down", Type: "veth",
606: +		}},
607: +		{
608: +			"client",
609: +			clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
610: +				Name:      "eth0",
611: +				Index:     4,
612: +				MTU:       1500,
613: +				MAC:       "02:42:ac:14:14:02",
614: +				OperState: "up",
615: +				Type:      "veth",
616: +			},
617: +		},
618: +		{"client", clablabruntime.InterfaceEventData{
619: +			Name: "lo", Index: 1, MTU: 65536, OperState: "unknown", Type: "device",
620: +		}},
621: +	}
622: +	for _, tt := range tests {
623: +		container := dockerContainer(t, dockerLab, tt.node)
624: +		state, nodeState := c9sNode(dockerLab, path, tt.node)
625: +		snapshot := ifaceSnapshot{
626: +			Index: tt.data.Index, Name: tt.data.Name, Alias: tt.data.Alias, MTU: tt.data.MTU,
627: +			MAC: tt.data.MAC, OperState: tt.data.OperState, Type: tt.data.Type,
628: +		}
629: +		metrics := ifaceStatsMetrics{
630: +			RxBytes: 2000, TxBytes: 3000, RxPackets: 20, TxPackets: 30,
631: +			RxBps: 8000, TxBps: 12000, RxPps: 10, TxPps: 15, Interval: 2 * time.Second,
632: +		}
633: +
634: +		for _, action := range []string{"snapshot", "create", "update", "delete", "stats"} {
635: +			var stats *ifaceStatsMetrics
636: +			data := tt.data
637: +			if action == "stats" {
638: +				stats = &metrics
639: +				data.Stats = &clablabruntime.InterfaceStats{
640: +					RxBytes: 2000, TxBytes: 3000, RxPackets: 20, TxPackets: 30,
641: +					RxBps: 8000, TxBps: 12000, RxPps: 10, TxPps: 15, Interval: 2 * time.Second,
642: +				}
643: +			}
644: +			docker := dockerInterfaceEvent(container, action, snapshot, stats)
645: +			c9s := c9sInterfaceEvent(state, nodeState, action, data)
646: +			assertAttributeParity(t, docker, c9s, nil)
647: +

1083:  With `--runtime c9s`, events are backed by kubernetes watches for Clabernetes
1084: -`Topology` and `Node` resources and labeled Pods. Interface state (`interface up`
1085: -and `interface down` events) and statistics are sampled inside the device
1086: -containers, not through local host netlink. The stream covers every namespace by
1087: -default; `--namespace` (or `CLAB_KUBE_NAMESPACE`) limits it to one namespace,
1088: -and `-t`/`--name` to one lab. With Docker and Podman the lab selection is ignored
1089: -and every lab is streamed.
1090: +`Topology` and `Node` resources and labeled Pods. They use the actions and
1091: +attributes of the Docker runtime: a node is a container (`create`, `start`,
1092: +`kill`, `stop`, `die`, `destroy`, `health_status: …`) described by the same
1093: +labels, and the interface events (`snapshot`, `create`, `update`, `delete`,
1094: +`stats`) report the node's lab link interfaces, `eth0` and `lo` under the names
1095: +a Docker container of the node has. Interface state and statistics are sampled
1096: +inside the device containers, not through local host netlink. The stream covers
1097: +every namespace by default; `--namespace` (or `CLAB_KUBE_NAMESPACE`) limits it
1098: +to one namespace, and `-t`/`--name` to one lab. With Docker and Podman the lab
1099: +selection is ignored and every lab is streamed. The
1100: +[c9s runtime manual](../manual/clabernetes/runtime.md#events) lists the
1101: +attributes and the few Docker attributes c9s has no equivalent for.
1102:  
1103:  Runtimes that do not implement the `events` API, or are not yet supported by Containerlab, will exit with an explanatory error.
1104:  
1105:  ## See also
1106:  
1107:  - [`inspect interfaces`](inspect/interfaces.md) – produces a point-in-time view of the same interface details that `events` reports continuously.

1116:  ### Description
1117:  
1118:  The `inspect interfaces` subcommand provides information about the network interfaces of deployed nodes of a deployed lab.
1119:  The subcommand gathers information directly from deployed containers, and displays information about their operational state, network interface type, and if applicable, the applied network interface alias.
1120:  
1121: -With the [c9s runtime](../../manual/clabernetes/runtime.md#packet-capture), the listing covers the lab link interfaces of each running node, the ones [`capture`](../capture.md) accepts, with the alias the topology used, and the MAC address, index, MTU and operational state read in the node's device container. The node names follow `inspect` (`<lab>-<node>`), and the JSON fields are the same as with Docker.
1122: +With the [c9s runtime](../../manual/clabernetes/runtime.md#interface-events), the listing covers the interfaces a Docker container of the node has: the lab link interfaces of each running node (the ones [`capture`](../capture.md) accepts) with the alias the topology used, the management interface `eth0` and the loopback `lo`, with the MAC address, index, MTU and operational state read in the node's device container. The pod's own interfaces are not listed. The node names follow `inspect` (`<lab>-<node>`), and the JSON fields and values (`veth`/`device`, netlink state names) are the same as with Docker. `eth0` and `lo` cannot be captured on c9s.
1123:  
1124:  ### Usage
1125:  
1126:  `containerlab [global-flags] inspect interfaces [local-flags]`

1148: +### Topology file
1149: +
1150: +A deploy records the absolute path of the topology file, on the machine that
1151: +deployed it, in the annotation `containerlab.dev/topo-file`:
1152: +
1153: +- with a `Topology` resource, on the `Topology`; every deploy records the file
1154: +  it read
1155: +- with `--no-topology-cr`, on every `Node`. clabernetes copies a Node's
1156: +  annotations into its pod, so a Node keeps the file it was created from: a
1157: +  later deploy from another file does not change it and does not restart the
1158: +  node. Destroy and deploy again to record a new file.
1159: +
1160: +`inspect` reports the recorded file as `labPath` and `absLabPath` (shortened
1161: +for the table, as for Docker), and events as `clab-topo-file`, so a client
1162: +matches a running lab to its file the same way for every runtime. The file is a
1163: +path on the deploying machine; a client on another machine cannot assume it
1164: +exists there.
1165: +
1166: +A lab that containerlab did not deploy from a file, for example one applied from
1167: +`deploy --emit-crs` output with `kubectl` (the emitted manifests do not carry
1168: +the annotation), has no recorded file. It reports where its definition lives in
1169: +the cluster: `k8s://<namespace>/topologies/<lab>`, or
1170: +`k8s://<namespace>/labs/<lab>` without a `Topology` resource. With `-t`,
1171: +`inspect` reports the given file.
1172: +
1173:  Useful kubernetes checks for the same state are:
1174:  
1175:  ```bash
1176:  kubectl -n <namespace> get node.c9s.run,link.c9s.run,nodeprofile.c9s.run,deploy,pod,svc,cm,pvc \
1177:    -l c9s.run/topologyOwner=<lab>

1239: +
1240: +Each node is reported as a container. Its state follows its pod: `created`
1241: +while the pod is scheduled and prepared, `running` once the device containers
1242: +run, `exited` once the node is stopped, or its pod ends or is replaced. A change
1243: +is reported with the actions Docker reports for the same change:
1244: +
1245: +| Change | Actions |
1246: +|---|---|
1247: +| the node appears (deploy, apply) | `create`, then `start` once its pod runs |
1248: +| the device boots, is ready, is not ready anymore | `health_status: starting`, `health_status: healthy`, `health_status: unhealthy` |
1249: +| `stop` | `kill`, `stop`, `die` |
1250: +| `start` | `start` |
1251: +| `restart`, or the pod is replaced | `kill`, `stop`, `die`, `start` |
1252: +| the node is removed (destroy, apply) | `kill`, `die` (when it ran), `destroy` |
1253: +
1254: +With `--initial-state`, the stream starts with one event per node whose action
1255: +is its state (`running`, `exited`, `created`) and `origin` `snapshot`, like the
1256: +snapshot of a Docker container.

1321:  `/sys/class/net/*/operstate` (with index, MTU, MAC address, flags and alias).

1742: +// Container event actions, as the Docker runtime reports them.
1743: +const (

1746: +	containerActionKill          = "kill"
1747: +	containerActionStop          = "stop"

1756: +
1757: +// trackedContainer is the last reported container state of a node.
1758: +type trackedContainer struct {
1759: +	ref    labRef
1760: +	state  string
1761: +	health string
1762: +	pod    string
1763: +	// lab and node are the last observation, which a removed node is described with.
1764: +	lab  *clablabruntime.LabState
1765: +	node clablabruntime.NodeState
1766: +}
1767: +
1768: +// containerTracker turns the node states of the labs in an event scope into the container
1769: +// events the Docker runtime emits for the same lifecycle: create and start when a node's pod
1770: +// starts, kill, stop and die when it stops (on request, or between the pods of a restart),
1771: +// destroy when the node is removed, and health_status as its device becomes ready.
1772: +type containerTracker struct {
1773: +	r     *Runtime
1774: +	sink  chan<- clablabruntime.Event
1775: +	nodes map[string]*trackedContainer
1776: +}
1777: +
1778: +// trackContainers reports the container events of a scope. It reads the labs once, reporting
1779: +// them as a snapshot when the stream includes the initial state, and then reads a lab again
1780: +// whenever its Topology, Nodes or pods change. Changes that arrive together are read once.
1781: +func (r *Runtime) trackContainers(
1782: +	ctx context.Context,
1783: +	scope eventScope,
1784: +	includeInitialState bool,
1785: +	changed <-chan labRef,
1786: +	eventSink chan<- clablabruntime.Event,
1787: +	errSink chan<- error,
1788: +) {
1789: +	tracker := &containerTracker{r: r, sink: eventSink, nodes: map[string]*trackedContainer{}}
1790: +
1791: +	states, err := r.labStates(ctx, scope)
1792: +	if err != nil {
1793: +		sendEventError(ctx, errSink, err)
1794: +		return
1795: +	}
1796: +	for _, state := range states {
1797: +		tracker.observeLab(ctx, labRef{namespace: state.Namespace, lab: state.Name}, state,
1798: +			&observeSeed{snapshot: includeInitialState})
1799: +	}
1800: +
1801: +	pending := map[labRef]bool{}
1802: +	timer := time.NewTimer(time.Hour)
1803: +	timer.Stop()
1804: +	defer timer.Stop()
1805: +	armed := false
1806: +	arm := func(delay time.Duration) {
1807: +		if !armed {
1808: +			timer.Reset(delay)
1809: +			armed = true
1810: +		}
1811: +	}
1812: +
1813: +	for {
1814: +		select {
1815: +		case <-ctx.Done():
1816: +			return
1817: +		case ref := <-changed:
1818: +			pending[ref] = true
1819: +			arm(containerRefreshDelay)
1820: +		case <-timer.C:
1821: +			armed = false
1822: +			refs := pending
1823: +			pending = map[labRef]bool{}
1824: +			for ref := range refs {
1825: +				if !tracker.refresh(ctx, ref) {
1826: +					pending[ref] = true
1827: +				}
1828: +			}
1829: +			if len(pending) != 0 {
1830: +				arm(containerRefreshRetryDelay)
1831: +			}
1832: +		}
1833: +	}
1834: +}
1835: +
1836: +// observeSeed marks the first observation of a stream: it records the node states without
1837: +// reporting changes, and reports them as a snapshot when asked to.
1838: +type observeSeed struct {
1839: +	snapshot bool
1840: +}
1841: +
1842: +// refresh reads a lab again and reports what changed for its nodes. A lab that is gone reports
1843: +// its nodes as destroyed. It returns false when the lab could not be read.
1844: +func (t *containerTracker) refresh(ctx context.Context, ref labRef) bool {
1845: +	state, err := t.r.Inspect(ctx, clablabruntime.InspectRequest{
1846: +		Name:      ref.lab,
1847: +		Namespace: ref.namespace,
1848: +	})
1849: +	if err != nil {
1850: +		var notFound *labNotFoundError
1851: +		if !errors.As(err, &notFound) {
1852: +			if ctx.Err() == nil {
1853: +				log.Debug("Failed to read a C9s lab for container events",
1854: +					"namespace", ref.namespace, "lab", ref.lab, "error", err)
1855: +			}
1856: +
1857: +			return ctx.Err() != nil
1858: +		}
1859: +		state = nil
1860: +	}
1861: +
1862: +	t.observeLab(ctx, ref, state, nil)
1863: +
1864: +	return true
1865: +}
1866: +
1867: +// observeLab compares the nodes of a lab with what was reported before and reports the
1868: +// difference. A nil state removes every node of the lab.
1869: +func (t *containerTracker) observeLab(
1870: +	ctx context.Context,
1871: +	ref labRef,
1872: +	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
1873: +	seed *observeSeed,
1874: +) {
1875: +	seen := map[string]bool{}
1876: +	if state != nil {
1877: +		for idx := range state.Nodes {
1878: +			key := c9sNodeKey(state.Namespace, state.Name, state.Nodes[idx].Name)
1879: +			seen[key] = true
1880: +			t.observeNode(ctx, ref, state, state.Nodes[idx], seed)
1881: +		}
1882: +	}
1883: +
1884: +	for key, tracked := range t.nodes {
1885: +		if tracked.ref != ref || seen[key] {
1886: +			continue
1887: +		}
1888: +
1889: +		for _, action := range containerRemovalActions(tracked) {
1890: +			t.emit(ctx, tracked.lab, tracked.node, action, nil)
1891: +		}
1892: +		delete(t.nodes, key)
1893: +	}
1894: +}
1895: +
1896: +func (t *containerTracker) observeNode(
1897: +	ctx context.Context,
1898: +	ref labRef,
1899: +	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
1900: +	node clablabruntime.NodeState,
1901: +	seed *observeSeed,
1902: +) {
1903: +	key := c9sNodeKey(state.Namespace, state.Name, node.Name)
1904: +	previous := t.nodes[key]
1905: +	if node.ContainerState == "" {
1906: +		node.ContainerState = clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated
1907: +	}
1908: +	next := &trackedContainer{
1909: +		ref:   ref,
1910: +		state: node.ContainerState,
1911: +		pod:   node.Pod,
1912: +		lab:   state,
1913: +		node:  node,
1914: +	}
1915: +	next.health = containerHealth(previous, next, node.Health)
1916: +	t.nodes[key] = next
1917: +
1918: +	if seed != nil {
1919: +		if seed.snapshot {
1920: +			t.emit(ctx, state, node, next.state, map[string]string{
1921: +				"origin": clablabruntime.EventOriginSnapshot,
1922: +			})
1923: +		}
1924: +
1925: +		return
1926: +	}
1927: +
1928: +	for _, action := range containerTransitionActions(previous, next) {
1929: +		t.emit(ctx, state, node, action, nil)
1930: +	}
1931: +}
1932: +
1933: +// containerHealth is the health a running node reports: a node that was healthy and is not
1934: +// ready anymore in the same pod is unhealthy, as a container whose healthcheck starts failing.
1935: +func containerHealth(previous, next *trackedContainer, health string) string {
1936: +	if next.state != clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning {
1937: +		return ""
1938: +	}
1939: +	if health == "" {
1940: +		health = clablabruntime.ContainerHealthStarting
1941: +	}
1942: +	if health == clablabruntime.ContainerHealthStarting && previous != nil &&
1943: +		previous.state == clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning && previous.pod == next.pod &&
1944: +		(previous.health == clablabruntime.ContainerHealthHealthy ||
1945: +			previous.health == clablabruntime.ContainerHealthUnhealthy) {
1946: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerHealthUnhealthy
1947: +	}
1948: +
1949: +	return health
1950: +}
1951: +
1952: +// containerTransitionActions are the container event actions Docker reports when a container
1953: +// goes from the previous to the next state:
1954: +//
1955: +//	new node            create (+ start when it runs, + stop when it is already stopped)
1956: +//	created -> running  start
1957: +//	exited  -> running  start
1958: +//	running -> exited   kill, stop, die (stop, or the old pod of a restart ending)
1959: +//	running -> created  kill, stop, die (the replacement pod of a restart not running yet)
1960: +//	running, new pod    kill, stop, die, start (restart)
1961: +//	created -> exited   stop
1962: +//
1963: +// A started node also reports its health (health_status: starting or healthy), and a running
1964: +// node reports health changes, like a container with a healthcheck.
1965: +func containerTransitionActions(previous, next *trackedContainer) []string {
1966: +	const (
1967: +		created = clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated
1968: +		running = clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning
1969: +		exited  = clablabruntime.ContainerStateExited
1970: +	)
1971: +
1972: +	var actions []string
1973: +	previousState := ""
1974: +	if previous != nil {
1975: +		previousState = previous.state
1976: +	}
1977: +
1978: +	switch {
1979: +	case previous == nil:
1980: +		actions = append(actions, containerActionCreate)
1981: +		switch next.state {
1982: +		case running:
1983: +			actions = append(actions, containerActionStart)
1984: +		case exited:
1985: +			actions = append(actions, containerActionStop)
1986: +		}
1987: +	case previousState == running && next.state == running && previous.pod != next.pod:
1988: +		actions = append(actions, containerActionKill, containerActionStop, containerActionDie,
1989: +			containerActionStart)
1990: +	case previousState == running && next.state != running:
1991: +		actions = append(actions, containerActionKill, containerActionStop, containerActionDie)
1992: +	case previousState != running && next.state == running:
1993: +		actions = append(actions, containerActionStart)
1994: +	case previousState == created && next.state == exited:
1995: +		actions = append(actions, containerActionStop)
1996: +	}
1997: +
1998: +	if next.state != running {
1999: +		return actions
2000: +	}
2001: +
2002: +	started := len(actions) != 0 && actions[len(actions)-1] == containerActionStart
2003: +	if !started && previous != nil && previous.health == next.health {
2004: +		return actions
2005: +	}
2006: +	if next.health == clablabruntime.ContainerHealthStarting && !started {
2007: +		return actions
2008: +	}
2009: +
2010: +	return append(actions, containerActionHealthPrefix+next.health)
2011: +}
2012: +
2013: +// containerRemovalActions are the actions Docker reports when a container is removed: a running
2014: +// one is killed and dies first.
2015: +func containerRemovalActions(previous *trackedContainer) []string {
2016: +	if previous.state == clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning {
2017: +		return []string{containerActionKill, containerActionDie, containerActionDestroy}
2018: +	}
2019: +
2020: +	return []string{containerActionDestroy}
2021: +}
2022: +
2023: +// containerActionState is the container state after an action, which every container event
2024: +// reports in its state attribute.
2025: +func containerActionState(action, snapshotState string) string {
2026: +	switch action {
2027: +	case containerActionCreate:
2028: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated
2029: +	case containerActionStop, containerActionDie, containerActionDestroy:
2030: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateExited
2031: +	case containerActionStart, containerActionKill:
2032: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning
2033: +	}
2034: +	if strings.HasPrefix(action, containerActionHealthPrefix) {
2035: +		return clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning
2036: +	}
2037: +
2038: +	return snapshotState
2039: +}
2040: +
2041: +func (t *containerTracker) emit(
2042: +	ctx context.Context,
2043: +	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
2044: +	node clablabruntime.NodeState,
2045: +	action string,
2046: +	extra map[string]string,
2047: +) {
2048: +	t.r.sendEvent(ctx, t.sink, c9sContainerEvent(state, node, action, extra))
2049: +}
2050: +
2051: +// c9sContainerEvent is a container event of a node. The actor is the node, as for its interface
2052: +// events; its ID is the container_id inspect reports. Lab and Node let the events command
2053: +// describe the node with the attributes inspect and the Docker runtime report.
2054: +func c9sContainerEvent(
2055: +	state *clablabruntime.LabState,
2056: +	node clablabruntime.NodeState,
2057: +	action string,
2058: +	extra map[string]string,
2059: +) clablabruntime.Event {
2060: +	key := c9sNodeKey(state.Namespace, state.Name, node.Name)
2061: +	attributes := map[string]string{
2062: +		"namespace":                  state.Namespace,
2063: +		"lab":                        state.Name,
2064: +		"node":                       node.Name,
2065: +		containerEventAttributeState: containerActionState(action, node.ContainerState),
2066: +	}
2067: +	if node.Pod != "" {
2068: +		attributes["pod"] = node.Pod
2069: +	}
2070: +	if action == containerActionKill {
2071: +		// Kubernetes stops a pod's containers with SIGTERM.
2072: +		attributes["signal"] = containerEventSignalSIGTERM
2073: +	}
2074: +	for k, v := range extra {
2075: +		attributes[k] = v
2076: +	}
2077: +
2078: +	nodeCopy := node
2079: +
2080: +	return clablabruntime.Event{
2081: +		Timestamp:   time.Now(),
2082: +		Type:        clablabruntime.EventTypeContainer,
2083: +		Action:      action,
2084: +		ActorID:     key,
2085: +		ActorName:   fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", state.Name, node.Name),
2086: +		ActorFullID: key,
2087: +		Attributes:  attributes,
2088: +		Lab:         state,
2089: +		Node:        &nodeCopy,
2090: +	}
2091: +}

2248: +// poller: only the lab link interfaces (named and aliased as clabwire lists them), eth0 and lo
2249: +// are reported, with the actions of the netlink events.
2250: +func TestInterfacePollerReportsTheTopologyInterfaces(t *testing.T) {
2251: +	t.Parallel()
2252: +
2253: +	tests := []struct {
2254: +		name  string
2255: +		link  string
2256: +		alias string
2257: +	}{
2258: +		{name: "linux", link: "eth1"},
2259: +		{name: "srl", link: "e1-1", alias: "ethernet-1/1"},
2260: +	}
2261: +	for _, tt := range tests {
2262: +		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
2263: +			t.Parallel()
2264: +
2265: +			links := []clabwireInterface{{
2266: +				Node: "r1", Interface: tt.link, Alias: tt.alias,
2267: +				PeerNode: "r2", PeerInterface: tt.link,
2268: +			}}
2269: +			sink := make(chan clablabruntime.Event, 64)
2270: +			p := newInterfacePoller(&Runtime{}, eventScope{},
2271: +				interfacePollOptions{includeInitialState: true}, sink)
2272: +			ctx := context.Background()
2273: +			start := time.Now()
2274: +
2275: +			p.processSample(
2276: +				ctx,
2277: +				interfaceTestSample("r1", start, links, podInterfaces(tt.link, "up")),
2278: +			)
2279: +			got := interfacesByName(drain(sink))
2280: +			if len(got) != 3 {
2281: +				t.Fatalf("first round reported %v, want %s, eth0 and lo", got, tt.link)
2282: +			}
2283: +			link := got[tt.link]
2284: +			if link.Action != interfaceActionSnapshot ||
2285: +				link.Type != clablabruntime.EventTypeInterface ||
2286: +				link.ActorID != "c9s-lab1/lab1/r1" ||
2287: +				link.ActorFullID != "c9s-lab1/lab1/r1" ||
2288: +				link.ActorName != "lab1-r1" || link.Interface.Alias != tt.alias ||
2289: +				link.Interface.OperState != "up" || link.Interface.Type != "veth" ||
2290: +				link.Lab == nil || link.Node == nil || link.Node.Name != "r1" ||
2291: +				link.Attributes["origin"] != "clabernetes" ||
2292: +				link.Attributes["pod"] != "lab1-r1-abc" ||
2293: +				link.Attributes["namespace"] != "c9s-lab1" {
2294: +				t.Fatalf("%s event = %+v", tt.link, link)
2295: +			}
2296: +			if got["lo"].Interface.Type != "device" || got["eth0"].Interface.Alias != "" {
2297: +				t.Fatalf("eth0/lo = %+v %+v", got["eth0"].Interface, got["lo"].Interface)
2298: +			}
2299: +
2300: +			// unchanged: nothing
2301: +			p.firstRound = false
2302: +			p.processSample(ctx, interfaceTestSample("r1", start.Add(time.Second), links,
2303: +				podInterfaces(tt.link, "up")))
2304: +			if events := drain(sink); len(events) != 0 {
2305: +				t.Fatalf("unchanged interfaces reported %+v", events)
2306: +			}
2307: +
2308: +			// the peer goes away: the link loses its carrier
2309: +			p.processSample(ctx, interfaceTestSample("r1", start.Add(2*time.Second), links,
2310: +				podInterfaces(tt.link, "lowerlayerdown")))
2311: +			events := drain(sink)
2312: +			if len(events) != 1 || events[0].Action != interfaceActionUpdate ||
2313: +				events[0].Interface.Name != tt.link ||
2314: +				events[0].Interface.OperState != "lower-layer-down" {
2315: +				t.Fatalf("carrier loss reported %+v", events)
2316: +			}
2317: +
2318: +			// the link interface disappears, then comes back
2319: +			withoutLink := podInterfaces(tt.link, "up")
2320: +			withoutLink = withoutLink[:len(withoutLink)-1]
2321: +			p.processSample(
2322: +				ctx,
2323: +				interfaceTestSample("r1", start.Add(3*time.Second), links, withoutLink),
2324: +			)
2325: +			events = drain(sink)
2326: +			if len(events) != 1 || events[0].Action != interfaceActionDelete ||
2327: +				events[0].Interface.Name != tt.link {
2328: +				t.Fatalf("removed link reported %+v", events)
2329: +			}
2330: +			p.processSample(ctx, interfaceTestSample("r1", start.Add(4*time.Second), links,
2331: +				podInterfaces(tt.link, "up")))
2332: +			events = drain(sink)
2333: +			if len(events) != 1 || events[0].Action != interfaceActionCreate ||
2334: +				events[0].Interface.Alias != tt.alias {
2335: +				t.Fatalf("new link reported %+v", events)
2336: +			}
2337: +
2338: +			// the node stops: its interfaces are deleted
2339: +			p.retireStoppedNodes(ctx, map[string]bool{})
2340: +			got = interfacesByName(drain(sink))
2341: +			if len(got) != 3 || got[tt.link].Action != interfaceActionDelete ||
2342: +				got["eth0"].Action != interfaceActionDelete || len(p.nodes) != 0 {
2343: +				t.Fatalf("stopped node reported %+v", got)
2344: +			}
2345: +		})
2346: +	}
2347: +}

2351: +

2362: +func TestInterfacePollerStatsCoverTheReportedInterfaces(t *testing.T) {
2363: +	t.Parallel()
2364: +
2365: +	sink := make(chan clablabruntime.Event, 32)
2366: +	p := newInterfacePoller(
2367: +		&Runtime{},
2368: +		eventScope{},
2369: +		interfacePollOptions{includeStats: true},
2370: +		sink,
2371: +	)
2372: +	links := []clabwireInterface{{Node: "r1", Interface: "e1-1", Alias: "ethernet-1/1"}}
2373: +	start := time.Now()
2374: +	first := interfaceTestSample("r1", start, links, podInterfaces("e1-1", "up"))
2375: +	second := interfaceTestSample("r1", start.Add(time.Second), links, podInterfaces("e1-1", "up"))
2376: +	for idx := range second.stats {
2377: +		second.stats[idx].RxBytes = first.stats[idx].RxBytes + 1000
2378: +	}
2379: +
2380: +	p.processSample(context.Background(), first)
2381: +	_ = drain(sink)
2382: +	p.processSample(context.Background(), second)
2383: +	got := interfacesByName(drain(sink))
2384: +	if len(got) != 3 {
2385: +		t.Fatalf("stats reported for %v, want e1-1, eth0 and lo", got)
2386: +	}
2387: +	stats := got["e1-1"]
2388: +	if stats.Action != interfaceActionStats || stats.Interface.Alias != "ethernet-1/1" ||
2389: +		stats.Interface.Index != 7 || stats.Interface.OperState != "up" ||
2390: +		stats.Interface.Stats == nil || stats.Interface.Stats.RxBps != 8000 ||
2391: +		stats.Interface.Stats.Interval != time.Second {
2392: +		t.Fatalf("e1-1 stats = %+v %+v", stats, stats.Interface)
2393: +	}
2394: +}

2396: +// listingExec answers clabwire --list-interfaces with the listing of the pod and counts the
2397: +// listings.
2398: +type listingExec struct {
2399: +	mu       sync.Mutex
2400: +	listings map[string][]clabwireInterface
2401: +	calls    int
2402: +}
2403: +
2404: +func (l *listingExec) exec(
2405: +	_ context.Context,
2406: +	_, pod, container string,
2407: +	command []string,
2408: +	_ io.Reader,
2409: +	stdout, _ io.Writer,
2410: +) error {
2411: +	l.mu.Lock()
2412: +	defer l.mu.Unlock()
2413: +
2414: +	if container != clabwireContainer || !slices.Contains(command, "--list-interfaces") {
2415: +		return nil
2416: +	}
2417: +	l.calls++
2418: +
2419: +	return json.NewEncoder(stdout).Encode(l.listings[pod])
2420: +}

2422: +func TestInterfacePollerListsAPodOncePerInterfaceSet(t *testing.T) {
2423: +	t.Parallel()
2424: +
2425: +	listing := &listingExec{listings: map[string][]clabwireInterface{
2426: +		"lab1-r1-abc": {
2427: +			{Node: "r1", Interface: "e1-1", Alias: "ethernet-1/1"},
2428: +			{Node: "r1b", Interface: "e1-2"},
2429: +		},
2430: +	}}
2431: +	r := &Runtime{podExec: listing.exec}
2432: +	p := newInterfacePoller(
2433: +		r,
2434: +		eventScope{},
2435: +		interfacePollOptions{},
2436: +		make(chan clablabruntime.Event),
2437: +	)
2438: +	target := interfaceTestSample("r1", time.Now(), nil, nil).target
2439: +
2440: +	for range 3 {
2441: +		links, err := p.nodeLinks(context.Background(), target, "e1-1,eth0,lo")
2442: +		if err != nil {
2443: +			t.Fatal(err)
2444: +		}
2445: +		if len(links) != 1 || links[0].Alias != "ethernet-1/1" {
2446: +			t.Fatalf("links = %+v, want the node's own link", links)
2447: +		}
2448: +	}
2449: +	if listing.calls != 1 {
2450: +		t.Fatalf("listed %d times, want once while the interfaces stay the same", listing.calls)
2451: +	}
2452: +
2453: +	if _, err := p.nodeLinks(context.Background(), target, "e1-1,e1-2,eth0,lo"); err != nil {
2454: +		t.Fatal(err)
2455: +	}
2456: +	if listing.calls != 2 {
2457: +		t.Fatalf("listed %d times, want again after the interfaces changed", listing.calls)
2458: +	}
2459: +
2460: +	p.forgetListings(map[string]bool{})
2461: +	if len(p.listings) != 0 {
2462: +		t.Fatalf("listings of gone pods kept: %+v", p.listings)
2463: +	}
2464: +}

2466: +func TestContainerTransitionActions(t *testing.T) {
2467: +	t.Parallel()
2468: +
2469: +	const (
2470: +		created = clablabruntime.ContainerStateCreated
2471: +		running = clablabruntime.ContainerStateRunning
2472: +		exited  = clablabruntime.ContainerStateExited
2473: +		healthy = clablabruntime.ContainerHealthHealthy
2474: +		start   = clablabruntime.ContainerHealthStarting
2475: +		sick    = clablabruntime.ContainerHealthUnhealthy
2476: +	)
2477: +	tracked := func(state, health, pod string) *trackedContainer {
2478: +		return &trackedContainer{state: state, health: health, pod: pod}
2479: +	}
2480: +
2481: +	tests := []struct {
2482: +		name     string
2483: +		previous *trackedContainer
2484: +		next     *trackedContainer
2485: +		want     string
2486: +	}{
2487: +		{"new pending node", nil, tracked(created, "", ""), "create"},
2488: +		{
2489: +			"new running node", nil, tracked(running, start, "p1"),
2490: +			"create,start,health_status: starting",
2491: +		},
2492: +		{
2493: +			"new ready node", nil, tracked(running, healthy, "p1"),
2494: +			"create,start,health_status: healthy",
2495: +		},
2496: +		{"new stopped node", nil, tracked(exited, "", ""), "create,stop"},
2497: +		{
2498: +			"pod starts", tracked(created, "", "p1"), tracked(running, start, "p1"),
2499: +			"start,health_status: starting",
2500: +		},
2501: +		{
2502: +			"device ready", tracked(running, start, "p1"), tracked(running, healthy, "p1"),
2503: +			"health_status: healthy",
2504: +		},
2505: +		{"still booting", tracked(running, start, "p1"), tracked(running, start, "p1"), ""},
2506: +		{"no change", tracked(running, healthy, "p1"), tracked(running, healthy, "p1"), ""},
2507: +		{
2508: +			"device not ready again", tracked(running, healthy, "p1"), tracked(running, sick, "p1"),
2509: +			"health_status: unhealthy",
2510: +		},
2511: +		{"stop", tracked(running, healthy, "p1"), tracked(exited, "", ""), "kill,stop,die"},
2512: +		{
2513: +			"start", tracked(exited, "", ""), tracked(running, healthy, "p2"),
2514: +			"start,health_status: healthy",
2515: +		},
2516: +		{
2517: +			"restart, new pod pending", tracked(running, healthy, "p1"), tracked(created, "", "p2"),
2518: +			"kill,stop,die",
2519: +		},
2520: +		{
2521: +			"restart, new pod running", tracked(running, healthy, "p1"),
2522: +			tracked(running, start, "p2"), "kill,stop,die,start,health_status: starting",
2523: +		},
2524: +		{"stopped before it ran", tracked(created, "", "p1"), tracked(exited, "", ""), "stop"},
2525: +		{"stopped node rescheduled", tracked(exited, "", ""), tracked(created, "", "p2"), ""},
2526: +	}
2527: +	for _, tt := range tests {
2528: +		got := strings.Join(containerTransitionActions(tt.previous, tt.next), ",")
2529: +		if got != tt.want {
2530: +			t.Fatalf("%s: actions = %q, want %q", tt.name, got, tt.want)
2531: +		}
2532: +	}
2533: +
2534: +	if got := strings.Join(containerRemovalActions(tracked(running, healthy, "p1")), ","); got !=
2535: +		"kill,die,destroy" {
2536: +		t.Fatalf("removal of a running node = %q", got)
2537: +	}
2538: +	if got := strings.Join(
2539: +		containerRemovalActions(tracked(exited, "", "")),
2540: +		",",
2541: +	); got != "destroy" {
2542: +		t.Fatalf("removal of a stopped node = %q", got)
2543: +	}
2544: +
2545: +	// health: a running node that was healthy and is not ready anymore in the same pod is
2546: +	// unhealthy; in a new pod it starts again
2547: +	previous := tracked(running, healthy, "p1")
2548: +	if got := containerHealth(previous, tracked(running, "", "p1"), start); got != sick {
2549: +		t.Fatalf("health in the same pod = %q", got)
2550: +	}
2551: +	if got := containerHealth(previous, tracked(running, "", "p2"), start); got != start {
2552: +		t.Fatalf("health in a new pod = %q", got)
2553: +	}
2554: +}
